name: Pioneer
description: "Stereo cassette deck with a design that can be stacked with amplifiers and tuners.The cassette tape is set at an angle of 30 � from the front, and the running condition can be confirmed with the naked eye.In order to ensure low rotational unevenness under this condition, we have adopted an electronically controlled DC motor with large torque that is not affected by voltage fluctuations, and a high-precision capstan with roundness of 0.1 Ï‰ or less.It is equipped with a peak indicator combining a light emitting diode (LED) and an electronic circuit.Reacts quickly to the instantaneous peak level of the recording source and lights up to warn you that the recording level is over.The lighting level is set at + 4 dB from the reference recording level (0 dB on the meter). Since there is a margin to + 10 dB, which is the maximum recording level at which sound is completely distorted, the recording level can be adjusted when it flashes.In the case of Dolby recording, setting the recording level with the peak indicator results in a slightly lower average level, allowing recording with a wide dynamic range at a low distortion rate.The built-in Dolby system greatly reduces noise without compromising the sound quality of the recording source.In order to bring out the taste of chrome tape, low-noise tape, standard tape, etc., it is equipped with an independent switching type tape selector with 2 levels of bias and 2 levels of equalizer.For chrome tapes, a new equalizer circuit with a time constant of 70 Ï‰ s is used to improve the high-frequency SN.Duad Ferri Chrome When using a tape, switch the Bias Selector to Normal and the Equalizer Selector to Chrome, and record and play back the tape. This will bring out the tape.The head uses a ferrite solid head with less head wear.There is little magnetic loss at high frequency, which is advantageous for use of chrome tape.In addition, the contact surface is elaborately mirror-finished to obtain stable sound quality.Equipped with a recording level limiter.When you use this device, the limiter amplifier automatically adjusts the level of the overlevel during recording to prevent the sound from breaking.It has a built-in recording amplifier with a large dynamic margin and a high maximum allowable input.It has a built-in tape counter for repeated playback.If memory rewind is set to ON, it will automatically stop at the counter 999, one point before the start point in the rewind operation.It has a built-in internal authentication switch that makes it easier to see the letters on the tape.Equipped with a skip button that can fast-forward at about twice the speed while monitoring the playback sound.Equipped with a large level meter.A memory marker device that stores the position of the knob for recording and playback levels.Parallel input / output terminal for simultaneous recording with other decks."

name: Pioneer
description: "A front-operated stereo cassette deck equipped with a timer recording standby mechanism.By connecting a timer and setting the control lever to recording or playback standby (with the pause button pressed), the tape can be started at the desired time.Since the pinch roller is separated from the capstan during standby, there is no need to worry about damaging the mechanism or tape.A commercially available timer can be used.In order to make it easier to see the tape running, the mechanism is tilted by 30 degrees.In this condition, in order to under this condition, we have adopted an electronically controlled DC motor with large torque that is not affected by voltage fluctuations, and a high-precision capstan with roundness of 0.1 Ï‰ or less.It is equipped with a peak indicator that combines a light-emitting diode and electronic circuit that quickly responds to + 5 dB level in several mmsec.This quickly reacts to the instantaneous peak level of the recording source and turns on to warn that the recording level is over.It has a built-in Dolby System that greatly reduces tape hissing without compromising the sound quality of the recording source. When the Dolby System is ON, the indicator lamp lights.In order to bring out the characteristics of each tape such as chrome tape, low-noise tape and standard tape, it is equipped with an independent switchable tape selector with two levels of bias and two levels of equalizer.A new equalizer circuit with a time constant of 70 Ï‰ s that improves S/N by 4.5 dB in the high-frequency range is also used for chrome tapes. When using general low-noise tapes, both the bias and equalizer are set to STD. When using chrome tapes, both the bias and equalizer are set to CrO.2For more information.You can enjoy recording and playback that demonstrate the characteristics of each tape in terms of frequency characteristics and distortion factor.It is equipped with a recording amplifier with a large dynamic margin, and is designed to use a professional standard microphone with a compatible microphone impedance, so it is very useful for live recording.The head uses a ferrite solid head with less wear and long life.Since the contact surface with the tape is made of a hard material unique to ferrite and carefully mirror-finished, sound skipping due to dust adhesion is less and stable sound quality can be obtained.In order to facilitate cleaning of the cassette compartment set at 30 degrees, we have installed a maintenance skylight at the top of the bonnet where a large head eraser can be used.This makes maintenance of the head and travel system easy.It is equipped with a memory rewind switch. When this switch is turned ON, the start point [000] of the tape counter is memorized, played and recorded, and rewound after that, the tape stops at the [999] position.This mechanism is convenient when you want to repeatedly listen to the same music recorded in the middle of the tape.Equipped with a skip button that allows you to fast-forward at twice the speed while listening to monkey talk.The tape counter has a light lamp."

name: Pioneer
description: "A multi-functional cassette deck with built-in electronic digital timer, capable of recording absence, sleep timer and alarm clock playback.It has a built-in high-precision digital timer to further develop the absence recording function.The digital timer section, which requires accuracy, employs an electronic system using newly developed MOS LSI (Ultra-Integrated Circuit). The start time can be set at one minute intervals and the error with respect to the set start time is also kept low.In addition, the amount of time light can be switched to two levels.With the Timer knob, you can set the time for recording your absence, playing an alarm clock, or operating as a sleep timer.59 minutes can be set with 1H-ON, 118 minutes with 2H-ON, and 59 minutes with SLEEP. When the set time ends, the power to the deck and AC outlet is automatically turned off.The DISPLAY knob is used to set the current time and recording start time.The ADJUST knob advances the timer to the desired time. It can be set quickly to near the time set by FAST, while it can be set slowly by SLOW. The sleep timer operates by SLEEP START.If the outlet is unplugged or there is a power failure, either AM or PM will flash to indicate the current time error when the power supply is restored after a lapse of time.The drive section uses a DC-motor with a built-in generator with less torque ripple and vibration, and a capstan and flat belt with a precision finish to ensure stable tape drive.It is equipped with a tape selector with a built-in automatic switching mechanism for chrome tapes. When a chrome tape with a detection hole is attached, the bias and equalizer are automatically switched to chrome regardless of the position of the tape selector.Also, manual switching is possible for LH tape and Ferrichrome tape.In order to securely fix the cassette, a 6-blade reel with less play between the tape and the hub is used.Equipped with a memory stop on-off switch that is convenient for tracking.Equipped with a tape mechanism protection device that prevents the mechanism from differentiating if the tape is not set correctly.Equipped with a back illumination lamp with a tape end marker line that shows the remaining amount of tape at a glance.Equipped with a full auto-stop mechanism that employs a Hall element."

name: Pioneer
description: "A stereo cassette deck equipped with a third meter that can be used with three functions.Equipped with 3 independent meters that can be used separately : dynamic level meter, bias meter and peak meter.The dynamic level meter is designed so that it fluctuates slightly in the low range and considerably in the high range.When recording, in general, the distortion tends to increase as the level increases in the low frequency band, and tends to saturate in the high frequency band. However, since conventional meters cannot read the frequency component of the input signal, recording at a higher level may cause high peaks in a source that contains many high frequencies, and distortion increases in a source that contains many low frequencies.The dynamic level meter allows you to set an appropriate recording level that matches the frequency component of the recording source.When the bias meter is used, the amount of bias can be checked with the meter, and the bias variable volume can be set to the proper recording bias suitable for the tape to be used. This can be used for various types of tapes and provides better recording characteristics.The peak meter acts as a peak meter (Lch + Rch) with a fast response speed during playback.The drive section is equipped with an electronically controlled DC-motor with a built-in generator with stable rotational performance. In addition, it is equipped with a large flywheel with large inertial mass. The capstan with high roundness and high surface accuracy is driven by a flat belt. This improves the accuracy of the drive section thoroughly and ensures excellent rotational performance.The Dolby System is used as a noise reduction system.Equipped with a tape selector with automatic tape switching mechanism for CrO2 position.When a CrO2 position tape is attached to the Tape Selector, both the Bias / Equalizer switch automatically to the CrO2 position, and the Bias switch to the standard value for each tape, allowing fine adjustment while watching the Third Meter.Equipped with a memory stop mechanism.It uses a timer standby mechanism that enables you to record your absence and play an alarm.Uses a large indicator.By using a separately sold rack mount adapter, it can be mounted on an EIA-standard rack."

name: Pioneer
description: "In addition to the functions of the top-of-the-line CD-980, it is an auto-reverse deck with a Oatley berth at the Rokuon-ji temple.Equipped with a Oatley berth mechanism that employs LED sensors.The use of an LED sensor eliminates the loss of the leader tape (approximately 12 ~ 15 seconds), which was the bottleneck of the conventional reverse method, and realizes a quick reverse. In addition, the CT 780 uses a recording / playback Oatley verse mechanism that allows the reverse to work not only during playback but also during recording, enabling a long-time air check.3 dd system is adopted for the mechanism part.The 3 dd system has a simple structure in which the capstan and left and right reels are directly driven by three independent motors.The capstan motor uses a brushless DC servo hole motor with a coreless and slotless structure to reduce harmful components such as torque ripple and cogging. The reel motor also uses a brushless DC servo hole motor with a highly reliable coreless and slotless structure to achieve excellent durability and smooth tape travel.A ribbon sendust head is used for the head part.For the first time in the world, Sendust, which is hard and brittle and difficult to process, is made into a thin strip and multi-layer laminate. Compared with conventional Sendust heads, which were limited to three layers, this head reduces eddy current loss, expands the frequency range and dynamic range, and adapts to the characteristics of metal tapes.As a noise reduction system, Dolby C type is installed in addition to Dolby B type.The panel layout is divided into 3 parts. On the right side, various operation buttons for various tape play are arranged in a concentrated manner. In the center, LED illumination displays the tape running status, tape position and Dolby B/C position.The meter uses a 2-color LED peak level meter with excellent response speed.It is equipped with functions such as skip reverse which skips the unrecorded portion of the tape end and quickly plays the first track on the back of the cassette, index scan which continuously plays the head of the track, and blank search which quickly finds the unrecorded portion and sets the recording standby.Equipped with timer standby mechanism, recording of absence and alarm clock playback are possible.Equipped with a REC mute mechanism that can create unrecorded portions between songs.It uses a new feeling operation key.Equipped with one touch recording button.By using the separately sold remote control unit, it can be operated from a remote location."

name: Pioneer
description: "3-head stereo cassette deck.It uses a 3-head system with separate heads for recording, playback, and erasing. By thoroughly pursuing both recording and playback characteristics from their respective standpoints, it realizes high sound quality that cannot be obtained with a dual-head system.In order to effectively realize three heads on a cassette deck, the CT 910 uses a combination head that packages individually made recording heads and reproducing heads into a single case. This keeps the gap parallelism of both heads constant and prevents azimuth deviation and crosstalk. A center mask is provided between the two heads to prevent magnetic interference and improve head touch.The Sendust alloy originally developed by Pioneer is used in the head core of the recording and reproducing heads.As a result, wear resistance, distortion factor characteristics at high input power, and high frequency are improved, while adhesion of magnetic powder and dust and generation of noise due to magnetization are minimized.The mechanism section employs a closed-loop dual capstan system consisting of two capstan units. This system keeps the tension of the tape running in both capstan units constant at all times, resulting in extremely good head touch and preventing not only drop-outs and level fluctuations but also modulation noise caused by tape vibration.The drive section uses a 2-motor system that uses an electronically controlled DC servo motor with a built-in generator for constant speed operation and a DC high torque motor for fast forward operation.Equipped with an ATLC mechanism that instantly removes tape slack when the cassette half is mounted.Equipped with FL level meter.The level indicator uses 20 segments per channel and is designed to cover the range from -20 to + 7 dB. In addition, one segment per 1 dB is used for the range from -4 to + 7 dB, which is the most important for level monitoring. The two color indicator lights blue when the level is less than 0 dB and orange when the level is more than 0 dB. This makes level monitoring easier.This FL meter displays the average and is a 3-step switching type that can switch the response characteristics to peak or peak hold by controlling the microprocessor.It is equipped with a multipurpose memory mechanism using a microprocessor.The CT 910 is equipped with an FL counter that provides a 3-digit digital display by inputting the rotational speed detection pulse of the reel base into a microprocessor. It also has an end-repeat function, memory stop, memory play, and counter repeat functions by the microprocessor's memory control function.Equipped with a bias adjustment mechanism, it can be adjusted according to the characteristics of the tape to be used.It adopts a full open loading system and can be securely mounted in cassette half.It also comes with a dust protector that covers the head housing.The operation part adopts a pure electronic control system using a logic circuit, so that it can move directly from any position to the next operation.Equipped with a CrO2 position automatic switching mechanism.STD and Fe-Cr can be switched manually.The Dolby System is installed as a noise reduction system.Equipped with a timer start button, you can record your absence or play an alarm clock in conjunction with the timer.Equipped with an input selector that can switch between line and microphone inputs.By using a separately sold rack mount adapter, it can be mounted on an EIA-standard rack."

name: Pioneer
description: "Stereo cassette deck with UNI X' tal ferrite combination head.The head section uses a 3-head system that uses dedicated heads for recording, playback and erasing.The head uses the UNI X' tal ferrite head with excellent linear gap, uniform gap, and abrasion resistance, ensuring wide-band playback and excellent SN ratio. The CT-1000 uses a wide-gap recording head with low distortion and high recording sensitivity, and a narrow-gap recording head with excellent playback frequency characteristics.In addition, the head mount is a combination type in which a recording head and a reproducing head are individually manufactured and packaged in a high precision case, so that the parallelism between the recording head and the reproducing head is kept constant, and there is no worry of sound quality degradation due to azimuth deviation or crosstalk.Closed loop dual capstan system is adopted for the mechanism part.In this system, a pair of capstan and pinch rollers are arranged on the left and right sides of the head block, and two flywheels directly connected to the capstan are driven by an elastic belt. This ensures that the tape tension between the capstan and the capstan is kept constant at all times, resulting in excellent head touch.By suppressing tape vibration, modulation noise is also prevented.The drive system uses a 2-motor system, with an electronically controlled DC motor with built-in generator for constant speed operation and a DC torque motor for fast forward operation.Equipped with an ATLC mechanism that automatically removes tape slack when the cassette is mounted.Equipped with a Dolby REC calibration knob, the optimum Dolby level can be obtained by matching the level of the test signal (400 Hz) oscillated by the oscillator with the level of the signal recorded and played back on the tape with the Dolby REC calibration knob taking full advantage of the 3-head.Equipped with a tape selector with bias and 3-stage equalizer tape selector that employs an automatic CrO2 position switching mechanism.The CrO2 position tape automatically switches between the bias and equalizer by simply attaching it to the tape. name: Pioneer
description: "A stereo cassette deck with no vibration and no resonance by making full use of advanced analysis technology, and with high sound quality by introducing Pioneer's original technology.The NEW Z mechanism has been adopted to improve tape tension fluctuation, tape meander, and running speed fluctuation.First of all, in order to obtain stable tape tension and head touch, we have adopted a resonance dispersion type closed loop dual capstan system in which left and right capstan and pinch roller are used as different diameter.We have also succeeded in reducing head vibration and improving tape running by mounting a head block with a zinc die-cast double structure, in which tilt / height adjustment is precisely performed by an optical jig so that the head can be matched without opposing the natural flow of the tape.In addition, it employs a capstan shaft with sub-micron order polishing accuracy and FS treatment (special processing technology that makes it difficult to slip without losing roundness of 0.1 Ï‰ m or less) on the tape running surface, and a balanced flywheel with a large moment of inertia. Based on the results of the analysis, we are refining our vibration-free and resonance-free design.In order to prevent resonance that occurs at specific parts of the half, it is equipped with special non-repulsion rubber and NEW cassette stabilizer that is effectively damped at high rigidity parts.In addition, it is equipped with a Motor Vibration Insulator (M Ï‰ V Ï‰ I) mechanism to prevent vibration caused by the motor. Honeycomb structures with excellent vibration damping, such as copper-plated honeycomb chassis, large honeycomb insulator, and honeycomb shield case, are used in each part to diffuse vibration in various directions and attenuate it.The bias oscillation frequency quality sound recording, the bias oscillation frequency has been increased to 210 kHz, which is twice the conventional frequency.By setting the frequency difference with the music signal to a large value, the generation of beat and intermodulation noise due to interference between harmonics and bias current is suppressed, enabling recording with less distortion.A direct construction design is provided so that the power supply, control, amplifier, mechanical and FL meter can be connected at the shortest distance. name: Pioneer
description: "This cassette deck has been developed as a new reference model with a wide range system, Dolby S and FLAT SYSTEM.Equipped with a wide-range system that greatly improves the high-pass limit of recording and re-frequency characteristics.This technology focuses on the strong magnetic properties of metal tapes. It is realized by a fine-tuned azimuth head that tunes the azimuth parallelism of the recording and reproducing heads in a three dimensional manner on the order of sub-micron. This head greatly reduces azimuth loss in the high-frequency range, improves the left and right phase characteristics in the high-frequency range, and improves the sense of orientation.In addition, the recording and playback amplifier has also been widened, and the peak of the resonance point of the equalizer has been raised to 30 kHz. This improves the transient response characteristics, gives a sharp rise, and reduces unnecessary ringing at the fall.A newly developed two stage high-speed playback amplifier is used for the playback equalizer amplifier.The first stage employs a low-noise FET differential amplifier first stage, and a high-performance high-speed OP amplifier is used in the second stage to achieve low-noise and wide-band operation.In addition, an A-class operation FET buffer amplifier is used for the output of the recording amplifier to provide a stable current supply that is not affected by the load of the recording head.In order to prevent the deterioration of sound quality caused by the control current flowing into the audio circuit, we have adopted a MOS FET capable of low-current operation in the interface section from the system control to the audio circuit. This eliminates the influence of the control current and realizes high-purity music transmission.In the power supply section, the positive and negative power supply are separated from the winding of the power transformer to the ground pattern, and the signal d in which the positive and negative signals change randomly realizes independent operation.The output impedance within the audible band is less than 0.001 �, reducing noise and improving transient response characteristics.Equipped with Dolby S that reduces noise by up to 24 dB in the high range and up to 10 dB in the low range.In addition, micro-level sound and breathing noise have been greatly reduced.The FLAT SYSTEM is installed in order to take out the performance of the tape by correcting the frequency characteristics of the tape to be flat.The FLAT SYSTEM is designed to adjust the bias and equalizer sensitivity at three points : low-frequency (400 Hz), mid-range (3 kHz), and ultra-high-frequency (15 kHz). A microcomputer with a resolution of 64 steps for bias, 16 steps for mid-range with equalizer, and 32 steps for recording level automatically adjusts the bias and equalizer sensitivity in a short time.In addition, you can make fine adjustments according to your preference by manual operation.Direct construction is used to eliminate transmission loss and noise, greatly shortening the signal path from the input terminal to the recording head and from the playback head to the output.In addition, the input volume is controlled by a long shaft in order to make it close to the input terminal, and the line straight function is equipped to bypass the balance volume, so that transmission loss and noise are reduced thoroughly.It adopts a slant mechanism in which the entire tape transport section is tilted by 10 �, and realizes smooth rotation of a heavy flywheel and elimination of microvibration in the axial direction.In addition, to eliminate vibration and resonance, we have adopted cassette stabilizers, door pockets made of high-density materials, motor vibration insulators that absorb vibration energy by using special reinforced plastic motor brackets and non-resilient rubber between the motor and mechanical chassis, and insulated doors that block external vibration.Equipped with a peak level calibration function, once the peak level of the input signal is held, the microcomputer assists and adjusts the recording volume to recording volume to an appropriate level to eliminate the distortion caused by the input of an excessive signal.The meter range can be switched between -35dB to + 8 dB and -7dB to + 8 dB.Equipped with a last memory function, it can store various FLAT SYSTEM data, Dolby HX PRO, Dolby NR, meter range, switch on/off position, electronic counter numbers, etc.In order to prevent noise from entering the signal system, a midship mount structure with a mechanism placed in the center is adopted.Equipped with a digital tension control that automatically adjusts the tape winding torque.The head uses a laser amorphous head with PC-OCC (single-crystal high-purity oxygen-free copper) winding.The erase head employs a 210 kHz high-bias erase head that reduces the generation of beats and intermodulation distortion due to interference between the high frequency of the music signal and the bias current.In order to respond to broadband, we have adopted carefully selected parts. In addition, the head connector is gold-plated to improve sound quality.In addition, in order to eliminate connection loss, I/O pin jacks and attached pin cords are also gold-plated.Equipped with a CD-DECK sync function, recording is possible in conjunction with a Pioneer CD player with a CD-DECK sync function.Equipped with an SR terminal that enables linkage with Pioneer systems.The chassis and inner chassis are copper plated.Wireless remote control is included."

name: Pioneer
description: "A three head cassette deck equipped with a digital processing system.A digital processing system is used for signal processing inside the deck.In this method, the music signal read by the playback head is converted into a digital music signal, and the subsequent signal processing is done by digital processing with little degradation, thereby suppressing degradation caused by high-frequency correction and level correction.In addition, it is equipped with a Legato link conversion, which is also installed in CD players. It reproduces music signals in the audible band above 20 kHz by estimating them from signals within the audible band and 1/f characteristics, and realizes wide-band playback up to 40 kHz.Digital noise reduction is installed in the digital circuit.In this circuit, the audio frequency band is divided into multiple bands by a digital filter, and the hissing is separated and removed by increasing the level difference between the music signal and noise, thereby achieving an S/N ratio of 90 dB when the Dolby NR is on.This digital noise reduction does not need to be encoded at the time of recording, and is capable of high S/N playback on tapes recorded on other decks or in the past.Equipped with digital FLEX (Frequency Level Expander).This function is used for tapes that are muffled due to degradation of high-frequency sound quality. This function automatically adjusts the high-frequency level to the 1/f characteristic so that even tapes with poor high-frequency characteristics can be played with clear sound.Equipped with a digital XD (Extended Dynamic Range) FLAT System.With this circuit, the recording and playback frequency characteristics can be tuned to a flat level by digital processing with one touch according to the tape to be used. By checking the high-frequency recording characteristics of the tape to be used with a computer and carrying out bias control that is optimal for the tape, higher precision correction capability and a wide dynamic range in the high-frequency range can be obtained.The digital input terminal allows recording from digital devices with an optical output at a sampling frequency of 44.1 kHz. The T-D7 also has a digital input terminal on the front.In addition, it is equipped with a digital sync function so that recording starts automatically when a music signal is input.Equipped with digital ALCA (Auto Level Control with Tape Analysis) function.When recording with digital input, the recording level can be automatically adjusted to the optimum level. The peak and initial recording levels are set based on the bias and sensitivity analysis of the FLAT SYSTEM and the high-frequency and high-level recording capability analysis, and the recording level is set according to the input signal. Thus, even tapes with different characteristics can be recorded at the appropriate recording level.Manual operation is required for analog input.The Z-concept has been adopted to reduce waveform distortion and pursue accurate signal transmission.The T-D7 employs three technologies : a stayable detection based on the Z-concept, an accurate transmission, and a jitter-free conversion.A cassette stabilizer, digital tension servo and, and a wing chassis are used for Stable Detection.The cassette stabilizer is equipped with a special stabilizer of approximately 70g on the receiver side of the main body to effectively hold the cassette half with a soft touch. This reduces the influence of motor rotation vibration, sound pressure, and external vibration, and realizes stable driving and clear sound with less modulation noise.In the Digital Tension Servo, the microcomputer controls the voltage of the reel motor according to the size of the wound diameter of the tape, and the tape is wound at the appropriate tape tension. This improves the wow flutter at the beginning of the winding of the tape, which has tended to be unstable in the past.In the wing chassis, the shape of the bottom plate of the power transformer mounting part and the cassette mechanical mounting part is devised. By effectively releasing vibration to the outside from the insulator, the circuit board is isolated from the rotational vibration of the power transformer and motor.The Accurate Transmission uses a high-speed active servo regulator that consists of a transformer winding dedicated to the amplifier in the amplifier power supply circuit. This high-speed servo stabilizes power supply voltage fluctuations caused by load fluctuations. It can also quickly follow sudden fluctuations in music signals, and record and play back sources with a wide dynamic range more faithfully.The jitter-free conversion employs a switched-capacitor filter in the DAC to attenuate out-of-band noise and improve accuracy due to clock jitter.The Dolby B/C type and Dolby HX-PRO are installed as noise reduction systems.Equipped with power loading / ejection and time counter (elapsed time of recording and re-recording) functions.Equipped with a 4-digit electronic counter and tape remaining time display function.It is equipped with a function to select 15 songs in front and back.It has a headphone port.Equipped with timer recording and replay function.Equipped with an auto tape selector.Equipped with CD-Deck synchro function and REC mute with auto space.Equipped with a last memory function, it records FLAT System data, main switch positions, etc.This allows advanced recording even during timer recording.Wireless remote control is included."

description: "This tape deck achieves high-speed operation at 38cm/s with excellent high-frequency recording and playback characteristics.The transport mechanism has a single chassis with a thickness of 5 mm that reduces the plane accuracy of the reference plane and is firmly fixed with a die-cast frame to improve stability and reliability.In addition, maintenance is improved by mounting the mechanism as a unit for each block.The mechanism uses a 3-motor system.The capstan uses a belt drive with a hysteresis synchronous motor of 4-pole / 8-pole 2-speed type, and a large flywheel with a diameter of 100 mm and a capstan shaft with a roundness of 0.2 Ï‰ or less to improve driving stability and constant speed.A special induction type motor with a 6-pole inner rotor with excellent rotational speed versus torque performance is used to drive the reel table. This motor generates less heat than the eddy current type commonly used for reels and can be used continuously for a long time.The head section has a 3-head configuration to shorten the tape path and improve the stability of tape running.The recording and reproducing heads use a high-pressure-type permalloy head with excellent sensitivity, bias characteristics, and magnetization characteristics. name: Pioneer
description: "A universal player developed as a reference player that brings out the potential of DVD audio to the maximum.For the D/A conversion, a 192 kHz / 24-bit D/A converter developed jointly with Barr Brown is used for all channels. For the two main channels, two 192 kHz / 24-bit D/A converters are used as differential mode to reduce common-mode noise by mutually canceling each other.A digital filter compatible with the 192 kHz high-sampling frequency of DVD audio was jointly developed with NPC and incorporated into the digital filter.In order to achieve high sound quality, it is equipped with a pure audio clock reference function that switches the crystal oscillator according to the sampling frequency of the disc to be reproduced.The crystal oscillator is switched between 44.1 kHz (44.1 kHz, 88.2 kHz, 176.4 kHz) and 48 kHz (48 kHz, 96 kHz, 192 kHz), and the non-selected oscillator is turned off to supply an accurate clock and improve sound quality.It is equipped with a CD Digital Direct function that transmits the CD via the shortest path without going through the DSP section when playing back the CD, preventing signal degradation completely.The power supply section uses an R-core power transformer for audio circuits. In addition, the layout is completely separate from the power supply section so that noise from servo circuits and digital circuits does not interfere with the audio section.The R-core transformer is characterized by low leakage flux, which is a source of noise in the player.High-bit ICs are used for all audio channels. Using a unique algorithm developed from wide-range technology, the smooth waveform of the original sound of digital signals recorded with 16 bits of quantization is estimated and re-quantized to 24 bits.A low-impedance PX capacitor is used in the main unit of the digital section to reproduce clear, flexible, and high sound.In addition, a custom-designed power capacitor with thorough anti-noise measures is installed to eliminate minute noise from the power line.The video off function (Auto/on/off) is used to turn off the power and ground of the video circuit during non-visual source playback. By this function, fine noise generated by the video circuit is eliminated, and high sound quality playback is achieved.In addition, the multi-channel off function automatically cuts the power and ground of the multi-channel circuit when two channels are played back, and the digital out off function automatically cuts the power and ground of the digital out section.A built-in Dolby Digital or DTS sound decoder can process discrete 5.1 ch audio for DVD video.Equipped with a balanced output, a newly developed 192 kHz / 24-bit D/A converter is differentiated into two channels, L and R, to realize a truly balanced output terminal that is resistant to electrical noise.The balance output off function also improves the sound quality of the pin jack.In order to reduce the mutual electrical influence inside the player, each part is completely separated by copper plated steel plate, and the 3BOX-5CHAMBER structure is adopted which houses the main unit of the digital part in the shield case.In order to suppress the influence of external vibration, a 6 mm thick metal plate with excellent rigidity is fixed to the chassis base to form a weight-class stable underbase. In addition, a 2 mm thick top plate is adopted and a metal inside plate is adopted inside.In addition, solid brass is used for the insulator to prevent external vibration from the installation base.By adopting an acoustic damper tray and double air-lock shield door in the transport section, high-precision signal reading and reduction of leakage of operation sound are realized.In addition, a large disk clamper is installed for high sound and image quality, and operation with less jitter is realized.It uses a high-precision 2-wavelength twin focus pickup that automatically switches the laser light.This makes it compatible with DVD audio discs, as well as other recordable media and CD-Rs.It also supports SACD playback, converting a 2.8 MHz DSD signal into a multi-bit signal with a high-precision digitization filter and D/A converting it.In this configuration, the circuit blocks of DVD audio are shared as much as possible, and the configuration is simple. In addition, by processing everything in the digital stage, mutual interference of signals is suppressed and high sound quality is achieved.Video film is usually 24 frames per second, and DVD-Video movie software is 24 frames per second, which is the same as this movie film. Information on all 525 scanning lines is written on one screen and stored on a disc.In order to reproduce this progressive system image, it is equipped with 2-3 pull-down system ""Pure Cinema Progressive Scan Circuit"".For film materials such as motion picture software, frames are inserted into the original source based on 2-3 processing information in the telecine process to realize more natural and film-like progressive images. For video materials, ""motion adaptive complementary processing"" based on a unique algorithm realizes high-resolution and smooth images that cannot be achieved with conventional processing (when using a progressive scan compatible display).The VQE3 video quality enhancer, designed by Pioneer, is used to realize high-precision and high-performance video signal processing.Equipped with newly developed component component frame DNR / PRO. For discriminating between video signals and noise, appropriate parameters are set for each of the three signals of luminance [Y], color difference [Cb], and [Cr], which constitute the video, and noise is detected with high precision.The video digital signal read from the disc is processed by a fine-focus digital filter built into the new video quality enhancer VQE3. By upsampling the 4 : 2 : 2 video signal recorded on the disc to a 4 : 4 : 4 signal with high precision, the resolution of the video signal is increased and noise is suppressed.In addition to the existing ""YNR"", ""CNR"" and ""Detail"" functions, new parameters such as ""Progressive Motion"" and ""White Level"" are incorporated into the image quality adjustment function.It stores the image quality settings for 15 DVD discs in flash memory and automatically recalls the settings the next time the disc is played. It also features a 15-step forward / reverse trick play that includes smooth reverse playback at the same speed, a new GUI, program memory & auto program play, resume function and quick start mechanism.It comes with a multi-dial that integrates scanning, multi-speed, and jog operations during playback into one, and a remote control that realizes one hand operation by concentrating the joystick that is the key for GUI operation on the upper part of the remote control.In addition, the basic operation buttons have a self-illumination function, making it easier to use in rooms with reduced lighting."

name: Pioneer
description: "This is a CD player that inherits the high sound quality technology of the PD 3000 and further improves sound quality by thoroughly simplifying it.In order to minimize the power loss and prevent the influence of others, CD direct construction is adopted, and the layout is simple and straight along the signal flow from the pickup to the lineout.First of all, the printed circuit boards for digital / servo and analog circuits are separated independently. Moreover, with low impedance grounding, the sealed PCB (double-sided board), which provides an effective shielding effect against jumping from digital to analog, is used for digital, analog, and power supply. In addition, the analog board is designed to be as short as possible from input to output. At the same time, the symmetrical structure for left and right independence is adopted.This CD direct construction reduces the interference between signals.In the power supply circuit, the transmission path is minimized and the � power supply is parallelized. The power supply board is directly connected to the power supply line of the analog board.The digital filter uses a 20-bit operation 18-bit output digital filter.The sampling frequency of 44.1 kHz is increased eight times to 352.8 kHz, and a Butterworth third order low-pass filter with excellent phase characteristics and frequency ripple is used in the analog stage.The D/A converter employs a real 18-bit D/A converter with independent configuration on the left and right sides. It performs 18-bit operation at all levels from large input to Oire power, eliminating interference and phase shift between channels.We have also adopted a linear envelope system (glitch less type), a unique technology of Pioneer, to improve the accuracy of D/A conversion and reduce 0 cross distortion by correcting the upper bit error to an appropriate value.In addition, by double and triple D/A conversion accuracy support such as exclusive winding for D/A converter, exclusive power supply, low impedance guard link, etc., minute level reproducibility is improved.The pickup is equipped with a clean laser pickup developed in-house by Pioneer.By reducing the number of optical components such as collimator lenses, the power loss of the optical system has been greatly reduced. Moreover, the aberration in the optical path has been reduced, making possible a clean and low-distortion pickup.In addition, by adopting a photodetector with a built-in I/V conversion head amplifier that amplifies small signals of several microamperes to approximately 200 mV, in combination with an Accu-Focus system, the occurrence of jitter due to reading errors and disturbance is suppressed.In addition, an engineering plastic pick-up body developed by dividing the pick-up body into approximately 1000 elements and repeating strength analysis has been adopted, enabling precise shape that was difficult with conventional die casting.An A-class push-pull FET buffer amplifier is used for two stages, the lineout of the analog stage and the I/V amplifier stage, enabling more accurate waveform transmission without being affected by the connected load.We have developed and installed a multi-resonance absorber (MRA), which is a vibration-free and vibration-free technology for dealing with unnecessary vibration frequencies over all bands from vibration isolation of pickup handling at minute levels to vibration isolation of PCB (double-sided substrate).As the second base after the honeycomb chassis, a float base was newly installed, and unnecessary vibration is suppressed by floating the circuit board and the pickup.The pickup uses a magnetic disk stabilizer that reduces unnecessary vibration of the disk.In addition, the newly developed linear motor servo mechanism, which generates less vibration, has a low center of gravity structure, and is firmly supported by a name: Pioneer
description: "A reference model CD player developed under the technical concept of Real Transmission Design with the theme of ""expressive power of music"".It is equipped with an 18-bit 4 x oversampling digital filter. By calculating the sampling frequency and performing 4 x oversampling, unnecessary high-order noise is moved to the high-frequency range. It is removed with a low-order discrete analog low-pass filter with slow characteristics.As a result, excellent phase characteristics and low distortion audio characteristics are obtained.The D/A converter is equipped with a real 18-bit twin D/A converter. By increasing the quantization level from 16 bits to 18 bits, we have succeeded in reducing quantization noise to 1/4.It is equipped with the Accu-Focus system, the pickup technology used in the Laser Vision Player LD-S1.The photodetector is divided into four parts for focus servo control. The laser beam that hits the photodetector moves across the photodetector along the direction of the pit travel, causing a time lag between the leading signal and the trailing Yukinobu, resulting in a phase difference in the high-frequency range.The AcFOCUS system delays the preceding signal and matches the phase with the following signal to obtain an RF signal with less reading errors.Newly developed pickup is mounted on the pickup part.By using a high-magnification (7.5 times) finite objective lens without the need for a collimator lens as in the past, we have achieved a stable optical path with a margin in the optical path length. In addition, by increasing the thickness of the half mirror as much as possible and designing the angle of incidence as large as possible, we minimize distortion caused by external forces, reduce harmful aberrations in the optical path, and improve the quality of the optical signal.The latest IC technology is also applied to the photodetector, and the buffer amplifier is integrated in the same IC to realize a signal system that is stable against disturbances. In addition, analysis technology using a large computer is utilized to mold the pickup body with resin to reduce the use of adhesive, which reduces reliability.The power supply section uses a twin power transformer that completely separates the servo / digital power supply and the audio power supply from the transformer itself. In addition, the OFC extra-thick 4-core power cord that separates the core wire from the base of the power plug reduces the subtle influence (wraparound) from the servo circuit and the digital circuit to the audio circuit. In addition, the audio transformer uses OFC bifilar winding and silica sand resin impregnation that suppresses vibration.For audio circuits, we have adopted a discrete push-pull power supply circuit that uses high-precision components such as constant current diodes to stabilize the power supply and suppress fluctuations in the power supply voltage. In addition, we have adopted a remote sensing method that detects changes in the voltage at the load end, feeds back the voltage, and controls the voltage, greatly reducing the effect of pattern impedance from the power supply circuit to the load end.The audio circuit uses a large circuit board of 140x300mm, on which parts are arranged in an appropriate pattern layout independently and symmetrically on the left and right sides.In addition, a double-sided circuit board is used to enhance the shielding effect, and the structure is completely separated from the servo system circuit to eliminate mutual interference.An A-class FET buffer amplifier is used in the analog circuit to realize stable waveform transmission that is not affected by load fluctuation of the power supply, mutual interference of each circuit, load of the pre-stage and post-stage amplifier.The conventional digital signal circuit had separate clock circuits for the decoder, D/A converter, and system control microcomputer. However, in the PD 3000, the D/A converter, digital filter, decoder, and system control microcomputer are synchronized by the clock. This prevents the generation of beats due to interference of multiple clocks.In order to protect the pickup from unnecessary vibration, non-resonance lamisert mechanical base is adopted.The mechanical base supporting the pickup is made into a double structure, copper plating is applied to the base of the pickup side, and it is molded with special resin. This greatly improves the vibration damping characteristics, and at the same time eliminates the effect of magnetic strain.In order to eliminate as much as possible the effects of unnecessary intermittent vibration and flux generated by the power transformer, an isolated transformer base is set outside the player.Ultra thick aluminum angle and solid brass insulator are adopted, and the transformer block is floating structure.The chassis has a honeycomb shape that greatly increases rigidity. The 1.2 mm thick steel plate provides excellent vibration damping characteristics. The entire chassis is plated with copper to achieve the same effect as two metals bonded together with copper plating, greatly reducing unnecessary vibration and magnetostriction.Pioneer's vibration analysis technology vibration analysis technology, we have developed a disc stabilizer to improve sound quality by suppressing disc resonance. In particular, the PD-3000 uses a vertical clamp structure to further improve disc mounting accuracy, and a magnet catch system without mechanical contact between the disc stabilizer and the clamper that supports it to completely suppress unnecessary disc vibration.In order to protect the optical system mechanism from external vibration, it is floated from the chassis. It uses a low center of gravity coaxial suspension made of special rubber and spring with excellent damping characteristics. It is fixed by ceramic support columns with high rigidity and high internal loss.A large insulator with high vibration damping characteristics is used for the insulator, and the honeycomb shape is molded with resin to increase rigidity.The analog output terminal uses independent gold plated pin jacks on the left and right to minimize contact resistance and provide mechanical strength as well as the effect of the gold-plated terminal that is resistant to aging.We also use high-grade components for audio, such as resistors and capacitors, for repeated trial listening.The pickup is driven by a linear motor system with excellent response speed.In addition, the spindle motor is equipped with a high-torque brushless D. D. motor with three times the starting torque of conventional motors.The tray section is made of special resin with high specific gravity to improve weight and accuracy. At the same time, the sliding section is made of metal bearing metal, combined with the wire drive system to realize smooth and quiet loading operation.Built-in functions include a memory backup function that stores the program when the power was turned off last time, a time fade edit function that automatically fades out according to the tape time, a music window that automatically plays specified phrases in and out, a one touch fade function, variable fade time, and auto space.Equipped with a changeover switch that stops the operation of unused circuits, it can cut off noise sources from unused circuits. In addition, the headphone circuit operates only when it is plugged into a jack. In addition, an FL off switch is also equipped to prevent scanning noise when the FL indicator is turned on."

name: Pioneer
description: "A reference CD player developed by combining Pioneer's proprietary laser and digital technology, servo technology, and non-resonance technology.Equipped with 8 fs real 18 bit direct linear conversion.First, the 8 x oversampling digital filter uses a high-precision LSI with an operation word length of 20x22bit to improve the calculation accuracy. In addition to obtaining high-precision data, the sampling frequency is shifted up 8 times to 352.8 kHz, increasing the density of quantized data and reducing the load on the analog filter.In addition, the D/A converter uses the handpicked Pioneer Super Version of the one package real 18 bitLSI one package real 18, especially with regard to linearity and low-level distortion.In addition, by using the linear envelope method to adjust each bit to an appropriate value one by one, high-precision D/A conversion is achieved by converting not only MSB, which has a high importance of pit errors, but also 2 sb, 3 sb, and 4 sb to minimize errors.This greatly reduces the distortion caused by 0 cross distortion and bit error.In order to minimize the signal path, a CD direct conversion is adopted, and the signal path from the pickup to the output terminal is minimized and each circuit block is arranged properly.For this reason, the main circuit is laid out at the shortest distance along the signal flow, such as by placing the optical system mechanism in the center. Moreover, the wiring materials are also made as short as possible to minimize exposure.In order to make CD direct construction more thorough and effective, digital and servo, analog circuit board and power circuit board are separated independently. Moreover, analog circuit board adopts full monoconstruction of Lch and Rch from the digital data stage in pursuit of homogeneity of Lch and Rch, reducing interference between signals.In addition, it uses a sealed PCB (double-sided substrate) that achieves low impedance grounding and provides effective shielding against digital noise. In addition, low-impedance 70 Ï‰ m ultra-thick OFC (oxygen-free copper) substrates are used for Lch/Rch analog substrates and power supply substrates.The pickup is equipped with an in-house developed clean laser pickup with improved laser efficiency.By reducing the number of optical components such as the collimator lens, the power loss of the optical system is greatly reduced compared with conventional pickups, and the aberration in the optical path is also reduced, enabling more accurate signal pickup.A built-in I/V in I/V conversion head amplifier. The laser beam that bounces off the pit surface is converted into an electric signal of several microamperes by the photodetector. In the clean laser pickup, the photodetector has a built-in I/V amplifier and is amplified to approximately 200 mv order, so that a signal resistant to disturbance noise can be sent out.In order to obtain highly accurate RF signals from pit signals, we have adopted an Accu-Focus system.When a four part photodetector for focus servo receives a laser beam, a phase difference occurs due to the time difference between the preceding signal and the following signal, causing a disturbance in the synthesized RF signal. In the Accu-Focus system, a delay circuit delays the preceding signal to match the phase with the following signal.As a result, a high-output RF signal with few read errors can be obtained.The power transformer is a twin power transformer configuration in which analog circuits and digital / servo circuits are completely separated to prevent mutual interference between analog and digital / servo circuits.In particular, we have adopted bifilar twist windings made of OFC wire for the windings of transformers for audio circuits, increasing the balance of � voltage and output impedance of the power supply to the level of � 2 transformer system, and improving driving performance in the low-frequency range.In addition, a 4-core OFC cord is used for the power cord, and the analog circuit and digital / servo circuit are independent from the power plug to prevent the inflow of digital noise from the power supply.Moreover, to prevent vibration and induction noise generated by the power transformer from being transmitted to the main body, the transformer is mounted on an isorated base, which is an extremely thick aluminum angle separated from the main chassis. Moreover, the isorated base floats with the main body and is supported by special brass legs.The power supply unit uses a push-pull power supply system.Current control elements are installed in parallel so that the power supply voltage can be stabilized by controlling the current control elements when the load current suddenly changes. In addition, high stability is achieved by increasing the number of discrete components and introducing high-quality sound devices. This suppresses fluctuations in the power supply voltage and improves the transient response characteristics. In addition to realizing low impedance, the harmonic distortion of the power supply is also kept low.In addition, a 2-transformer, 4-part, 19-regulator, low-impedance 70 Ï‰ m ultra-thick OFC (oxygen-free copper) substrate is used to prevent interference between blocks.A class A operation FET buffer amplifier is used in all stages after the D/A converter. By reducing the load of each stage and reducing the output impedance of the amplifier as a whole, the analog section is not affected by capacitance components such as low-pass filters which become the load of the amplifier.By using Class-A operation, fluctuation of power consumption during operation can be reduced, and low distortion factor is realized.The spindle motor of the disk drive mechanism is equipped with a high-torque coreless D. D. spindle motor with a starting torque of 65g/cm. In addition, the spindle diameter is extremely large (4.5 mm), making it resistant to load fluctuations and providing stable disk drive performance.In addition, a high-speed linear motor with fast tracking response is used for the pickup drive to realize accurate tracing and high-speed access with an average of 0.5 seconds or less.Taking note of the adverse effect of disc resonance on sound quality, we have adopted a vertical clamp type disc stabilizer that improves mounting accuracy with the disc.In addition, it employs a magnet catch system without mechanical contact between the stabilizer and clamper, which thoroughly reduces unnecessary vibration of the disk and ensures smooth rotation.Lamisert mechanical base is adopted as the mechanical base supporting the optical mechanism.This is made by molding two sheets of steel plate with special resin. Furthermore, by plating the steel plate on the pickup side with copper, vibration damping characteristics are improved and the influence of magnetic strain is eliminated.Also, this mechanical base is fixed to a ceramic support called ceramic mechanical support via a coaxial suspension, which is a special rubber and spring integrated coaxially, and blocks vibration from the chassis.The chassis uses a copper-plated hybrid honeycomb chassis, an evolution of the honeycomb chassis.First, the honeycomb chassis is plated with copper to achieve excellent vibration control and reduced magnetic distortion. In addition, superfine pile is electrostatically implanted on the floor side of the honeycomb chassis to suppress high-frequency reflection from the floor and minute vibration on the chassis surface. This enables total control from unwanted vibration with large amplitude to minute vibration.Large-size honeycomb insulators made of special resin molded into a honeycomb shape are used as insulators.It is equipped with a clean microcomputer that starts scanning only when the operation key is pressed to reduce noise. In addition, it is also equipped with a display-off switch that turns off the display when it is not necessary, paying attention to the slight scanning noise that occurs when the display turns on.In addition, it is equipped with a digital analogout change-over switch that stops the operation of unused circuits and prevents noise contamination.The front panel uses a lacquer style panel made of extra-thick extruded aluminum material.It is equipped with 2 systems of digital out which is coaxial with light.It is equipped with a time location function that can locate in units of 1 second in a stop state."

name: Pioneer
description: "Equipped with digital filters and other devices, this CD player pursues even higher sound quality.In order to prevent signal reading errors and disc vibration that adversely affects audio circuits, we have adopted a ball alignment mechanism and disc stabilizer with improved performance with new materials.The chassis is structurally reinforced with honeycomb ribs and copper-plated to reduce magnetic strain.In addition, by forming a structure like two metals bonded together by plating, resonance points can be dispersed, and excellent vibration damping characteristics are realized.The audio circuit uses a 2 x over-sampling digital filter and does not use a low-pass filter with steep characteristics. name: Pioneer
description: "In addition to the basic performance inherited from high-end machines, this CD player features unique to CD players.The digital filter uses a 4 x oversampling digital filter.By digital processing, the signal sampled at a sampling frequency of 44.1 kHz is raised to 176.4 kHz by a factor of four, and unwanted folded noise around 44.1 kHz is removed. This allows the use of a low-pass filter with a loose characteristic, and realizes low-distortion audio characteristics with little phase rotation up to high frequencies.The D/A converter uses a glitch less type twin D/A converter.This eliminates the need for a deglitch circuit and enables a simple circuit configuration. Moreover, by adopting a twin configuration in which the left and right signals are independent, channel separation and phase shift in the high frequency range of the left and right signals are improved.When a pit signal is read by a laser beam, the phase difference between the four photodetectors is eliminated and a high-output RF signal can be obtained by using an Accu-focus system.The shape and characteristics of the pickup body have been improved through repeated analysis of polymer materials using a large computer and implementation simulation.In addition, the photodetector part has been improved, and six buffer amplifiers are built in to greatly reduce the influence of external noise and improve S/N.In addition to the servo, digital and audio systems, and FL display systems, the power supply uses a bifilar transformer with a separate winding for the D/A converter to prevent mutual interference.It adopts a floating structure in which the optical system mechanism is lifted from the chassis.In addition, we have developed a ballast base that reduces unstable lateral vibration by lowering the center of gravity of the mechanical chassis below the support part of the mechanism, and by fixing it on a ceramic mechanical support with excellent vibration damping characteristics, we have achieved stable signal reading.In order to reduce unnecessary vibration of the disk, Pioneer has further improved its original disc stabilizer and adopted a magnet clamp that enables the disc stabilizer and disc table to be firmly fixed by the attraction force of a magnet.This new mechanism allows the disc to rotate without contact between the stabilizer and the clamper arm supporting the stabilizer. This greatly reduces the vibration generated during disc rotation.The chassis uses a honeycomb chassis with structural strength increased by honeycomb ribs. In addition, copper plating is applied to reduce unnecessary vibration and magnetic strain.It is equipped with an auto program edit function that allows the microcomputer to determine the maximum number of songs that can be played in full within a given time by indicating the number of songs that you want to start listening to and the time of the tape to be used, and automatically programs the music.In addition, it is equipped with a time fade edit function which is an advanced version of auto program edit. When you specify the desired time, it automatically fades out and enters a pause state.Equipped with a music window function, you can take out your favorite phrases or only the parts you need from a song and play it continuously by connecting up to 8 phrases. The seam fades in and out.Equipped with one touch fade function.We have developed and adopted a digital attenuator IC for volume control.It has a digital level control function that can adjust the volume with a remote control.Equipped with a power on start function that enables timer start."

name: Pioneer
description: "A CD player developed by inheriting the technical ideas of PD 3000.The PD 8070 uses a core material that has more than three times the required capacity of 15 va for the transformer, and the power supply section is reinforced so that it can provide a stable power supply without affecting parts such as servo systems and audio systems.In addition, the audio and D/A sections are equipped with bifilar twist transformers to increase the output voltage balance and reduce noise, vibration and stray capacitance. The core structure is also a large laminate wrap structure to reduce magnetostriction, vibration and leakage flux.The audio circuit is equipped with a discrete push-pull power supply that has excellent transient response characteristics to load fluctuations.The digital filter is equipped with a 4 x oversampling digital filter.The digital signal sampled at a sampling frequency of 44.1 kHz is raised four times to 176.4 kHz and high-order sampling noise is moved out of the audible band. As a result, the analog filter of the next stage can be used with gentle characteristics, and audio characteristics with low distortion factor are obtained over the entire band.The D/A converter uses a Glitchless 16-bit twin D/A converter that performs D/A conversion by Dynamic Element Matching (DEM) method and eliminates glitch noise.This simplifies the circuit structure for higher sound quality and improves channel separation and S/N ratio by making the left and right independent twin structure.Similar to the PD 3000, it uses an Accu-Focus system that improves the accuracy of the RF circuit that converts laser light into electrical signals.The pickup section is equipped with a newly developed pickup developed by analyzing polymer materials using a large computer and analyzing technology such as mounting simulation.In addition to the highly reliable pick-up body, the photodetector unit integrates six small buffer amplifiers into one chip to realize a stable signal form against disturbance and enable accurate signal reading.It adopts a floating structure in which the optical system mechanism is lifted from the chassis.In addition, we have developed a ballast and base that reduce the occurrence of unstable lateral vibration by lowering the center of gravity of the mechanical chassis from the support part of the mechanism, and fix it on a ceramic mechanical support with excellent vibration damping characteristics.As a result, the stability of the optical system mechanical part is increased, and the structure is resistant to both external and internal vibrations.We have further improved our original disk stabilizer to prevent unnecessary vibration of the disk, and adopted a magnet clamp type that can fix the disk stabilizer and disk table with the attraction force of a magnet.This new mechanism allows the disk to rotate without contact between the stabilizer and the clamper arm supporting the stabilizer. It greatly reduces vibration generated during disk rotation and effectively blocks the path through which unwanted vibration is transmitted to the pickup.The chassis uses a honeycomb chassis with structural strength increased by honeycomb ribs, and in addition, by copper plating treatment, magnetic strain is greatly reduced.In addition, since it is in the same state as when two metals are bonded by plating treatment, resonance points can be dispersed, and excellent vibration damping characteristics are obtained.An insulator molded into a honeycomb shape is used for the insulator, which efficiently absorbs external efficiently absorbed.It is equipped with a change-over switch that stops the operation of the circuit that is not being used. name: Pioneer
description: "A CD player that embodies the concept of pure transmission by introducing advanced technologies.A disk stabilizer is used to reduce unnecessary vibration of the disk.The pickup uses aspherical objective lenses and compound lenses to reduce transmission loss of laser power.In addition, the drive unit adopts a focus parallel drive mechanism and cross parallel suspension system to obtain accurate and highly sensitive focus and trace performance.By holding these optical mechanisms in the precision die-cast body, it is resistant to disturbance.A linear servo system is used to prevent sound skipping caused by scratches or dirt on the disc.Taking advantage of the advantages of the 3-beam tracking system, we control the servo amount appropriately so that the leading beam detects scratches and dirt that are different from those of the pit train at the front, and the pickup does not follow the scratches and cause track jump.It employs a method that synchronizes digital signal processing by multiple LSIs with one master clock.This prevents jitter components from being included in digital signals and beats from occurring between signals, minimizing the influence on servo circuits and audio circuits.The audio circuit employs a digital filter, eliminating the need to use a low-pass filter with steep characteristics. As a result, low-distortion characteristics with little phase rotation are obtained up to the high frequency band of 20 kHz.We have adopted a pure transmission system to achieve higher purity transmission.The digital circuit is clearly separated from the analog circuit, and the digital part reduces unnecessary vibration of the disk due to the disk stabilizer and eliminates the adverse effect of external noise on the digital signal.In the audio section, a low-noise low-output impedance regulator is placed close to the audio circuit on the PCB to supply each block circuit with reduced impedance rise.In addition, the use of IC common to L and R is eliminated, and L and R symmetrical straight pattern is adopted.In order to produce stable sound, an insulator with high rigidity and high vibration damping rate is adopted.In addition, the optical mechanism, which avoids vibration, is made into a floating structure, and audio insulation is adopted to reduce external vibration.The power supply for servo, digital and audio systems is a twin power transformer that is completely separated from the transformer itself.This reduces the influence of the servo and digital circuits on the audio circuit.In addition, high-purity OFC windings are used in the Orient Core material for power transformers for audio circuits, and OFC wires are used for the drawers.We use carefully selected parts for high-purity transmission.Glass case electrolytic capacitor, OFC power cord, fast recovery diode, copper-foil styrene capacitor, FOC connection code (gold-plated plug), brass cap carbon resistor, etc. are used. In addition, OFC lead wire and OFC bus bar are used for audio circuit.In particular, all resistors used for audio circuits are within a tolerance of 1%. In combination with carefully selected operational amplifiers, all adjustable semi-fixed volumes are eliminated.Equipped with functions such as pause program function, program adjustment time display, track display, 10-key program function, repeat all songs / program / one song, index search, 3-speed manual search, etc.It uses a headphone port with volume.Subcode output terminal is mounted."

Mio system mechanism.This system was developed with the aim of good operability. When the front panel is opened, four Lorin Dreyfuss G.R.C. Mio (each can hold 25 sheets) appear first. Then, when you press the eject button of the Lorin Dreyfuss G.R.C. Mio you want to open, the Lorin Dreyfuss G.R.C. Mio comes forward. description: "A file-type CD player with a roulette rack system that can store 301 CDs.The newly developed roulette rack system accommodates 301 sheets of 12 cm CD in a 420mmx433mm composite size.You can call up and play the disc you want to listen to by pressing the jog dial or the numeric keypad. name: Pioneer
description: "This is the first generation CD player using the turntable system.It uses a CD turntable system developed from a disk stabilizer.By installing the pickup and spindle motor on the upper part of the disc, it is possible to support the disc from the bottom to the entire surface of the turntable just like an analog player.As a result, the moment of inertia of the turntable has been improved to about three times that of the conventional one, and it is resistant to external vibration, sound pressure, warped disks, etc., so that unnecessary vibration of the disk can be suppressed.The D/A converter is equipped with an 8 fs digital filter and a left-right independent bit stream D/A converter.In principle, this D/A converter is free from non-linear distortion or 0 cross distortion caused by resistor error or operation timing difference like the multi-bit system. Moreover, the effect of the noise shaper is kept low by over-sampling as high as 192 fs based on the third order noise shaper.In the 1-bit system, all operations are controlled by the system clock, and jitter in the system clock affects performance. By laying out main circuits simply and straight along the signal flow, the shortest signal path is realized.In addition to the center tray design with the pick-up mechanism in the center, the digital / servo and audio circuit boards are separated to prevent interference in each circuit. The analog circuit board is also connected from the input terminal to the output terminal by the shortest distance, making it symmetrical.This eliminates interference between circuits and noise caused by the routing of wiring materials.The pickup uses a clean laser pickup developed in-house, reducing power loss in the optical system by reducing the number of optical components such as collimator lenses, and reducing aberrations in the optical path, making it possible to pick up signals with less distortion.In addition, an engineering plastic body is used for the body, and by dividing the pickup body into approximately 1000 elements and performing strength analysis, a high-precision and precise shape is realized.In addition, the photodetector has a built-in I/V conversion head amplifier that amplifies the signal to the order of approximately 200 mV, enabling transmission that is resistant to disturbance noise.The audio circuit uses a class-A FET buffer amplifier to reduce the output impedance and the influence of the load of the connected amplifier.In addition, Class-A operation reduces fluctuations in power consumption during operation and realizes stable waveform transmission.A high-precision four section photodetector generates a phase difference between the leading signal and the trailing Yukinobu signal when it receives laser light. To solve this problem, we have adopted an Accu-Focus system. By delaying the leading signal with a delay circuit and matching it with the trailing signal, we can obtain an RF-signal with less reading error.The spindle motor is equipped with a brushless Hall motor with a starting torque of 65g Ï‰ cm. Each of these mounts has a flow and structure to prevent external vibration from the chassis.A newly developed multi-layered honeycomb chassis has been adopted.It is based on a honeycomb chassis made of BMC (Bulk Molding Compound) with high internal loss and high rigidity. It is layered with steel plate and cushion material with excellent electromagnetic shielding. It reduces unnecessary vibration by excellent vibration control effect and reduces the reflection of sound from the floor.The fifth insulator is installed in the center of the chassis to provide vibration resistance and weight balance, and to support the center mechanism.The power supply is equipped with twin power transformers for digital / servo circuits and analog circuits.In addition, a bifilar winding is used in the transformer for the audio circuit to increase the balance of output impedance and inductance so that the power supply on the + side and the power supply on the - side can be supplied under the same conditions, improving transparency and driving feeling in low frequency range.The power supply circuit employs a 4-part 11-regulator, which independently rectifies four parts of servo / digital, servo drive and audio + and - to eliminate mutual interference.It is equipped with a clean microcomputer that operates only when the operation key is pressed, and it cancels the scanning noise.Equipped with a digital / analog logout selection switch.A display off switch is installed to prevent scanning noise when the display is turned on."

name: Pioneer
description: "This CD player was the first to adopt a unique turntable system based on the concept of no vibration and no resonance disc developed in the development of disc stabilizers.In the CD turntable system, a pickup and a spindle motor are installed on the top of the disc to hold the entire disc from the bottom.
