However, when receiving laser light, a phase difference occurs between the leading signal and the trailing Yukinobu signal, causing a disturbance in the synthesized RF-signal.To solve this problem, we have adopted an Accu-Focus system. By delaying the preceding signal with a delay circuit to match the phase with the following signal, we can obtain an RF signal with less signal reading error.The D/A converter uses an 8 fs digital filter and a left-right independent bit stream 1-bit DAC.New Bit Stream The 1-bit DAC has only one electronic switch and one current source, and the analog quantity is expressed by the on/off of one electronic switch. This eliminates the problem of the error of the resistor and the difference of the operation timing unlike the multi-bit DAC. Therefore, it has excellent linearity and in principle, there is no non-linearity or 0 cross distortion.In addition, while multi-bit DACs express analog signals in terms of vertical amplitude width (pulse height), 1-bit DACs express them in terms of horizontal time axis (coarse and dense waves of pulses), so it is called PDM (Pulse Density Modulation) method. In response to digital data input, pulses are generated at a high speed of tens of thousandths of a second, and analog signal waveforms are converted into coarse and dense waves of pulses.In the 1-bit DAC, noise shaping is performed to reduce requantization noise caused by bit compression. In the PD-T07, over-sampling as high as 192 fs is performed at the pre-stage, and the signal is sent to the third order noise shaper to suppress the influence of out-of-band noise.A system clock as low as 16.93 MHz is used as the system clock necessary to control all operations of the 1-bit DAC to suppress the effect of jitter.Attention is also paid to the application, and an independent oscillation circuit is provided, and anti-vibration and anti-magnetic processing are applied.Lamisert mechanical base is adopted to protect the optical mechanism from vibration from the outside.This is made by molding two sheets of steel plate with special resin, and copper plating is applied to improve vibration damping characteristics and suppress the occurrence of magnetic strain.This mechanical base is mounted on a mechanical chassis via a coaxial suspension with special rubber and springs, and the lower turntable base is also mounted via a coaxial suspension. The float structure prevents external vibration from the chassis.Using direct construction, each circuit block is laid out simply and straight along the signal flow, and the shortest signal path is realized.In addition, the digital / servo and audio circuit boards are separated to prevent mutual interference. In addition, a sealed PCB (double-sided circuit board) is used for the digital and analog circuit boards to provide an advantageous shielding effect against noise jumping from the digital to the analog circuit boards. In addition, the analog circuit boards are also connected at the shortest distance from the input terminal to the output terminal and have a symmetrical configuration.The audio circuit after D/A conversion uses a class-A operation FET buffer amplifier. By reducing the output impedance, the influence of the load of the connected amplifier is reduced. In addition, by using class-A operation, fluctuations in power consumption during operation can be reduced, the influence on other circuits is reduced, and a low distortion factor is realized.The power transformer is a twin power transformer for digital / servo circuits and analog circuits.In addition, the transformer for the audio circuit has a bifilar winding, and by increasing the balance of output impedance and inductance, the + side and - side power supply are supplied under the same condition, contributing to sound quality improvement.In addition, the four parts of servo / digital, servo drive, and audio + and - are independently rectified to eliminate mutual interference. In particular, the audio power supply uses a discrete push-pull power supply to provide a power supply with low output impedance and strong resistance to load fluctuations. In addition, the left and right independent power supplies are used for the DAC. The power supply for the servo drive is separated into one for the turntable and another for other drives. By stabilizing each power supply, the influence of motor and actuator operation is eliminated.Newly developed multi-layer honeycomb chassis is used for the chassis.This chassis is based on a honeycomb chassis made of BMC (Bulk Molding Compound), which has high internal loss and excellent vibration resistance and strength. Steel plates and cushioning materials with excellent electromagnetic shielding are layered to achieve high rigidity and excellent vibration resistance. name: Pioneer

It reduces conversion errors in minute signals and improves linearity.It is equipped with a TOC function that records information such as program time and length of each song at the beginning of the tape.This function enables DAT to manage information such as the total number and time of songs, the song time of each song, the start time of each song, and the remaining time of the recorded part.It is equipped with high-speed AI search and subcode application functions. name: Pioneer
description: "A DAT deck with 96 kHz high sampling and legato link conversion.In order to record and play back high-frequency components exceeding 20 kHz, we have developed a wide-mode for high sampling by increasing the sampling frequency from 48 kHz to 96 kHz, which is twice the conventional frequency. As a result, the recording and playback frequency has reached 44 kHz, which is twice the conventional frequency. To achieve this technology, we have doubled the tape speed, increased the drum rotation speed from 2,000 rpm to 4,000 rpm in wide-mode, and doubled the head amplifier bandwidth from 4.7 MHz to 9.6 MHz.* The ones recorded in the wide mode cannot be played back in the conventional standard SP mode or long-time LP mode, and the playback time in the wide mode is half of that in the SP mode.With Legato Link Conversion for natural over-20kHz music playback even in standard mode.Legato Link Conversion is a technology that brings the frequency components of natural sounds and music closer to the original signal waveform. It performs digital signal processing based on the signal recorded on the tape and connects the data with a smooth function curve, making it possible to reproduce sounds closer to the original before recording on the tape.In addition, by estimating the original signal before recording and reproducing the sound at 20 kHz or higher according to the 1/f attenuation characteristics, more natural sound reproduction is achieved.The A/D converter is equipped with an 18-bit multi-bit converter and a dither circuit to reduce non-linear and 0 cross distortion.The D/A converter is equipped with an originally developed high-speed pulse-flow D/A converter, which operates at an extremely high oversampling of 256 fs for smoother and more natural sound reproduction.The system clock employs a clean clock circuit that supplies audio and digital signals separately. By driving the oscillation itself of the clock that controls the system independently, the SN ratio and distortion factor are improved.The head is equipped with an AT (All Track) head.In order to respond to the high speed head rotation in the wide mode, precision technology has been put into it. It has an AT structure with 20 Ï‰ m uniform track processing in the track trace direction. In addition, glass is welded on both sides of the head to improve abrasion resistance, and special polishing processing is applied to the gap to improve tape touch stability.We have reduced the impact of vibration by using panel stabilizers with rubber vibration isolators to reduce vibration around the front panel, cassette stabilizers to securely hold tapes and prevent sound quality degradation due to vibration, honeycomb chassis to support mechanisms and circuits, large insulators, and hood vibration control structures.It is equipped with a character recording function (character pack) that allows you to record your favorite information such as song title and title. At the beginning of each song (start ID part), you can record up to 60 characters of your favorite information such as song title, performer's name and source title. Data can be recorded either on the remote control or on the main body.The recorded information is scrolled on the display at the start of each song and can be displayed again by pressing the button while the song is playing.It is equipped with a CD-Q code sync start ID recording function. When recording digital input from a CD, the start ID is automatically recorded based on the track number and index in the CD-Q code data transmitted to the D-07 through the digital interface. In addition to the conventional detection of the replacement of each song with two second silence, the start ID can be recorded without any silence between songs.This eliminates the recording error of the start ID due to the fade-in and fade-out portions.It is equipped with a Table of Contents (TOC) function that records information such as the total number of songs and the total time of the tape, the playing time of each song, the starting time of each song, and the remaining amount of recording space at the beginning of the tape.Equipped with digital faders, fade in and fade out functions for digital input recording, playback, analog input recording, and playback.In addition, the operation functions at the time of playback include random play, in which a microcomputer randomly selects and plays music based on TOC information, time skip, in which a desired time is skipped forward or backward from the current position, one point memory, in which the microcomputer memorizes the point on the tape when a button is pressed and plays that point with one touch, and fine cue / review, which is convenient for recording the start ID and tracking.In addition to the standard SP mode, it is equipped with three modes : a wide mode capable of recording and playback in a wide band up to 44 kHz, and a long-time LP mode with a maximum of 4 hours (when using 120 minutes of tape), which is advantageous for air check of satellite broadcasting and FM broadcasting.We use carefully selected parts to respond to the demand for broadband."

name: Pioneer
description: "Based on the D-07, this DAT deck is equipped with Legato link conversion S and further improved sound quality.For recording and playback in the ultra-high-frequency range exceeding 20 kHz, it is equipped with a high-sampling (HS) mode in which the sampling frequency is increased from 48 kHz to 96 kHz, twice that of the conventional one, enabling recording and playback in a wide band up to 44 kHz.The maximum recording time in High Sampling mode is 1/2 of the conventional Standard (SP) mode.It is equipped with Legato link conversion S.In the conventional Legato link conversion, the waveform of the original signal was estimated and reproduced based on the 1/f attenuation characteristic for the component of 20 kHz or higher. However, in the Legato link conversion S, an independent harmonic generation circuit is added for overtones. The overtone component of 20 kHz or higher is generated from the attenuation characteristic based on the estimation of the original sound, and the reproduction band is expanded by adding it together with the time axis.When playing back digital sources such as CDs, it is equipped with a DAC mode that allows you to use only the D/A converter function with the newly developed Legato link conversion S. This mode converts the input digital source into an analog signal with a 20 kHz or higher component and outputs it.An 18-bit multi-bit converter is used on the A/D side, and a dither circuit is incorporated to suppress non-linear distortion and 0 cross distortion.In addition, the D/A side employs a multi-bit DAC that eliminates the generation of 0 cross distortion by a unique method. In this method, two 20-bit DACs with exactly the same characteristics are integrated into one chip, and + and - region waveforms are independently D/A converted. At that time, the conventional 1 LSB level difference is expressed by the presence or absence of 1 LSB compensation current, not by inversion of all bits including MSB. In principle, the generation of 0 cross distortion is eliminated, and reproducibility and linearity of small signals are improved.The head is equipped with a high-output AT head with precision technology for high-speed head rotation in high sampling mode.It is an all track structure with 20 Ï‰ m uniform track processing in the track trace direction. Glass is welded on both sides of the head to ensure high abrasion resistance. In addition, a special polishing process is applied to the gap to realize a stable tape touch.We take thorough anti-vibration and anti-vibration measures, including a panel stabilizer with anti-vibration rubber that suppresses microvibration around the front panel, a cassette stabilizer that securely holds tapes and prevents sound quality deterioration caused by vibration, a honeycomb chassis that supports mechanisms and circuits, and a large insulator and bonnet anti-vibration structure.Copper plating is applied to the chassis, mechanical base, and rear panel to reduce high-frequency impedance and noise.At the beginning of each song (start ID part) is equipped with a character recording function (character pack) that can record up to 60 characters of favorite information such as the name of the song, the name of the performer, and the title of the source.The recorded information is scrolled on the display at the start of each song and can be displayed again by pressing the button during the performance.It is equipped with a CD-Q code sync start ID recording function. When recording digital input from a CD, the start ID is automatically recorded based on the track number and index in the CD-Q code data transmitted by the digital interface. Even if there is no silence between songs, the start ID can be recorded reliably.It is equipped with a Table of Contents (TOC) function that records the number of recorded songs and time data of each song at the beginning of the tape.Equipped with digital faders, fade in and fade out functions for digital input recording / rerecording and analog input recording / rerecording.In addition, the operation functions during playback include random play and time skip using a microcomputer based on TOC information, one point memory which records points on the tape and plays them with one touch, and fine queue / review functions.In addition to the conventional three modes of 96 kHz High Sampling (HS) mode, 48 kHz Standard (SP) mode and 32 kHz Long Time Mode, an additional 44.1 kHz Standard (SP) mode with the same sampling frequency as CD is installed when analog input is used.96 kHz Digital Out in HS mode is also supported.Wireless remote control is included."

name: Pioneer
description: "DAT deck with 1-bit A/D converter and bitstream D/A converter.Newly developed 1-bit A/D converter and bit stream D/A converter (SAA7350) are installed in the conversion part.Compared with the multi-bit method, this 1-bit method does not need to take into consideration problems such as resistor error and operation timing deviation, so it has excellent linearity and is free from non-linear distortion and 0 cross distortion in principle.The same device as that used in the D/A converter PD-T07 is used to reduce conversion errors in the case of small signals and improve linearity.In order to eliminate the fluctuation of the clock signal, which is important for the 1-bit system, we have adopted a clean clock circuit that separates the clock signal from both audio and digital signals.As a result, the oscillation itself of the clock controlling the system is cleared, and by driving independently, high S/N and low distortion are achieved.The head is equipped with a high-power AT (All Track) head developed by Pioneer's original precision technology.The AT head features an AT structure with uniform track processing of 20 Ï‰ m with respect to the track trace direction. Glass is welded on both sides to improve abrasion resistance, and special polishing is applied to the gap which is the signal entrance / exit to realize more stable tape touch.Also, by increasing the reproduction output level by 2 to 6 dB, signal reading with low error rate is realized.It is equipped with LP (long time) mode which realizes twice the recording time of SP (standard) mode for analog input recording and digital input recording with sampling frequency of 32 kHz, and enables continuous recording for up to 4 hours with 120 minute tape.It is equipped with a Table of Contents (TOC) function that records information such as the program time and the length of each song at the beginning of the tape. This function enables DAT to manage information such as the total number and time of songs, the song time of each song, the start time of each song, and the remaining time of the recorded portion.It is equipped with an AI search function of about 300 times at the fastest time (about 600 times at LP time) utilizing the TOC function.As a result, it is equipped with functions such as AI search by TOC information, time skip, one point memory, random play, and fine cue / review.You can display time information such as A-Time, which indicates the time elapsed from the beginning of the tape, P-Time, which indicates the time elapsed from the beginning of each song, and an end mark, which indicates the end of the recording.The mechanism uses a 1.6 mm flat chassis with a specially processed flat structure, reducing unnecessary vibration generated by the mechanism and realizing more stable tape travel.In addition, it is equipped with Pioneer's original cassette stabilizer that suppresses vibration of the cassette half. The cassette half is sandwiched by special rubber at the top and bottom. In addition, the left and right two places are pressed with resin to firmly fix the cassette half and reduce vibration.A large honeycomb insulator with excellent vibration damping characteristics and a honeycomb chassis are used for the chassis.In order to reduce adverse effects caused by unnecessary vibration of the drum, the structure of the rotating drum has been completely revised and a low-vibration and low-noise structure has been adopted.Direct construction is adopted for the input volume, and the signal from the analog input terminal is input to the input volume at the shortest distance, thus reducing degradation due to routing of the signal path."

name: Pioneer
description: "The reference DAT deck reduces mutual interference by adopting a midship mounting mechanism in which each part is independent.The audio circuit board and digital circuit board are separated to the left and right, and the mechanism part is placed in the center to clarify the separation of each unit. The power transformer also uses a twin transformer that supplies energy to the audio and digital circuits independently.This ensures the independence of each unit from power supply to layout, and reduces the mutual interference between circuits.Both the A/D side and D/A side use 1-bit converters, so there is no problem of conversion error due to resistor error, and there is no non-linear distortion or 0 cross distortion in principle.The D/A converter A converter is equipped with twin original high-speed pulse-flow D/A converters that operate with high oversampling of 256 fs and provide finer and smoother output.In order to eliminate the fluctuation of the system clock, which is important for the 1-bit system, the signal processing section and the audio section each have their own clocks. In addition, we have newly developed a Clean Clock II circuit that combines a clock jitter suppressor circuit that captures the data transmitted from the signal processing section to the audio section and the transmission clock with the audio section's own clock, and a lithium tantalate oscillator to improve the sound quality.The head is equipped with a high-output AT head.Based on Pioneer's precision technology, this head adopts an All Track structure with 20 Ï‰ m uniform track processing in the track trace direction. In addition, to improve abrasion resistance, glass is welded to both sides of the head and special polishing processing is applied to the gap to realize stable tape touch.Also, by increasing the reproduction output level by 2 to 6 dB, signal reading with low error rate is made possible.Vibration is reduced by adopting a high-rigidity flat chassis for the mechanism part and by using a resin material with a high vibration isolation effect for the vibration source.In addition, vibration is absorbed by adopting a cassette stabilizer structure in which the cassette half is held from the top and bottom by special rubber and the cassette is held from the left and right by resin to fix the cassette.Information such as the program time of the source and the playing time of each song is recorded in the first position of the source, and it is equipped with a TOC (Table of contents) function in which the source can be enjoyed like a CD.With this function, you can manage the source such as total number of songs and total time of the source, playing time of each song, starting time of each song, remaining time of the recorded part, etc.Since the TOC information is recorded simply by recording the end ID and renumbering the TOC, various operations can be performed by using this TOC function.It is equipped with an AI search function that utilizes the TOC information recorded at the beginning of the tape. It can search at a speed of approximately 300 times (approximately 600 times for LP) at the fastest speed. In addition, even if the tape does not have TOC information recorded on it, the program number is read by running the tape and the position is memorized by the microcomputer, making it possible to perform high-speed searches similar to those based on TOC information.Equipped with digital faders, fade in and fade out function both during digital input recording, analog input recording and playback.In addition, as operation functions during playback, it is equipped with functions such as random play, which selects and plays music at random based on TOC information, time skip, one point memory, fine queue / review, etc.Equipped with LP mode capable of continuous recording / playback for up to 4 hours (when using 120 minutes of tape).It is equipped with a digital meter that displays the recording level as it is after A/D conversion, and accurate level management is possible.A 2mm-thick chassis with high rigidity is used for the bottom panel. In addition, vibration is absorbed by a large insulator, and panel stabilizers with rubber vibration isolators are used to suppress small vibrations around the front panel.High quality is achieved by carefully selecting high-quality sound parts."

name: Pioneer
description: "In addition to the 4fs18bitA / D converter and 8fs20bitD / A converter, a dither circuit is installed on the DAT deck for high sound quality.A 4fs18bitA/D converter for the recording side and an 8fs20bitD/A converter for the playback side were installed for the first time in the DAT for high-precision signal processing.In addition, both the A/D and D/A converters are L/R-independent configuration, eliminating phase shift between channels and preventing distortion and noise.It is equipped with an A/D side dither circuit developed by a unique method applying the dither technology used in professional digital sound recorders.This circuit adds a dither signal outside the audible band to the analog input signal, performs A/D conversion, and then removes the dither signal with a digital filter to enable conversion with excellent linearity. It reproduces a more faithful signal by dispersing and averaging conversion errors caused by 0 cross distortion at a minute level.For high-quality source recording, a line-straight switch is installed.By turning the switch ON, the signal can be input to the A/D converter without passing through the input volume and the 5th low-pass filter. This minimizes the signal path and reduces phase distortion.The audio circuit board uses twin monoconstruction for improved separation. The recording / reproducing and L/R circuit blocks are divided into four sections. The placement of parts and the length and routing of wires are symmetrical to eliminate interference between each circuit block.In addition, the spacing between the input / output pin jacks is taken into consideration in the terminal layout to improve channel separation.In order to achieve high sound quality, the printed circuit board for audio uses double-sided boards made of single-sided solid earth foils to provide shielding effect and greatly reduce noise. In addition, the ground line on the board uses bus bars made of 1 mm thick extra-thick oxygen-free copper plates to reduce the impedance of the ground and improve the rigidity and sound quality.In addition, it is designed with high sound quality to every detail, and selected capacitors and resistors are used.The head is equipped with a high-power AT head developed by integrating Pioneer's original advanced precision processing technology. This head features an AT (All Track) structure with 20 Ï‰ m uniform track processing in the track trace direction.In addition, glass is welded on both sides in order to improve abrasion resistance, and special polishing is applied to the gap which is the entrance of the signal to realize more stable tape touch.Furthermore, by increasing the playback output level by 2 dB to 6 dB, it is possible to read signals with high precision and low error rate.The mechanism uses a highly rigid flat chassis made of 1.6 mm thick material.In order to prevent the generation of strain due to bending process, this steel plate has been specially processed into a flat structure to reduce unnecessary vibration generated by the mechanism.The mechanism and power transformer, which are sources of vibration, are fixed to an isolated chassis independent from the main chassis.In addition, the isolated chassis is grounded with a dedicated zinc die-cast insulator and mechanically separated from the audio unit mounted on the main chassis to eliminate the adverse effects of unwanted vibrations.In order to suppress vibration of the cassette half, Pioneer's original cassette stabilizer is mounted.By sandwiching the cassette half with special rubber at the top and bottom and pressing it with resin at two places on the left and right, the cassette half is firmly fixed and the double anti-vibration structure realizes the stable running of the tape.Large honeycomb insulators and copper-plated honeycomb chassis are used to prevent harmful external vibrations from being transmitted to the mechanism and each circuit.The power transformer uses a large power transformer consisting of a bifilar OFC winding with separate windings for audio and digital circuits. The case is filled with epoxy resin to suppress vibration of the transformer body.Equipped with 2-mode ON/OFF function of FL display which is a source of digital noise.In half-OFF mode, if the display is turned off due to something other than playback or recording, segments other than the pole number display are turned off. In full-OFF mode, if the display is turned off during playback or recording, all segments are turned off.By examining the material and shape of the gear belt, we have adopted a silent mechanism that reduces the operating noise when the tape is running or when the cassette is attached or removed.The quick response mechanism also reduces the amount of time between tape insertion and sound.Equipped with an intelligent peak monitor, you can easily record high quality by simply adjusting the recording level volume to -01dB.The peak margin display shows the amount of dB remaining based on the maximum allowable level (full bit / 00 dB for digital signals), and displays the range from -50dB to 00 dB in 1 dB steps. The over-level display shows the level exceeding the maximum allowable level in 1 dB steps up to + 8 dB. The recording volume attenuation display shows the recording volume attenuation in 1 dB steps from 0 dB to 36 dB.It is equipped with a TOC function that stores the program time and the length of each song in the first position of the tape.With an AI search of approximately 300 times (at the fastest time), more comfortable operation is realized.AI search by program number and AI search by TOC information are available.Wireless remote control is included."

name: Pioneer
description: "Pioneer's first DAT deck.In order to ensure that the input and output waveforms are identical, an oversampling re-independent double digital filter configuration, which was not used even in professional PCM recorders, is employed.By operating the D/A converter at twice the normal sampling frequency on the playback side, the digital filter reduces the load on the analog low-pass filter in the latter stage and improves the frequency characteristics, distortion factor, and group delay characteristics. In the conventional digital filter, only an analog low-pass filter with steep attenuation characteristics was used for A/D conversion during recording, so the distortion and phase delay of the analog filter caused considerable distortion and distortion in the music signal. The D-1000 is equipped with a digital filter on the recording side to achieve low-distortion sound quality with excellent phase characteristics up to the high frequency range.The D/A converter is equipped with an oversampling glitch less D/A converter.In conventional resistive ladder-type D/A converters, it takes time to stabilize the analog output after the digital data is input to the D/A converter due to variations in the response of each switching. As a result, a glitch, a type of noise, occurs in the output.The D-1000 solves this problem by speeding up the operation of the D/A converter and improving the sound quality by realizing a simple signal path that does not go through the digricher by making it glitch less.In addition, the use of independent D/A converters on the left and right sides eliminates the phase difference between the channels.The audio circuit board uses twin monoconstruction.In this configuration, the recording / playback and L/R circuits are divided into four sections, and the arrangement of parts and the length of wires are symmetrical to eliminate interference between each block.In addition, noise is greatly reduced by grounding one side of the audio printed circuit board. In addition, bus bars made of 1 mm thick oxygen-free copper plates are used for power supply lines and ground lines on the circuit board to reduce ground impedance and increase the rigidity of the circuit board.All condensers and resistors are made of high-quality sound components.Metalized polyester film capacitors with non-inductive OFC lead wires are used as coupling capacitors for analog signal paths, and OFC lead wires and gold-plated brass cap mold carbon film resistors are used as signal resistors.In addition, oxygen-free copper wires are used for signal wiring.The slide volume is the same as that used in professional mixing consoles, enabling fine adjustment of recording levels and greatly improving the separation characteristics at high frequencies.A newly developed cassette stabilizer is installed to suppress tape vibration and ensure stable operation.In the cassette stabilizer, vibration is suppressed by sandwiching the cassette half with special resin material from above and below.In order to reduce vibration from the outside, a large solid brass insulator with excellent vibration damping characteristics is adopted.In addition, the insulator is firmly secured to the double chassis with oxygen-free copper washers and copper-screws to eliminate vibration.It uses a copper-plated chassis to greatly reduce magnetic distortion, which adversely affects sound quality, and shields the digital circuit to prevent unwanted interference from the digital circuit, creating a clear separation between the digital and analog circuits.The power supply is composed of 7 independent 2-transformer power supplies that separate the digital and analog systems, eliminating interference from the digital system to the analog system.The analog transformer has a 2-winding power supply configuration that is strong enough to handle large load fluctuations, and oxygen-free copper wires are used for the windings and lead wires. The digital transformer also has a 5-winding power supply configuration that uses oxygen-free copper wires for stable power supply.The circuit board that makes up the entire power supply circuit is made of copper foil with a thickness of 70 Ï‰ m, twice as thick as the normal one, to reduce impedance.Pioneer's original linear skating mechanism is adopted for the deck mechanism part, and combined with high rigidity shaft and linear bearing, excellent quietness and reliability are obtained.In the linear skating mechanism, the deck mechanism is incorporated into the cassette and can be operated while monitoring the tape running condition. In addition, operability is improved by the auto lead-in function, which automatically mounts and skates just by inserting the cassette, and the auto lead-out function, which allows the cassette to be ejected with one touch.The motor section employs a 4 dd mechanism using two drum motors, capstan motors and reel motors. High reliability is achieved by a high-precision digital servo system and a highly stable tension speed control system.Equipped with a peak margin indicator, it is possible to make appropriate adjustments for digital recording that will cause sudden distortion when the level meter exceeds 0 dB (maximum quantization level).Equipped with a digital drive peak meter that displays digital signals directly as bars.By directly driving the meter with a digital signal, it enables accurate level monitoring during recording. The meter is Oatley set with a peak held for approximately 3 seconds.Both digital and analog inputs can monitor extremely accurate recording levels, and the maximum digital signal level can be read even when the signal is emphasized, so there are no recording errors.It is equipped with the easy operation function using subcode which is unique to DAT deck.Equipped with an auto ID recording function, you can automatically record the start ID and program number that indicate the beginning of the track during recording. You can also cancel this function.In addition, the manual ID recording function allows you to set or erase a start ID or skip ID anywhere you want.Equipped with a Oatley number function, you can record by adding to a tape that has been recorded up to a certain part, or automatically organize the number of songs after adding or deleting the start ID manually.Equipped with a program number setting function, you can freely set the program number at the start of recording.It is equipped with one shot direct music selection function, and you can play the desired music just by specifying the program number and pressing play button.Equipped with skip playback function, you can skip unnecessary parts and play (with cancel function)Equipped with a guiding operation function, the microcomputer detects and displays the ID mode and tape status, and by operating according to the display, the ID can be recorded or erased reliably.It is equipped with a blank monitor function so that unrecorded parts can be recognized during playback, fast-forward or rewind.Equipped with an emphasis ON/OFF function.Music signals generally have fewer high-frequency components than low-frequency components, so you can improve the dynamic range and S/N ratio in the high-frequency range by pre-emphasizing the high-frequency components during recording and de-emphasizing the high-frequency components during playback.On the D-1000, you can record by turning the emphasis ON/OFF according to your preference, and playback is automatically switched during playback.Two types of name: Pioneer
description: "An FM/AM stereo tuner equipped with a digital direct decoder TypeII that digitally demodulates the FM signal itself at once and does not generate distortion or noise in principle.The digital direct decoder uses a pulse converter to convert the signal output from the IF section into a digital signal of 1.26 MHz. The digital direct decoder then sends a multiplier for stereo demodulation at once and multiplies it by a 38 kHz subcarrier (sine wave). This is a simple method.Since FM signals are detected and demodulated as digital signals from the pulse converter to stereo demodulation, there is no need for an anti Birdie filter, which has been the cause of signal loss and distortion, and excellent characteristics are obtained by making maximum use of the characteristics of digital signals that do not generate distortion or noise.This D. D. recorder was selected as a monitor by the Swedish National Broadcasting Station due to its excellent characteristics.The F-120D is equipped with a digital direct decoder TypeII, which is a further consideration of the waveform of the digital signal itself.A C-MOS IC is used in the pulse converter that converts FM signals into digital signals, improving the accuracy of the digital waveform itself, and realizing a further constant distortion rate and high SN ratio.The front end uses a linear front end to improve RF intermodulation characteristics. High reception performance is achieved by a high-performance twin varicap and a unique balance hold capacitor system.In addition to high stability achieved by the installation of a balanced mixer, various types of interference rejection capability are also greatly enhanced.In addition, in order to maintain a linear relationship between the frequencies of the antenna tuning stage and the antenna tuning stage and the local oscillator and to suppress the occurrence of distortion.In the IF section, the first stage amplifier uses a Darlington differential IC with a wide dynamic range, high gain, low noise, and high gain and high signal-to-noise ratio.In addition, we have adopted a highly reliable crystal oscillator circuit for the oscillator circuit of the frequency conversion section (1.26 MHz), which is an important section for sending signals to the D. D. Decoder TypeII. In addition to improving stability and SN ratio, we have also reduced drift due to environmental changes such as temperature and humidity.In addition to these features, two stage switching of the IF band is also installed so that high quality can always be obtained according to the difference of reception conditions.In order to make the best use of the high sound quality of D. D. Decoder TypeII, the overall including parts is polished.After the pulse converter, there is no LC filter until the output part, and distortion and sound quality degradation caused by the LC filter are completely eliminated.In addition, we have further improved the semiconductor capacitor for the tuner used in the F-120. By coating the exterior with an epoxy coating, vibration is suppressed and distortion factor is further reduced.In addition, the power supply section has been thoroughly reviewed by installing a large power transformer similar to that of an amplifier, using a oxygen-free copper wire for power supply wiring, and using a power cord with polarity indication.In the low-pass filter section of the final stage, an active filter is used in place of a passive filter using a coil to obtain higher sound quality.The PLL circuit of the quartz synthesizer employs a unique pulse swallow method, and the reference frequency is set at 25 kHz. name: Pioneer
description: "FM/AM tuner with PLL circuit in MPX section.The FM front-end uses a dual-gate MOS FET for the two stage RF amplifier and mixer stage.Since the dual-gate MOS FET with a low noise figure is used, the practical sensitivity is improved, and the interference rejection capability is improved by the tuning circuit using 5 series variable capacitor.The local oscillator circuit of the TX 910 is equipped with a buffer circuit. Even when stations with high electric field strength are adjacent to each other, the buffer circuit works to prevent the lead-in phenomenon.The IF section uses a monolithic IC instead of conventional transistors. The circuit consists of three single-stage differential ICs and one 3-stage differential IC, providing high stability and limiters.In addition, various characteristics have been improved by combining with wide-band ratio detection.The filter element is composed of a ceramic filter (4 pieces of 2 elements) with less phase distortion and sharp selectivity characteristics.This reduces distortion in a wide range within the pass band and improves MPX separation.A PLL circuit is introduced into the MPX section.The MPX demodulation signal obtained by the PLL circuit is a square wave whose phase always matches that of the pilot signal. Therefore, when it is passed through a double-balanced differential demodulation circuit, the leakage of the demodulation signal is canceled out and hardly appears on the output side, and the leak carrier is small even as it is, and the distortion generated during demodulation is minimized.Also, since there is no SCA beat interference, the SCA filter can be omitted, which greatly improves the high-frequency separation.A part of 19 kHz derived from the PLL is used to guide the signal to another phase comparator, which detects the magnitude of the pilot signal and guides the 38 kHz demodulated signal to the demodulation circuit only when the broadcast being received is stereo. When the signal is mono or when the stereo broadcast transmission is too weak for practical use, the circuit is automatically switched to mono and the indicator flashes simultaneously.The ICPA 1310 has a built-in PLL circuit, a double-balanced differential demodulation circuit, an indicator circuit, and auxiliary circuits such as automatic switching.It is equipped with a low-pass filter that cuts the 19 kHz pilot signal and the 38 kHz carrier leak during MPX demodulation. This filter eliminates adverse effects such as beat interference and intermodulation during FM recording.The muting circuit can be switched between two operation levels.The first stage is used to cut out inter-station noise during channel selection, and the second stage is used to receive only strong stations.In order to perform accurate muting operation, MOS IC and IC developed exclusively for muting are adopted. In addition, pop noise is suppressed by double action combining lead relay.It is equipped with a pulse noise suppressor that cuts out the pulse noise caused by Radio noises from automobiles and motorcycles.It detects both AM noise, which occurs when the limiter is receiving a weak station, and FM noise, which cannot be removed by the limiter circuit, and operates in either case, so it works effectively over a wide range of electric field strength and noise types.Equipped with a signal meter whose linearity is improved by the AGC circuit, it is not saturated even in a strong electric field region.In the AM tuner section, a frequency number line type varicon is also used for the AM section to make channel selection easier. In addition, a one stage synchronous RF-amplifier using a 3-row varicon is used to increase interference rejection capability.In addition, stability and reliability are improved by adopting a high-integration IC. Each amplifier stage is equipped with a sufficient AGC to keep the detection output constant and suppress the occurrence of distortion due to saturation at strong input.The mixer stage employs a balanced type mixer to improve spurious characteristics.There are two types of output terminals, fixed and variable.The output level of the variable terminal can be adjusted independently by FM and AM.We use a Darlington OTL amplifier as an amplifier for headphones.Volume can be controlled on the front panel.It is equipped with a multi-pass terminal, and the best point in the antenna direction can be easily determined by connecting a stereo display SD-100 or an oscilloscope."

name: Pioneer
description: "38 cm 3-way compound speaker unit.The PAT-38X is a 3-way speaker consisting of three units with completely independent voice coil and magnetic circuit.The structure consists of a hollow center pole in the Woofer's magnetic circuit and Woofer's cone paper in the Scoker's horn, and the Scoker's magnetic circuit is attached to the rear end of the speaker.The tweeter is mounted by a bridge at a position slightly offset from the central axis of the woofer.For the cone paper of the woofer part, Cross Edge cone (a piece of cone paper with a separately made cloth edge attached to the edge part) is used, and special damping agent is applied to the edge part, which lowers the lowest resonance frequency and reduces distortion in the low range.Aluminum wire is used for the voice coil, and special hardened conductive paint is applied to prevent disconnection.A horn type is used for the mid-range and high-range.A polyester resin film is used for the diaphragm.The pole and yoke are designed so that the unbalance of the magnetic flux distribution is minimized after the magnetic flux distribution is precisely measured, and the driving force applied to the voice coil is always constant to reduce distortion.By adopting a damper with a circular corrugation, the stability of center holding is improved, and the generation of distortion due to the nonlinearity of the damper is reduced.The frame and yoke cap are coated with baking paint, and the top of the yoke cap is made of transparent plastic material so that you can see the midrange diaphragm and the front and back of the speaker center axis.It comes with a specially designed 3-way network.In this network, L, C and attenuators are combined in a single metal case that is baked and painted gray, and the attenuation of each band is 12dB/oct.For the connection with the dedicated network, W is for woofer, S is for squaker, and T is for tweeter.The standard position of the attenuator is the fourth position from the MIN position for the squaker and the third position from the MIN position for the tweeter."

name: Pioneer
description: "A ribbon tweeter that inherits the know-how accumulated in the PT-R7A and can be added to an existing speaker system as a super tweeter.A built-in network with a crossover frequency of 10 kHz and attenuation characteristics of 12dB/oct.Therefore, by simply connecting the PT-R5 as it is, it is possible to improve the energy characteristics above 10 kHz.Ultra-high-frequency playback at 120 kHz is achieved by using an ultra-lightweight diaphragm, a feeding system with significantly reduced inductance, and a matching transformer with low-loss design.The feeding method is a unique method developed by Pioneer, in which two copper plates on the outward and homeward paths are held in close contact with each other through thin insulation, and the ribbon and copper plates are placed as close to each other as possible in a balanced manner. This eliminates the magnetic flux generated by each conductor and greatly reduces inductance.In order to transmit the excellent vibration of the ribbon directly to the air, it is a short horn design taking advantage of the merits of the direct radiator.It also has a direct connector that passes through the built-in network."

name: Pioneer
description: "A ribbon-type tweeter unit that realizes ultra-high frequency reproduction.Since the vibrating part itself is the driving part of the ribbon speaker, a very light vibration form can be constructed.The PT-R7A uses an ultra-lightweight diaphragm with a mass of 0.009g. By making the mass of the diaphragm itself equal to the mass of the air that the diaphragm moves, the transient characteristics are enhanced with good efficiency without waste.As a result, flat playback is possible up to 120 kHz.The diaphragm has a rigid ribbon made by molding 9 micron ultra-thin aluminum foil into a continuous hexagonal pyramid, and by molding it into a shape that does not become a straight line when cut vertically, horizontally, or diagonally, it has a strong structure that does not worry about bending.As a result, the piston motor cortex range of the ribbon is expanded, and excellent power linearity is secured from minute input to large input.The magnet uses Alnico 7 with a magnetic flux density of 7,400 Gauss to ensure high density and uniform magnetic flux distribution, greatly improving transient characteristics, and realizing high efficiency at the same time.A low-inductance power supply system has been adopted that greatly reduces the inductance up to the ultra-high frequency range.This reduces the generation of slight inductance in the feed section and improves the high-frequency energy characteristics.The matching transformer employs a multi-layer sandwich winding of copper foil with a broadband, low-loss design, and a permalloy core with linear initial permeability characteristics.Comes with a stand base that can be set directly in the cabinet."

name: Pioneer
description: "Beryllium ribbon tweeter developed by improving ribbon tweeter PT-R7A.The entire surface of the diaphragm is in the same phase and receives the driving force more uniformly.Since the vibrating part itself is the driving part, an extremely light vibration system can be constructed without waste, and the diaphragm is easy to move and achieves excellent linearity.Beryllium, which is the lightest and most rigid material of the diaphragm for the ribbon, has been adopted to realize high efficiency and high input resistance.In addition, the ribbon is formed into a regular hexagonal pyramid pattern by a unique manufacturing method. name: C7
description: "In search of true stereophonic, we have applied our technology without fail to create L, which can be called the origin of stereophonic.This is a high-end stereo preamplifier with the aim of ""0 stereo transmission error"" which reproduces sound from R as homogeneous sound.It uses a completely independent monoconstruction structure from the power cord to the input / output terminals on the rear panel.In addition, we thoroughly analyze the magnetic field, temperature, vibration, etc. inside the set that affect the reproduction of the same left and right by making full use of the latest measuring equipment, and use newly developed parts and layout of all parts of the left and right independently symmetrical type to ensure the same transmission.In addition, various considerations are taken to achieve 0 stereo transmission error, such as simplification of signal path and adoption of in-set remote control system.The magnetic field generated by power transformers and smoothing capacitors affects the transmission circuit, generating inductive noise and degrading sound quality. We have developed a power transformer with a low magnetic flux density, a capacitor that cancels the magnetic field, and other anti-magnetic measures for major components and uniform magnetic distribution within the set.Taking into account the effects of external and internal vibrations of the amplifier, we have developed and adopted a newly developed low-flux transformer and a capacitor (complimentary service capacitor pair) in which the positive side and the negative side cancel each other's magnetism.In addition, anti-vibration and anti-vibration measures such as floating printed circuit boards and an aluminum die-cast chassis with no resonance are implemented.In addition, in order to cope with deformation due to heat of the chassis, we have adopted a chassis with calculated stress and designed the layout of each part taking into account the effects of thermal deformation, etc., to clarify and respond to the effects of mechanical elements on sound quality.Taking into consideration that the characteristics of conductors whose resistance changes with temperature affect sound quality, we control heat radiation and provide appropriate layout of heat source parts to create a temperature environment similar to a constant temperature chamber in order to equalize sound on the left and right sides.In order to ensure the independence of the perfect monoconstruction in which the left and right are completely independent, the volume and function switch also adopt the remote control in the set, and the left and right are clearly separated.The circuit configuration is 1-channel 2-amplifier 2-buffer amplifier configuration.In order to drive the volume and Rec output with low impedance from the input with high impedance, a buffer amplifier is installed between the input selector and the volume, and between the volume and the phase switch. In addition, two flat amplifiers use an amplifier circuit made of aluminum hybrid IC.The power supply section is independent of three transformers for left, right and control. In order to eliminate the influence on sound quality, a power transformer which operates at a low magnetic flux density is adopted from Shinkai. Noise generation is suppressed by setting it to operate at a point with good linearity.In addition, we have developed a new complimentary service capacitor pair that focuses on the magnetic field generated on the plus side and the minus side of the smoothing capacitor and cancels each other, thereby reducing the effect of the magnetic field on sound quality.In order to completely eliminate noise and ensure the purity of the signal from the source, the input circuit uses a separate ground circuit that turns on/off not only the hot side but also the ground side at the same time. This eliminates noise from other equipment coming in from the ground line.Aluminum, which has excellent thermal conductivity and shielding characteristics, is used for the substrate of the hybrid IC used in the amplification part of the flat amplifier, thereby thoroughly suppressing the influence of heat and magnetism, which cause sound quality degradation, on sound quality.The printed circuit board, which is easily affected by vibration, is floated from the holder with dump material of special vibration insulating rubber, and the effect of vibration on sound quality is eliminated.In order to obtain independence of each channel and symmetry of left and right, an in-set remote control system is adopted for switching between volume and function to ensure left and right independence.When the front panel control is operated manually, the volume and function selector switches located at the rear of the set are driven by the motor and set to the desired position.If no operation is performed, the motor-drive generator is turned off and the effect on sound quality is cut off.In order to reproduce excellent sound quality, each part is carefully examined, and 99.99% pure oxygen-free copper shielded wire is used for signal path wiring.In order to supply energy directly to each of the three transformers, a 6-core oxygen-free copper high-quality extra-thick power cord is used.In addition to double insulation, carbon is used as the coloring pigment of the insulation material to cope with the influence of pigments on sound quality."

name: C10
description: "This is a stereo control amplifier designed with low distortion, low noise and ultra-wide bandwidth by completely eliminating magnetic materials that distort sound.The C10 eliminates all magnetic material from the chassis and case to the switch frame and volume cover to minimize distortion due to magnetization.Taking note of the fact that capacitors have a significant effect on sound quality, we have adopted an original capacitor that has been changed from the conventional aluminum case to a resin case. The resin case prevents distortion due to eddy currents, improves impedance characteristics, and reduces distortion.In addition, capacitor elements have been treated thoroughly by reducing ESR (equivalent series resistance) (1/2 of conventional ones), using plain foils, improving impedance characteristics equivalent to film capacitors, reducing distortion (3rd harmonic 15 dB), and using oxygen-free copper wires for lead wires.A unique non-magnetic switch is used for the switches.By using non-magnetic brass for the case of this switch, the generation of distortion is almost eliminated. This eliminates the intervention of magnetic material in the switch part. In addition, the switch part is directly plated with silver on brass, and the movable contact is plated with silver on the phosphor bronze, so the reproduction sound without any sense of distortion is obtained.The pin jack is gold-plated.In general gold plating, nickel plating is applied to the base in order to stabilize the plating. Therefore, due to the influence of the ferromagnetic material nickel, the strain caused by hysteresis is generated. The newly developed pin jack used in the C-10 is coated with a non-magnetic base plating that shows stability equal to or higher than that of nickel to prevent the generation of strain.Oxygen-free copper wire is used for wiring inside the amplifier.The power cord uses a highly reliable 15A large-capacity power cord with double insulation.In addition, the core wire of this power cord is color-coded in black and white, and the connection with the AC plug is managed to unify the polarity.A 140 Ï‰ m thick copper foil glass epoxy board is used for the substrate.Conventional glass epoxy boards used 35 Ï‰ m copper foil attached to them. However, in order to reduce DCR (direct current resistance) and inductance in the board, we use 140 Ï‰ m copper foil, which is four times larger than conventional ones.Equipped with a unique supersonic filter.This filter is composed of an air-core coil with a cutoff at 50 kHz and a resistor, and has a large effect on TIM distortion countermeasures.The wooden case has an oil finish of Andes Rose natural wood.Pin cord for connection is included.This connection code uses a oxygen-free copper wire as the material and a gold-plated plug made of a non-magnetic material as the pin plug to minimize the occurrence of strain in the connection code. In addition, unlike the conventional coaxial structure, the structure of the connection code is a star quad system in which the core wires of the signal wires facing each other are twisted together to reduce the inductance. In addition, the signal wires are made of conductive polymer material and completely shielded by polarization."

name: M5
description: "This monaural power amplifier has been carefully designed based on the concept of ""amplifier for getting drunk with music"".Returning to the starting point of the amplifier design of ""faithfully amplifying the input signal and reproducing it as the output signal"", we have developed and installed a new super linear circuit that can obtain characteristics without applying NFB. This eliminates TIM distortion from the root and ensures stability in the high-frequency range.It is a class A power amplifier that in principle does not generate any distortion such as switching distortion or crossover distortion. It adopts a unique power supply system of M5 which has a dedicated power supply for class A bias.By increasing the efficiency of the power supply, there is no excessive heat generation, which is considered a drawback of A class amplifier.All parts and construction are thoroughly examined, and the best parts are developed and carefully selected using the technology that we have.The power transformer is designed to achieve low leakage flux and stable regulation.First, we have adopted a polyester-coated oxygen-free copper wire for the winding, which has a cross-sectional area twice that of ordinary wire. This improves the regulation and reduces the temperature rise of the winding to 1/2. In addition, we have achieved a dramatic improvement in S/N by adopting the toroidal method, which is effective in reducing leakage flux.A non-conductive and non-magnetic resin is used for the transformer case, and silicon carbide powder, which is a radio wave absorber, is mixed into the filler to reduce strain, and the transformer body is floated from the chassis by rubber to reduce vibration.A newly developed film capacitor for pure audio has been adopted in order to prevent chattering and squeal in the mid - and high-frequency range caused by the structure of the film capacitor. The film material is a composite structure of polycarbonate with low tan � (dielectric loss) and polypropylene with high insulation and excellent high-frequency characteristics. This film is wound tightly at low speed and high tension to eliminate wrinkles and stress. In addition, a special winding core and heat-shrinkable resin are utilized to prevent squeal. In addition, in order to prevent the influence of external electric field, double shielding is applied by conductive resin case and conductive resin tube.It uses a 4-core power cord for audio that was developed after thorough examination of the power cord.This power cord uses high-conductivity oxygen-free copper wires to reduce losses in the wires, greatly reducing non-linear distortion, and reducing the mutual interference between the two power transformers to reduce the source impedance.In addition, polyethylene with low dielectric constant is used as an insulator to reduce loss and prevent conductor vibration.In order to stably supply high power of 300W to the speakers, a large output terminal is newly installed.The cable connection opening is wide (3.8x14mm) to allow for the connection of very thick speaker cables. The cable connection method is a vise type in which the cord is crimped by two flat plates with internal knurling.The contact surface is gold-plated to improve stability and reliability.The fuse used is an audio fuse that was developed after reconsidering the material.By changing the cap material from conventional brass to pure copper, the conductor resistance is reduced to approximately 1/3. In addition, by changing from alloy to pure metal, the non-linearity between dissimilar metals generated inside the alloy is improved.Furthermore, nickel plating, which is a ferromagnetic material, is replaced with tin plating, which is a non-magnetic material, thereby eliminating magnetic strain.A glass epoxy substrate developed for audio equipment is used for the substrate. By using 99.99% pure oxygen-free copper, non-linearity is dramatically improved. By changing the conventional 35 Ï‰ m copper to 280 Ï‰ m thick copper, the conductor resistance is reduced to 1/8, enabling stable signal transmission.By using a glass epoxy board with excellent moisture resistance, the change in capacitance inside the copper foil is minimized and leakage inside the circuit is prevented."

name: M7
description: "This monaural power amplifier is designed with the latest of the latest technology, and its performance has been refined to reproduce richer musical quality through repeated trial listening and attention to craftsmanship.Class A operation without crossover distortion and switching distortion in principle is adopted. In addition, in order to improve drive performance at low load and to suppress generation of distortion, voltage and current amplification circuits are clearly separated.A hybrid IC using an aluminum substrate is adopted for the voltage amplification stage, and high-precision voltage amplification is performed using NFB. The power amplification stage is 5-stage Darlington to ensure power linearity, the drive transistor is 2-parallel, and the power transistor is 6-parallel push-pull configuration, enabling current amplification with less distortion even though it is a non-feedback amplifier.In addition, the voltage amplifier stage and power amplifier stage are separated from each other in terms of layout to eliminate mutual interference.In order to prevent adverse effects on sound quality due to counter-electromotive force generated by external pressure applied to the cone paper of the speaker and high-frequency noise such as radio waves and fluorescent lights induced in the speaker cableThe voltage amplification stage and the power amplification stage are completely separated, and a circuit configuration without feedback loop from output to input is adopted.Focusing on the fact that the output signal is obtained by modulating and synthesizing the two power supplies (plus and minus) with the input signal, we have adopted symmetrical construction that equalizes the internal environment and mechanical strength of the chassis, such as the temperature of the plus and minus power supply and the temperature and magnetism of the amplification stage.This reduces distortion not only from the circuit, but also from temperature distribution inside the chassis, magnetic effects, and chassis mechanical strength problems.In addition to the input terminal of the RCA pin jack, a balanced input terminal of the canon-type input jack is mounted on the input terminal.The power supply section uses a large-capacity toroidal transformer that provides low linkage flux and stable regulation. The use of an extremely thick winding improves regulation and reduces temperature rise, contributing to stable temperature balance.In addition, the two transformers are dedicated to the positive and negative power supply respectively, reducing the source impedance, and in combination with the adoption of the double-bridge rectification system, the speaker can be driven more accurately.It employs a protective circuit that eliminates the relay from the output stage, reducing the effect of the protective circuit on sound quality and minimizing the contact points of the signal path.In order to prevent the deformation of the chassis due to external vibration and internal heat from affecting the sound quality, it uses a strong structure that is hard to be deformed. In addition, thick aluminum material is used lavishly to ensure the strength and eliminate the influence of magnetism that causes distortion.In addition, in order to suppress vibration, we have adopted a floating mount for the power transformer, and have taken thorough measures to prevent vibration and vibration.In order to ensure the realization of the design concept of symmetrical construction, a large heat sink with high heat radiation efficiency is laid out in an appropriate position, and the temperature environment on the positive and negative sides is made uniform.To prevent interference between circuits from affecting sound quality, each circuit section is separated by a shield to eliminate mutual interference.In order to provide a stable power supply to the dedicated positive and negative transformers, a 6-conductor thick oxygen-free copper audio cord with high conductivity is used.It is designed with an emphasis on sound quality such as double insulation, adoption of carefully selected coating material, polarity indication on plug, etc.The speaker terminal is a large vise crimping type speaker terminal that allows for easy connection of very thick speaker cables. description: "A flagship AV amplifier that supports THX Surround EX.Compatible with THX Ultra, it can be used anywhere from space-saving to full-fledged home theater (3000 ft).It is equipped with the THX Surround EX decoder which brings the sound effects of Surround EX, an audio format for theaters, to the living room.This system is a 7.1 ch surround system with two surround back channels added to the conventional 5.1 ch surround system, further improving sound continuity and enveloping impact.With the VSA-D10EX, you can connect surround back speakers by adding an external power amplifier. name: Pioneer
description: "A non-feedback MC head amplifier with an ideal transparent amplifier and a super linear circuit for MC in the circuit.It uses a super linear circuit for MC consisting of a nonlinear absorption circuit and a voltage amplifier.The H-Z1 employs a low-noise FET in order to greatly improve the SN ratio. By driving the current push-pull, the second power characteristic (non-linearity) of the FET is canceled, and excellent linearity without distortion is obtained.A silicon carbide shielded power transformer is used for the power transformer.In this transformer, high-purity oxygen-free copper wire is used for the winding, and by using a balanced winding, the voltage value after commutation is made uniform and stable regulation is obtained. In addition, by using a toroidal core, leakage flux is reduced. This prevents the transformer from affecting other parts and eliminates sound quality degradation caused by induction hum.In addition, porous silicon carbide ceramic is used for the transformer case to prevent distortion due to electromagnetic induction from the outside.Aluminum electrolytic capacitor Non-inductive electrolytic capacitor is adopted.Unlike ordinary electrolytic capacitors, this capacitor employs a method in which all the electrode foils of the capacitor are made into electrodes by special welding, thereby realizing a significant reduction in inductance.A resin case coated with a special conductive material is used inside the case to shield the elements from external magnetic fields.We have adopted newly developed film capacitors for audio equipment as small-capacity capacitors.The film is made of a composite structure consisting of polycarbonate with low tan � (dielectric loss) and polypropylene with high insulation and excellent high-frequency characteristics. This is rolled up hard at low speed and high tension to eliminate wrinkles and mechanical stress that often occur in the past and to prevent intermodulation distortion caused by squeal.In addition, the device is double-shielded with a conductive film coating and a special case to prevent the effects of external electrolysis.Uses a glass case electrolytic capacitor in which the case is replaced with glass to prevent the generation of eddy current.When signal current flows, electromagnetic waves are generated and leaked from electronic components, and interactions between channels and electromagnetic waves are reflected by metal objects, causing distortion of the signal current itself and causing deterioration of sound quality. To prevent this, a special electromagnetic wave absorber is used in the H-Z1.This is a multi-layer carbon-containing urethane foam sheet that prevents the induction of electromagnetic waves inside and outside the amplifier. In addition, the top plate is made of glass coated with highly reliable silicon carbide as an electromagnetic wave shield. This improves the audibility that does not appear in the specifications.The printed circuit board uses glass epoxy, which has excellent mechanical strength and electrical high-frequency characteristics.The copper foil is made of 99.99% pure oxygen-free copper with a thickness of 280 Ï‰ m, about eight times that of conventional copper foil. This reduces DC resistance to 1/8 of conventional copper foil and greatly reduces inductance.The fuse is an audio fuse that uses pure copper for the base material instead of conventional brass.This not only improves the conductor resistance by nearly 30%, but also prevents the occurrence of non-linear distortion between different metals inside the alloy by switching from alloy to pure metal.In addition, tin, a non-magnetic material, is used instead of nickel, a magnetic material, for the plating material of the electrode.We are also working to improve the quality of the power cord. We have adopted oxygen-free copper as the conductive material, and by improving the conductivity, loss in the wire is reduced and non-linear distortion is greatly reduced.The insulation covering the conductor is made of polyethylene with low conductivity for low loss, low loss, low capacity and low distortion. In addition, the double insulation structure covered with polyvinyl chloride of 1.6 mm thickness prevents conductor vibration such as cord noise generated when current flows.In addition, the polarity of the plug is indicated, and the polarity is controlled from the core wire of the power cord to the wiring inside the body to improve the sound quality.We have developed and adopted a fast recovery diode with high high-speed response for the rectifier diode.This reduces power supply noise.In order to solve the problem of non-linearity between dissimilar metals, copper-containing solder is used. In addition, oxygen-free copper wire with 99.99% purity is used from the inlet to the outlet.Equipped with a gain switching function that can be switched in two stages and a 4-position cartridge load."

name: Pioneer
description: "In order to faithfully pick up the limits of high-fidelity reproduction by delving into basic issues such as low mass, broadband, high trackability, high rigidity, and no resonance in order to faithfully pick up the music signal inscribed on the disc.The left and right channels of the magnetic circuit are independent, and each channel is composed of 3 poles and 2 magnets. The magnets are opposed to each other in the same polarity across the center yoke so that the magnetic flux is concentrated in the center yoke. By this, a larger magnetic flux is generated with a small magnet, and efficient power generation is achieved.The magnet uses samarium-cobalt, which has a large energy product, and is designed to obtain high magnetic flux density in spite of the wide gap. As a result, high magnetic flux density of 10,000 Gauss maximum can be obtained, and linear and efficient power generation is possible from large amplitude of low sound range to small amplitude of high sound range.The total weight of the magnetic circuit for both channels is only 0.9g, which is about 1/4 of that of a conventional MC cartridge, making it possible to make a low-mass cartridge.Micro coils are arranged to correspond to magnets independently on the left and right. The coils have a coreless and bobbinless structure with 99.99% pure oxygen-free copper wires wound in multiple layers.The impedance characteristics are almost constant up to around 100 kHz, and the sound quality is not affected by changes in the impedance characteristics, so a flat playback sound can be obtained.Both the magnet and the coil are structurally separated into the left and right channels, respectively, so that interference between the left and right signals is suppressed and excellent channel separation is obtained.Beryllium is used as a material for the cantilever, and the tapered pipe cantilever is completed by the vacuum deposition method utilizing Pioneer's proprietary precision processing technology.This is different from the one in which thin plates are rounded and joined together. It is directly molded in the shape of a pipe, so that rigidity is increased and effective mass is reduced, mechanical impedance is extremely low, and reliable tracing is possible.The PC-70MC uses a one point support system with a clear vibration support point. The rear end of the cantilever is supported by a suspension wire, a damper is provided to clarify the vibration support point, and a damper is provided to clarify the vibration support point. The vibration in the front-back direction that occurs during tracing is reliably suppressed and stable braking is provided.In addition, taking advantage of the low mass design, the viscous damping of the damper material is set to a minimum to further improve the traceability.In designing the frame, we have developed a method for measuring dynamic mass using data obtained by directly exciting the cartridge body using computer analysis technology, and based on the know-how obtained through this method, we have implemented a non-resonance design.The main body of the PC-70MC is made of aluminum die-cast to suppress resonance. Moreover, the vibration system is fixed directly to the frame where the cartridge is attached to the head shell. Thus, there are no intermediate parts and no resonance is generated due to the structure.In addition, a chuck joint system is adopted in which the vibration system is firmly attached to the aluminum die-cast frame, and the contact point is changed from conventional point contact by screw fastening to surface contact, and adhesion is improved and resonance is prevented."

name: Pioneer
description: "Direct-drive phono motor employing magnetic pulse detection system.The drive motor is a brushless high-torque Hall motor using a Hall element.A Hall element is a type of semiconductor that converts a change in magnetic field into an electric current. By applying it to motor-driven switching (magnetic pole switching), vibration and wear due to friction are suppressed, and high S/N and durability are achieved.The servo mechanism uses a frequency control method of magnetic pulse detection.In this system, magnetic pulses from the bottom surface of the magnetized rotor magnet are detected, and the AC signal obtained from the detected pulses is used for automatic control, so that constant speed rotation with quick response can be maintained without being affected by external temperature and humidity.The power supply to the drive circuit and control circuit is provided by a stable circuit with a large current capacity. Moreover, by providing sufficient temperature compensation, stability of rotation against fluctuation of power supply voltage and stability index with high temperature drift and time drift can be obtained.The turntable has a precisely machined inertial mass of 280kg-cm.2Large turntables have been adopted.Stroboscopic lighting is lit by a special waveform shaping circuit and is easier to see than general stroboscopic lighting.The turntable and control part are separated to increase the freedom of installation.It boasts durability that can be used without oil for 10,000 hours.Fine speed adjustment of � 6% is possible for each rotation speed independently.There was a special cabinet sold separately."
