name: Pioneer
description: "A direct-drive phono motor developed by applying the Hall element developed by Pioneer.By adopting a direct drive system in which the rotation of the motor itself is the same as the number of revolutions of the record, there is no reduction mechanism that causes uneven rotation, and the generation of vibration that increases in proportion to the number of revolutions is reduced.In addition, we have adopted a DC drive Hall motor that applies a Hall element to detect the magnetic field of the switching mechanism. Compared with a mechanical switching mechanism motor using a brush, vibration is less and S/N and durability are improved.The Hall element is a magnetic-to-electric conversion element with a structure in which a potential difference is generated at the output terminal when a current is passed through the input terminal and a perpendicular magnetic field is applied to the input terminal. This is called the Hall effect. An alloy of N-type InSb is evaporated on a cross-shaped substrate, and four input / output lines are provided there. This is a type of semiconductor molded with synthetic resin material.Pioneer has developed a vacuum deposition method and succeeded in rationalizing the production process and increasing the thickness of the ultra-thin film from 30-50 Ï‰ m to 0.8 Ï‰ m. Moreover, uniform quality improves the performance of Hall elements.In the MU-3000, three Hall elements are placed at the bottom of the stator core for sequential switching.The MU of the MU 3000 consists of a rotor magnet magnetized to 20 poles and a 3-phase wave-wound stator with two pairs of 60-slot windings.Three Hall elements are arranged on a part of the stator side. The Hall elements generate signals to activate the transistor circuit by magnetic field lines in sequence with the rotation of the magnet rotor magnetized with 20 poles. The transistor circuit changes the current supply to each winding in sequence according to the signals to generate rotational driving force.A DC servo mechanism has been adopted in order to obtain more precise accuracy of constant speed.This servomechanism uses the back electromotive force generated in the coil by the rotation of the magnet rotor to control the rotation. Since the back electromotive force increases and decreases in proportion to the rotation, this change is detected and the electronic circuit accurately controls the drive current.33 1/3, 45 rpm speed switching uses a purely electronic circuit.In addition, there is a speed fine adjustment knob that can be adjusted independently for each rotational speed, and it can be freely controlled within � 2%.Since it uses a DC motor, it can be used regardless of the power frequency of 50Hz/60Hz."

name: P3A
description: "This is a stereo player system based on Exclusive P3 that aims for higher quality playback by changing the arm and details.For the phono motor and bearing structure, we have adopted a quartz PLL control system for the linear torque type DD motor with slotless and coreless structure. In addition, we have adopted the SHR (Stable Hanging Rotor) bearing structure with the center of gravity of the rotating shaft set low. As a result, we have achieved rotational performance with rotational unevenness of 0.003% or less and rotational speed accuracy of 0.001%, which is impossible with conventional measurement methods.In the SHR system, the bearing structure is designed to be the reverse structure of the conventional system. First, the supporting point is moved closer to the center of gravity and the conventional bearing section is changed to the rotating side, so that inertia is generated in the bearing section during rotation and lateral pressure is not applied to the shaft. To prevent rattling, the clearance of the bearing is kept to a minimum, and sufficient torque and turntable inertia are set for the load of the cartridge applied to the outer circumference of the turntable.The high torque motor with dual rotor structure using anisotropic ferrite magnet with strong magnetic force realizes high torque (10kg-cm) similar to record cutting equipment.In addition, an inertial mass of 700kg-cm2In combination with the turntable and servo circuit with excellent transient characteristics, excellent starting characteristics (constant speed rotation in 0.3 seconds after the switch is turned on) and load resistance characteristics (equivalent to needle pressure of 1.5 kg) are realized, and stable and high precision rotational characteristics are obtained.The tone arm is equipped with a mass concentration system that concentrates the mass on the rotating shaft and an oil dump adjustment mechanism, in addition to the light equivalent mass of the tone arm.By applying a highly reliable silicone oil brake on the arm shaft, the volume in the low range and the reduction of cross modulation distortion are realized. In addition, the amount of oil dump brake can be controlled according to the characteristics of the cartridge, and the dump can be turned off.The tone arm is made of DRA & alumina ceramics in pursuit of no resonance.It is equipped with a new mechanism, Dynamic Resonance Absorber (DRA), which was developed based on computer analysis technology such as FFT analyzer to understand the vibration characteristics of the tone arm that degrade sound quality. The DRA is equipped with a sub-resonance body composed of a damper with moderate spring properties and a weight, and absorbs vibrations that are opposite to the resonance of the arm. This vibration neutralization function prevents the needle tip from picking up excess components other than the sound groove, and more accurate reproduced sound is obtained.Alumina ceramic is used for the arm material. This material has approximately 3 times the specific rigidity compared to conventional aluminum and reduces resonance.Equipped with a quick stop mechanism that combines an electronic brake that uses an electronic circuit to apply the force of a motor and reverse rotation, and a mechanical brake that uses a plunger to stop the rotation of the rotor.The motor and tone arm are fixed to a 12 kg weight base made of laminated aluminum and barium sulfate of high density material.In addition, the base is completely floated from the cabinet to prevent sound pressure from the speakers and vibration from the floor. adopting a coaxial suspension system.In order to enable a high howling margin, a triple structure insulator has been adopted.The 25 kg body is supported by an oil dump type piston structure using a 62 mm spring, and special rubber is used to absorb surging of the spring.In addition, since the natural frequency of the insulator is set to 5 Hz or less, which is lower than the natural frequency of the tone arm, a high howling margin is obtained by combining with the vibration isolation structure of the coaxial suspension.The cabinet is designed with a combination of a Brazilian Rosewood natural wood finish cabinet and a tempered glass dust cover to prevent howling.A very thick power cord made of highly conductive oxygen-free copper is used for the power cord, reducing losses in wire rod and greatly improving non-linear strain.In addition, by clearly displaying the polarity, the sound quality is improved."

name: Pioneer
description: "In pursuit of sound quality, this record player system takes advantage of the excellent unit design just like high-end machines.The tone arm uses a shell-integrated carbon graphite straight arm.Through vibration analysis using a computer, the shape and balance with the least resonance can be determined theoretically, and through repeated measurement and listening, a tone arm that enables more faithful transmission has been realized.In order to suppress low-frequency resonance caused by warping or eccentricity of the record, a silicon oil braking system (on-off capable) is adopted. By pressing the damping knob on the upper part of the arm shaft, the silicon braking fin injected into the oil cup sinks and applies viscous braking to the arm. In addition, by cutting the tip of the braking fin (ring shape) at 45 degrees, it is designed to apply braking suitable for both horizontal and vertical directions simultaneously. This suppresses harmful low-frequency resonance and reduces intermodulation distortion.It uses silicon oil, which is excellent as a braking oil and has little viscosity change with time or temperature. In addition, this silicon oil is stored in an oil cup made with high precision to prevent oil from oozing out and improve reliability.A heavy weight arm base made of die cast with a stabilizer effect is used for the arm base.The drive section is equipped with an SH-rotor type coreless motor.We have succeeded in greatly reducing the wow flutter by moving the rotor bearing, which used to be located at the bottom of the motor, just below the turntable, and by adopting a coreless structure that does not cause cogging in principle.Starting torque is 1.3kg-cm and further 330kg-cm2By combining a turntable with an inertial mass (including a turntable seat), stability without load fluctuation is realized even with a load of 200g corresponding to 100 tone arms with a needle pressure of 2.0g.In addition, three highly reliable Hall elements developed by Pioneer are used in the magnetic pole switching mechanism of the motor. In addition, fine noise is eliminated by requiring micron-order machining order of microns down to fine parts.Adopts a silent lift-up mechanism that achieves quiet and accurate operation.First of all, the arm is moved up and down using a moving coil system that applies the operation principle of a speaker and operates without contact with DC voltage.In addition, to detect the end position of the recording sound groove, a method of non-contact detection using a Hall element mounted inside the arm shaft and a magnet mounted opposite the Hall element is adopted, which realizes stable operation without impairing the performance of the arm.Equipped with a pure electronic quick stop mechanism that operates in conjunction with a silent lift-up mechanism and stops the turntable instantly.We have adopted a high-density cabinet that effectively controls the shaking of the cabinet due to the anti-energy effect of the rotational moment of the turntable with high inertia and high torque.In addition, by adopting a large insulator with a unique low center of gravity structure, the structure is resistant to external vibration.By using a damping adjustment adapter (sold separately), it is possible to adjust the oil braking at a level of 0 to 5 as in the case of the advanced model PL-70LII and PL-50LII.Includes an S-shaped replacement arm pipe (with large weight) for easy replacement of the head shell.Also, carbon graphite shell integrated straight arm pipe is sold separately."

name: Pioneer
description: "A record player whose sound quality has been improved by reflecting the sound quality improvement technology obtained with a high-grade machine.The tone arm employs a double-structure head-shell integrated straight arm composed of carbon graphite and high-rigidity aluminum base, which are lightweight, highly rigid and have excellent damping characteristics. While examining the material itself, the complex split-resonance phenomenon is eliminated by computer vibration analysis.The strength of the head shell part and the connector part at the root is also sufficiently high to eliminate the adverse effect of resonance.To eliminate low-frequency resonance and achieve high sensitivity at the same time, a variable level silicon oil braking system is adopted.This is designed to apply damping by sinking a damping fin (ring shape) into the silicon oil injected into the oil cup at the upper part of the arm shaft. By appropriately matching the equivalent mass of various cartridges and the arm, the applicable range of the arm is expanded.In addition, by cutting the tip of the fin at 45 degrees, the structure reduces the Q (resonance sharpness) of low-frequency resonance by applying appropriate braking simultaneously in both horizontal and vertical directions. In addition, cross-modulation distortion is greatly improved by the synergistic effect of mass concentration concentration system that brings the main weight of the arm closer to the rotating shaft.The arm base uses a heavy weight die cast arm base with a stabilizing effect. By fixing the arm firmly and suppressing partial resonance, it realizes low-frequency reproduction with higher resolution.In order to improve rotational accuracy, we have adopted a coreless structure that does not cause cogging in principle. In addition, we have achieved excellent rotational characteristics by adopting the SH rotor system in which the rotor fulcrum (bearing) located at the bottom of the motor is moved just below the turntable. The SH rotor system fundamentally eliminates the reverse conical motion of the motor shaft caused by the slight clearance between the motor shaft and the bearing, which could not be prevented by the conventional structure.A coreless quartz PLL DC servo hole motor with a starting torque of 1.6kg-cm is used to eliminate the load fluctuation caused by the resistance which the needle tip receives from the recording sound groove, and a 330kg-cm ring motor is used to eliminate the load fluctuation.2By adopting a 31 cm diameter turntable with an inertial mass of 1 g, the stability that does not cause rotational speed fluctuation even under the load of 200g needle pressure is realized.In addition, three Hall elements developed by Pioneer are used in the magnetic pole switching mechanism of the motor, and fine noise is eliminated by seeking processing accuracy in the order of microns even to other fine parts.Equipped with a silent lift-up mechanism that does not produce mechanical sounds. This is a moving coil system that applies the operation principle of a speaker to the elevation mechanism that moves the arm up and down. It is designed to operate without contact with DC voltage.In addition, the end position of the sound groove of the record is detected by non-contact detection using the Hall element inside the arm shaft and magnet, so that no side pressure is generated and the sensitivity of the arm is not impaired.In addition, a pure electronic quick stop mechanism is adopted.The cabinet uses a high-density cabinet (marble ebony finish) with laminated solid boards to effectively prevent the cabinet from shaking due to the reaction of the rotational moment of the high torque motor.In addition, a unique low center of gravity insulator is used as the supporting insulator to ensure stability against external vibrations such as howling.Oxygen-free copper wires with low transmission loss are used for the tone arm lead wires and PU cord.Equipped with an S-shaped universal arm pipe (with large weight) that allows easy replacement of the head shell, any cartridge can be enjoyed by the twin pipe replacement system.In addition, carbon graphite shell integrated straight arm pipe is also sold separately. Straight arms are arranged as many as the number of cartridges, and you can enjoy easily changing cartridges."

name: Pioneer
description: "A high-precision player system that realizes incommensurable stability by pursuing high precision and looks at the essence of the player to the ultimate.For the drive part, we reviewed the bare characteristics of the rotation before applying servo, and developed and installed the SH rotor (Stable Hanging Rotor) method rotor) method to achieve rotational accuracy of orders of magnitude.The SH-rotor system adopts a unique structure in which the rotor support point, which was previously located at the bottom of the motor, is moved just below the turntable. By this, the center of gravity of the turntable and the support point are almost matched.This is achieved by a structure opposite to the conventional one in which a motor shaft is fixed, a ball bearing is mounted on it, and a rotor is rotated. This eliminates the unstable inverted cone motion caused by the coincidence of the supporting points.The motor has a diameter of 31 cm and an inertial mass of 480kg-cm.2Equipped with a 2kg-cm high-torque DC servo motor that rotates the turntable at a constant speed within 1/3 rotation (approximately 1 second), it achieves excellent stability.The turntable uses a low-pressure casting method different from the conventional turntable manufacturing method in order to obtain more stable rotation and excellent acoustic characteristics.This is a hand-made method in which metal is slowly poured into an extremely precisely molded mold and cooled naturally over a long period of time. Since the inside of the mold is kept uniform with less soot and bubbles, it achieves higher density and better dynamic balance than conventional methods.In addition, in order to deaden the resonance of the turntable itself, a special anti-vibration agent is applied to the back surface to prevent squealing which adversely affects the sound quality.The magnetic pole switching mechanism of the motor uses a Hall element non-contact switching method developed by Pioneer.The SH-rotor drive eliminates the fine noise that has been generated between the motor shaft and the bearing, and the special anti-vibration processing inside the phono motor unit realizes a high S / N ratio.The arm base uses a 1 kg heavy weight arm base made of hand-made solid brass cut one by one. In addition, the support part that fixes the arm shaft uses a chucking joint system in which 8 metal blades clamp and tighten the entire face of the arm shaft evenly.Unlike the general support system in which one point or several points are fixed with screws, this system eliminates play and prevents partial resonance. In addition, the chucking joint system is also adopted for the mounting part of the head shell to pursue sound quality by thoroughly eliminating resonance.A newly developed realize high sensitivity while suppressing low-frequency resonance caused by eccentricity and warpage of commercially available records, a newly developed level variable oil braking system is adopted.Silicone oil is injected into an oil cup installed in the arm bearing. A ring-shaped braking fin with the tip cut at 45 degrees is pinched to apply damping. The braking amount suitable for both vertical and horizontal directions can be applied at one point. This reduces the low-frequency resonance Q and flattens the mechanical impedance.The level adjustment ring is free when the scale is 0, and the braking amount increases as the scale increases from 1 to 5. This design allows for a wide range of applications from the MC type, which has a relatively low compliance type, to the MM type, which has a high compliance. The level adjustment ring uses a helicoid type with a highly accurate lapping process to prevent partial resonance.The tone arm part adopts a mass concentration system in which the main weight is brought closer to the arm shaft and the equivalent mass of the needle tip is reduced. By reducing the moment of inertia of the tone arm, basic performance before oil braking is also improved.The bearing part of the tone arm utilizes Pioneer's precision pioneer's precision processing technology which boasts of micron order, and adopts stability support in which the pivot is stored in the pivot holder and supported by spring.The tone arm is a long type design with an effective length of 282 mm using a high-rigidity aluminum pipe, and is equipped with a light-mass, high-rigidity carbon fiber head shell as standard.The cabinet is a 8.5 kg heavy weight cabinet. This cabinet has a strong design consisting of four layers of conifer solid boards with high rigidity, high density and high internal loss, which were selected after trial manufacture and study of various materials.In addition, the newly developed low-center-of-gravity insulator with spring support is used for the insulator, with the center of gravity of the player system and the supporting point of the insulator at approximately the same height.Low-capacitance oxygen-free copper wires and gold-plated terminals are used to minimize transmission loss at the tone arm leads, power cords and their contacts.It uses a purely electronic start / stop button.5 mm thick smoke-degree acrylic hood made by hand craft is equipped as standard.Uses a turntable sheet with excellent acoustic characteristics."

name: Pioneer
description: "This record player system is based on the concept of the PL-70 that directly addresses the essence of the player. It uses the latest technology for the tone arm and motor. It also features a silent lift-up function.The arm is made of originally developed carbon graphite with high internal loss and high rigidity. By combining it with the base of high-purity aluminum pipe, it realizes a low-mass, high-rigidity arm that is resistant to resonance. In addition, the arm pipe is of a straight type that is advantageous in weight and provides high strength. In addition, the arm pipe is of a tapered shape that increases in second moment of area as it approaches the center of the arm. Thus, the rigidity is increased while reducing the low-mass. In addition, brass with high Young's modulus is used for the connector at the base of the arm to obtain sufficient strength.The head shell is also made of a lightweight, highly rigid carbon fiber composite material. In addition to the excellent material, the shape is ribbed to increase the strength.Vibration analysis theory is applied to determine the shape of the tone arm. In this method, the entire resonance of the arm is grasped in real time by a computer modal analyzer, the overall balance is controlled, and the vibration characteristics are made flat. In the measurement method, sensors are attached to each part of the tone arm, and the vibration distribution is expanded to about 1000 times the actual vibration displacement by a computer, and it is observed as an animation.It employs a level variable oil braking system that realizes high sensitivity while suppressing harmful low-frequency resonance caused by warping or eccentricity of records.Silicone oil is injected into the oil cup located at the upper part of the arm shaft, and the damping is applied by sinking the ring-shaped braking fin with the tip cut at 45 degrees. Since the amount of braking suitable for both vertical and horizontal directions can be applied at one point, the Q of low-frequency resonance is lowered. By this, the suppression of con-modulation distortion, which makes the reproduced sound muddy, is improved by 9 dB.In addition, the brake oil uses silicon oil, which has less viscosity change with time and temperature. In addition, this silicon oil is stored in a high-precision molded oil cup to prevent oil bleeding and improve reliability.The level adjustment ring of the level variable oil braking system is free when the scale is 0, and the braking amount increases as the scale increases from 1 to 5. This level adjustment ring uses a helicoid type with high precision lapping processing to prevent partial resonance.The tone arm part adopts a mass concentration system in which the main weight is brought closer to the arm shaft and the equivalent mass of the needle tip is reduced. By reducing the moment of inertia of the tone arm, the basic performance before oil accuracy is also improved.It employs a simple contactless end detection system using a Hall element and magnet, and a silent lift-up mechanism using a moving coil drive system arm elevation without any operating noise.In addition, it is equipped with a pure electronic quick stop mechanism in which the arm gently rises when the performance ends and the turntable automatically stops.In principle, the drive motor uses a coreless quartz PLL DC servo motor that does not cause cogging, which is the cause of uneven rotation. This motor uses a flat coil to generate a magnetic field instead of an air-core for the drive coil, thereby eliminating the strength and weakness of a partial magnetic field and preventing cogging.In addition, the SH rotor (Stable Hanging Rotor) system has been adopted in order to improve the bare characteristics before the servo system. This system has a structure in which the rotor support point, which was previously located at the bottom of the motor, is moved just below the turntable. By this structure, the center of gravity of the turntable and the support point almost coincide with each other. In addition, the lateral pressure applied to the bearing, which is the heart of the rotating system, is reduced to improve the stability of the turntable.The turntable uses a low-pressure casting method that is different from the conventional method. This is a hand-made method in which metal is slowly poured into an extremely precise mold and cooled naturally over a long period of time. Since the inside of the mold is kept uniform with less soot and bubbles, it achieves higher density and better dynamic balance than the conventional method.In addition, in order to deaden the resonance of the turntable itself, a special anti-vibration material is applied to the back surface to prevent squealing which adversely affects the sound quality.The cabinet is a 8.5 kg heavy weight cabinet designed by laminating conifer solid boards selected after trial manufacture and examination of various materials.We have also adopted a newly developed low-center-of-gravity structure insulator with the center of gravity of the player system and the supporting point of the insulator at approximately the same height. As shown in the as shown in the structure diagram.Low-capacitance oxygen-free copper wires and gold-plated terminals are used to minimize transmission loss at the tone arm leads, power cords and their contacts.It is equipped with a 5 mm thick smoke door clear hood made by hand craft one by one as standard.Uses a turntable sheet with excellent acoustic characteristics.Equipped with S-shaped replacement arm pipe for easy replacement of head shell (with large weight)In addition, carbon graphite shell integrated straight arm is also sold separately, and straight arm pipes are prepared for the number of cartridges to be used, and the cartridge can be easily replaced."

name: Pioneer
description: "A full auto player that uses an SH rotor type coreless motor.With a full-auto mechanism, you can place a record on a turntable and press the start button to auto-lead-in. This eliminates from the root the reverse cone motion and the rotational slippage caused by the lubricating oil used between the shaft and the bearing. In addition, the bare nature of the motor before the servo was applied is improved, and the rotation of the turntable is stabilized. In addition, parts such as shafts and bearings are also improved in accuracy of micron order or less by utilizing Pioneer's precision processing technology, and reliability and durability are improved.The SH rotor type coreless motor realizes smooth rotational torque without cogging by using a coreless structure in which a driving coil is an empty core and a flat coil is used to generate a magnetic field without using a core. In addition, the diameter of the coil for generating the magnetic field is increased, a thin flat coil is used for the coil, and the power efficiency required for torque generation is improved by using Pioneer's original new IC, and high torque is realized.The tone arm uses a static balance S-shaped tone arm.Mass concentration system is adopted for this arm to reduce the moment of inertia which affects the traceability of the tone arm by moving the main weight closer to the fulcrum (arm shaft).The cartridge is equipped with a high power MC cartridge that can be used in the MM position.This cartridge uses Pioneer's independently developed 6-pole 4-magnet configuration for the left and right sides. In addition, as the left and right sides are independently generated, there is essentially no interference between channels, and excellent separation characteristics are obtained.In this MC cartridge, the magnetic circuit and needle are separated and independent, so the needle exchange can be done as easily as MM type.The cabinet uses a coaxial suspension.In this system, the motor and tone arm are fixed to a single underboard, and the whole underboard is spring supported, preventing harmful resonance and suppressing howling.In addition, by adopting a thin design of 96 mm, the area that receives sound pressure is reduced and excellent howling resistance is realized.Rotational speed can be finely adjusted."

name: Pioneer
description: "A full auto player that uses an SH rotor type coreless motor.PL 470 is a full auto player that can perform auto lead in, Oatley turn, auto cut and auto repeat without touching the tone arm.An SH rotor type coreless motor is used as the drive motor.In the SH-rotor system, the rotor support point, which used to be located at the bottom of the motor, is moved just below the turntable so that the center of gravity of the turntable almost coincides with the support point. This eliminates from the root the reverse cone motion and the rotational slippage caused by the lubricating oil used between the shaft and the bearing. In addition, the bare nature of the motor before the servo was applied is improved, and the rotation of the turntable is stabilized. In addition, parts such as shafts and bearings are also improved in accuracy of micron order or less by utilizing Pioneer's precision processing technology, and reliability and durability are improved.The SH rotor type coreless motor realizes smooth rotational torque without cogging by using a coreless structure in which a driving coil is an empty core and a flat coil is used to generate a magnetic field without using a core. In addition, the diameter of the coil for generating the magnetic field is increased, a thin flat coil is used for the coil, and the power efficiency required for torque generation is improved by using Pioneer's original new IC, and high torque is realized.The servo circuit uses a quartz PLL system that controls the phase difference by comparing the reference signal of the crystal oscillator with the speed detection signal of the motor.In order to improve the accuracy and reliability of the PL 470, a sample-and-hold type high-gain F-V converter, which is highly stable against ripple (erroneous signal), has been developed as a single-chip IC, and is used in the frequency control circuit and phase control circuit.The speed detection mechanism of the motor itself uses an all-round integration method. In this method, the AC signal obtained by the pole magnetized at equal intervals over the whole circumference of the lower surface of the rotor magnet and the print pattern coil with the same number of poles attached opposite to each other is integrated over the whole circumference to improve reliability. In addition, a special large magnet is used, and by doubling the magnetized magnetic pulse from the conventional 200 pole to 400 pole, it is possible to quickly apply servo against load fluctuation, and dynamic load characteristics are greatly improved.We have also adopted a brushless motor pole switching circuit that uses a Hall element developed by Pioneer.A straight arm using carbon graphite is adopted for the tone arm.This arm realizes high rigidity, low mass and no resonance by forming carbon graphite into a straight pipe with high mechanical stability and combining it with aluminum base.Carbon fiber composite material is used for the head shell to increase strength and reduce weight.High-purity oxygen-free copper wires are used in the signal transmission system to improve sound quality.The cartridge is equipped with a high power MC cartridge that can be used in the MM position.This cartridge uses Pioneer's independently developed 6-pole 4-magnet configuration for the left and right sides. Samarium-cobalt magnets with high energy product (BHmax) are placed opposite to each other in the same pole. As a result, a high magnetic flux of up to 10,000 Gauss can be obtained, and power is efficiently generated linearly from small amplitude to large amplitude. In addition, as the left and right sides are independently generated, there is essentially no interference between channels, and excellent separation characteristics are obtained.In this MC cartridge, the magnetic circuit and needle are separated and independent, so the needle exchange can be done as easily as MM type.The cabinet uses a coaxial suspension.In this system, the motor and tone arm are fixed to a single underboard, and the whole underboard is spring supported, preventing harmful resonance and suppressing howling.The operation buttons are all front operation type located on the front panel for improved operability.Equipped with a quick play mechanism that starts rotating the turntable when the tone arm is moved onto the record board, and with a quick stop climate that stops rotating when the tone arm is returned to the arm rest.Since the arm lifter is operated by a dedicated DC motor during manual operation, smooth and highly reliable elevation operation is possible.The exterior is finished in champagne gold."

name: Pioneer
description: "Linear tracking player equipped with linear DD arm.It is equipped with a linear DD arm that combines the basic performance of the linear tracking system with proprietary technology.While the conventional linear tracking method has advantages such as 0 tracking error, it has a disadvantage that the SN ratio is poor and the playback sound is muddy. This eliminates mechanical contact and eliminates vibration and other problems that cause sound quality degradation.In addition, the combination with an electronic full auto mechanism realizes a quiet and highly accurate arm drive.The cartridge is equipped with an MC cartridge with a new structure developed by Pioneer.This cartridge has a high output of 1.5 mV thanks to its efficient power generation mechanism, so it does not need a dedicated amplifier or head amplifier and can be connected directly to the MM position of the amplifier.In addition, this new structure has been thoroughly simplified, making it easy to replace needles, which was difficult with conventional MC cartridges.An SH rotor type coreless motor is used as the drive motor.By using a coreless motor without cogging and an SH rotor system with improved rotational accuracy, the bare characteristics of the motor are dramatically improved and excellent characteristics are realized.In addition, a quartz PLL is used in the servo circuit to improve stability and load resistance.Carbon graphite, which is lightweight and highly rigid, is used for the arm pipe. Carbon fiber is also used for the head shell, and a low mass tone arm with almost no resonance is realized. In addition, the theory of mass concentration is applied to the arm structure, and excellent traceability is exhibited.Oxygen-free copper wires are used for internal lead wires to improve sound quality.This is the first linear player in this class to be equipped with a universal tone arm, and most commercially available cartridges can be mounted.A high-precision electronic full auto mechanism is adopted, and a newly developed microcomputer controls linear tracking operation and rotation / stop / rotation speed switching of the phono motor."

name: Pioneer
description: "A record player that uses a brushless DC servo motor and carbon fiber reinforced arm.The drive motor is a brushless DC servo D. D. motor using a Hall element.The motor used in the PL 1800 is a brushless type. Three hall elements detect the position of magnetic signals magnetized on the inner surface of the rotor in a contactless manner. Changes in magnetic field due to rotation are reliably converted into changes in current. In addition, since it is a high-torque type with a starting torque of 1kg-cm, start-up time is fast.The servo circuit uses a magnetic pulse detection type.In this system, a magnetic pulse for velocity detection is magnetized on the lower surface of the rotor, and a printed circuit board with a pulse pattern is installed on the lower surface facing the magnetic pulse. The frequency generated by the rotation of the rotor is detected and an AC signal is sent to the servo circuit. This system has extremely low impedance of the signal source and high stability against changes in temperature and humidity.The turntable has a dynamically balanced inertial mass of 280kg-cm2Turntable is adopted.This turntable, shaft and bearing are carefully polished by an automatic precision machine to obtain high accuracy.The strobe lights on the periphery of the turntable are lit by a waveform shaping circuit, and are easier to see than conventional strobe lights.The power supply to the drive circuit is from a stable circuit with a large current capacity, and stability is improved by providing sufficient temperature compensation. Stable values for temperature drift and time drift are also obtained.The tone arm uses a reinforced pipe made of carbon fiber. By weaving long carbon fiber into a mesh, we have succeeded in increasing the strength against twisting and reducing the effective mass. This reduces the moment of inertia of the arm to a very small value, increases the ability to follow the sound groove, and also improves the partial resonance that occurs in the middle range.The head shell also uses carbon fiber to reduce the moment of inertia.A special angular contact bearing has been adopted for the horizontal and vertical rotating part of the arm. This reduces friction and improves tracing capability. In addition, milling and precision polishing are applied to the finish to prevent the degradation of mid-range characteristics caused by the rattling of the bearing part.In addition, the anti-skating mechanism uses a lever type that uses two angular contact bearings, and it is processed without losing horizontal sensitivity.This mechanism has the advantages of simple structure, high stability during use, and no aging.The cabinet uses a rigid fiberboard (MDF) that extracts only the hardest fiber (cellulose) of all wood and compresses it into a 20-mm-thick plate. This plate is used and reinforced effectively to reduce howling.Uses an insulator that combines specially shaped rubber and aluminum die-cast.The height of this insulator is adjustable.The height and vertical tracking angle of the arm can be adjusted.Fine speed adjustment is possible within � 6%.Equipped with pin jack output terminal for easy attachment and detachment of output cord.Also comes with a low-capacity cord (50 pf or less / 1m)."

name: Pioneer
description: "An armless player with a brushless DC servo direct drive hole motor.The motor is a direct drive phono motor that uses a Hall element.In place of the brush, which was indispensable for conventional DC motors, we applied the hole stopping method developed by Pioneer to the magnetic field detection of the switching mechanism. This reduces vibration compared with DC motors with mechanical switching mechanism, and improves S/N and durability.In addition, the motor rotates at 33 1/3 Ï‰ 45 rpm, which is the same as the number of revolutions of the record. Since the direct drive system directly drives the turntable, there is no intermediate reduction mechanism that causes uneven rotation, and excellent characteristics are obtained.The Hall element is a kind of semiconductor. It is a cross-shaped thin film metal made of N-type Insb alloy. It uses the ""Hall effect"" in which a voltage is generated between two terminals when an electric current flows through two terminals and a magnetic force is applied at a right angle to the other two terminals to convert magnetism into electricity.Pioneer has developed a new manufacturing method called the vacuum deposition method, and has reduced the thickness from the previous limit of 30-50 Ï‰ m to 0.8 Ï‰ m, realizing a low-cost and small-size Hall element.Equipped with a DC servo mechanism to control the rotation accurately at all times.In this control circuit, the rotation is automatically controlled by a capacitor-type oscillator that is not affected by changes in the ambient temperature or by the magnetic force of the rotor magnet, thus maintaining a stable rotational speed.Equipped with a brake mechanism that instantly stops the turntable when the power switch is turned off.A purely electronic system is used for changing the rotational speed, and the speed can be finely adjusted within a range of � 4% while watching the strobe light carved on the outer circumference of the turntable.The flash lamp is equipped with a flashing switch so that it can be turned off when it is unnecessary.The cabinet is a double-walled 30mm-thick cabinet with a combination of plywood and metal base with a rosewood natural wood wood finish.A large insulator is used to reduce howling and external vibration.In addition, the height can be freely adjusted, and the level can be adjusted while looking at the level of the panel.You can attach any tone arm to the attached panel and use it. name: Pioneer
description: "The development and installation of the Linear D. D> arm solves the problem that had been a bottleneck until now.The Linear D. D. Arm developed by Pioneer Shinkai is mounted in order to move the strong arm base horizontally precisely and quietly. By this, factors that cause harmful noise and vibration are completely eliminated.The Linear D. D. arm is structurally very simple because the magnetic repulsion force generated by electrical energy can be directly converted into linear motion. Unlike conventional systems, the arm base can be directly driven without any transmission mechanism such as a rotary motor, gears, belts, or strings.Record sound In order to ensure that the arm base follows the movement of the needle tip that traces the groove, we have adopted a contactless arm shift detection mechanism that combines a cds and a lamp at the arm mounting part. By adding this detection output to a differential amplifier, we constitute a servo system that supplies the required amount of current.Moreover, since this arm shift detection angle is a small angle of 0.2 degrees, quick correction is possible. Moreover, since the arm shift detection mechanism makes accurate response correction not only in the inner circumferential direction of the record but also in the outer circumferential direction, there is no need to worry about unnecessary lateral pressure on the needle tip even if a record with eccentricity is traced, and high traceability is achieved.In the linear D. D. arm, a two way servo system is activated by the output voltage of the generator linked to the rotary arm feed section to enable smooth arm feed.All you need to do is to lightly touch the arm feed knob and turn it. description: "Armless player that adopts quartz PLL system.Universal type arm mounting board is adopted, and domestic and overseas tone arms except for 16 inch long arm can be used.The mounting board uses laminated plywood with a metallic finish for easy drilling.The turntable uses a direct drive system, and the motor shaft directly drives the turntable without passing through a transmission mechanism.A high-torque brushless DC servo hole motor is used hole motor.The magnetic pole switching (switching circuit), which greatly influences the performance of the DD motor itself, adopts a brushless type using three Hall elements developed by Pioneer's original manufacturing method, and realizes high S/N and reliability.The XLC 1850 uses a quartz PLL system for the servo circuit with high detection accuracy. By comparing the output pulse of the generator attached to the rotating shaft of the motor with the pulse of the reference signal using a crystal, not only the frequency difference between the two is detected, but also the phase difference (time difference between lead and lag) is detected and the rotation speed is controlled. This enables accurate detection of long and weak speed changes that were considered difficult to detect with conventional methods, and always maintains the correct rotation speed.In place of the conventional strobe, a direct-reading pitch indicator is used to indicate the rotational speed during fine adjustment of speed.Since the deviation from the exact number of revolutions can be read directly in numerical values, it is easy to compare and play records at the same pitch and to confirm when the pitch of a record matches the pitch of an instrument.When the Quartz Lock is ON, this indicator is synchronized with the correct rotation speed with the word ""Quartz"" lit. When the brake is applied by an external force, the lamp goes out. When the Quartz Lock is OFF, the memory of the pitch indicator lights. The rotation speed of the turntable is measured by a combination of a Schmidt circuit and an integrating circuit for driving the meter, and the rotation speed can be displayed in analog form.The volume for fine adjustment has a special resistance curve so that it can turn in the same sense as the indicated angle of the meter at the time of adjustment, taking usability into consideration.Equipped with quick stop mechanism for electronic devices.In this system, when the stop button is pressed, the control circuit switches to generate torque to rotate the motor in the opposite direction and applies the brake rapidly. When the rotation is almost stopped, the power is turned off and the turntable stops.This drive circuit responds quickly when the motor speed is increased by electronic braking, and when the speed is changed from 45 rpm to 33 1/3rpm, servo is also activated and constant speed rotation is achieved immediately.By integrating the control circuit and drive circuit into an IC, unstable elements that cause performance degradation are eliminated.A bipolar IC is used for the drive circuit and a MOS IC is used for the control circuit.The cabinet is made of aluminum die cast with a thickness of 4 mm and a weight of 4.7 kg, and has a structure to prevent howling by analyzing resonance mode.The cabinet has a box structure with 24 ribs around it. In addition, a new material with low Q (low resonance) is used for the bottom cover. In addition, an insulator made of a combination of special rubber and die-cast solid is directly attached to the cabinet body howling margin by 3 db.A cut-core transformer is used for the power supply.The cut-core transformer has low leakage flux and excellent regulation. By floating mounting the transformer on the cabinet board, the effect of noise on sound quality is suppressed.A push type is used for the operation part.Concentrated layout on a single die-cast panel enables one touch operation.A removable transparent acrylic dust cover is used for the dust cover.Comes with one touch universal arm rest.Installation is one touch type and can be installed in any position by adhesive tape at the bottom.

name: Pioneer
description: "A full auto player with a quartz PLL servo circuit.Quartz PLL is used for the servo circuit.In this method, the motor rotation speed is kept constant by comparing the pulses from the ??????? mounted on the motor rotation shaft with the pulses from the reference signal generator and detecting the phase difference (time difference between lead and delay). This enables accurate detection of minute speed changes with long periods, which were considered difficult to detect with conventional methods, and maintains the correct rotation speed at all times. In the quartz PLL method, a crystal is used as the oscillator of the reference signal generator, and a high-precision reference signal is obtained.The XL-A700 uses an IC circuit to increase the reliability of the circuit itself. Bipolar ICs are used for the drive circuit and MOS ICs are used for the control circuit.A bi-directional drive circuit is adopted for the drive circuit, and it can operate in both forward and reverse directions, so quick response is possible even when the motor speed increases.A brushless DC servo hole motor is used as the drive motor.This motor has high S/N and high durability by applying the functions of three Hall elements developed by Pioneer in the magnetic pole switching process.The turntable has a diameter of 32.4 cm and an inertial mass of 340kg-cm.2Precision machining turntable has been adopted.In addition, excellent characteristics have been obtained by using precision processed shafts and bearings.The strobe light is equipped with a waveform shaping circuit. In this circuit, the oscillation frequency (3 MHz band) of the crystal oscillator is divided by an electronic circuit to light it. This circuit eliminates the adverse effect of fluctuations in the power supply frequency. In addition, when the number of revolutions is switched, the frequency division ratio is changed to enable adjustment in one stripe pattern.The servo circuit also contains a highly accurate CR oscillator, enabling phase control even when quartz is turned off.You can also compare records at the same pitch and adjust the pitch of the records to match the pitch of the instrument. When the rotational speed is finely adjusted by 1%, 5.5 stripes flow at 33 1/3rpm and 7.5 stripes flow at 45 rpm in 10 seconds. Since the rotational speed fine adjustment range is � 6%, it can be adjusted up to about a semitone.Equipped with a full auto mechanism.In addition to the motor for driving the turntable, the XL-A700 uses a precision gear motor exclusively for the automatic operation of the arm, so that no load is applied to the rotating system and high reliability and durability are obtained.The full auto mechanism allows for auto return, auto cut and repeat performance. It also has a quick play function that automatically turns on when the arm is moved onto the record board by hand.The return detection mechanism of the XL-A700 uses an optical system instead of the conventional mechanical system.The XL-A700 uses an LED to illuminate the overlapping position of the movable slit, and uses a phototransistor to detect light transmission and light shielding. The XL-A 200 uses a phototransistor to detect the position of the arm.S-shaped pipe arm is used for the tone arm.In addition to reducing the effective mass of this arm, an angular contact bearing is used for the vertical and horizontal rotating parts to reduce friction and obtain high sensitivity. In addition, a 6t aluminum panel with sufficient strength is used for the mounting base of the arm, and the inside of the cabinet is reinforced with thick steel plate (6 mm thick, 700g) to protect the tone arm from howling.MM type cartridge PC 330 / II is used.This cartridge realizes a light mass vibration system by combining a special heat-treated titanium pipe cantilever, rare-earth cobalt magnet, and special diamond needle. In addition, by adopting a single-end support system, high-frequency mechanical impedance can be kept low, improving sound quality.In addition, parts such as aluminum stylus knob and aluminum die-cast frame are used to reduce resonance.In the cabinet, the motor body, full-auto mechanism, tone arm, etc. are firmly fixed to a highly rigid aluminum die-cast frame to obtain high accuracy over a long period of time.By combining the rigidity of the die-cast frame with a hard plywood with moderate internal loss, howling and resonance are prevented.Uses a large insulator combining special rubber and die-cast solid.The level of this insulator can be adjusted (0.5 mm variable per one revolution of the insulator).Equipped with anti-skating mechanism and arm elevation mechanism."

name: Pioneer
description: "A record player equipped with a full auto mechanism with an auto size selector.Equipped with an autosize selector that automatically detects the record size.The XL-A800 uses an optical system. There are three detection holes on the turntable, and a phototransistor is placed under the holes to determine the presence or absence of a record and the size of the record by the emitted light. It adopts a quick start mechanism in which the turntable starts rotating when the arm is moved on the record board with the finger tip, and a quick stop mechanism in which the turntable stops rotating when it is returned to the arm rest.A newly developed quartz PLL Hall motor is used as the drive motor.The speed detection mechanism of the XL-A800 is a highly accurate system that magnetizes 200 poles at equal intervals on the lower surface of the rotor magnet, generates an AC signal by a print pattern coil installed facing the rotor magnet, and integrates this signal over the whole circumference.In addition, we have adopted a brushless DC servo Hall motor that uses a Hall element for changing the magnetic pole of the motor to suppress uneven rotation.The tone arm uses a mass concentration system in which the main weight is placed close to the rotating shaft to reduce the moment of inertia of the arm and achieve high trackability. In addition, it is equipped with a gimbal support bearing.Adopts a magnesium die-cast head shell.We have adopted a MM type cartridge using a beryllium evaporated cantilever.An aluminum die-cast cabinet with coaxial suspension (coaxial suspension system) has been adopted for the cabinet to improve the howling resistance.Equipped with a butyl rubber turntable seat.Front operation system is adopted and arm operation (auto lead-in, auto cut, Oatley peat) can be performed while the acrylic cover is closed."

name: Pioneer
description: "A speaker system developed taking advantage of the characteristics of Pioneer's studio monitor.It uses an in-line coaxial arrangement double woofer with a tweeter at the center and a woofer at the top and bottom to obtain excellent low-sound reproduction capability and phase characteristics.Instead of arranging each unit vertically and vertically symmetrically, the enclosure reinforcement and the duct of the bass reflex are arranged vertically and vertically symmetrically. This reduces the interference of the vertical standing wave generated inside the enclosure and improves the resolution of the low sound range.Two 14 cm cone type woofers with a polymer film laminate diaphragm are used for the low range, and each of them is driven in parallel.In addition, each woofer is equipped with a midship mount, so that vibration of the woofer is not directly transmitted to the baffle plate, and it is fixed to the inner baffle installed in the enclosure.In addition, it has a low magnetic leakage design, and the effect on the CRT is suppressed.A 2.5 cm dome type tweeter using ceramic carbon with carbon purity of 99.9% is adopted for the high range.The network is electrically symmetrical with low-pass filters inserted into each woofer.This makes the motion of the two woofers as equal as possible and reduces the influence between the woofers.The baffle plate is 18 mm thick. The round baffle suppresses the diffraction phenomenon of sound. In addition, the surface is covered with a felt sheet to suppress the reflection of sound in the high frequency range.The speaker stand sold separately can be adjusted acoustically by putting the attached sand bag and sound absorbing material inside."

name: Pioneer
description: "This is an improved speaker system of the S-55twin, which follows the characteristics of the vertical twin system and is more complete as a speaker system.It adopts a vertical twin system and improves low sound reproduction by using two woofers.In addition, since the acoustic energy of the two woofer matches the axis of the tweeter, the sound connection from the low range to the high range is smooth, and directivity and phase characteristics are excellent.In addition, not only the unit but also the enclosure reinforcement and bass reflex duct are laid out symmetrically in the vertical direction. This reduces the interference of vertical standing waves generated inside the enclosure and improves resolution in the low-frequency range.For the low range, two 14 cm cone-shaped woofers with high rigidity cone laminated with polymer film are used.Even if it is set adjacent to a TV monitor, it is designed so that color unevenness does not occur.A dome type tweeter using a 2.5 cm ceramic carbon diaphragm with carbon purity of 99.9% is adopted for the high range.Alnico magnet is used for the magnetic circuit.In order to prevent the vibration of each unit from being transmitted to the baffle through the frame, a midship mounting system is adopted.The magnetic circuit of each unit is fixed to the inner baffle, which reduces the transmission of unnecessary vibration from the unit and suppresses unnecessary vibration of the baffle.In addition, in order to reduce reflection and diffraction phenomenon of sound, round baffle plate is adopted, and in addition, suede finish is applied to the baffle surface.The speaker terminal is bi-wired and can be fed by a dedicated cord by separating the low and high frequency circuits.There was a speaker stand CP-55 sold separately. This stand can be integrated with the S-55twinSD by screw fastening.In addition, it comes with a sandbag (plastic bag) that can be inserted into the legs for acoustic tuning."

name: Pioneer
description: "A vertical twin tall boy speaker system developed by inheriting the technology cultivated in the development of the S-99twin.Vertical twin system is adopted aiming at the sense of localization of real sound image.By placing the upper and lower woofers around the center of the tweeter, the acoustic energy of the two woofers matches the axis of the tweeter, making the sound connection between the low and high tones smooth, and obtaining a clear sense of localization of sound image.In addition, horizontal directivity is improved by in-line coaxial arrangement k and k.Each unit inherits the technologies developed in Technical Audio Devices (TAD).For the low range, pulp corn is laminated with polymer film, and in addition, 2 18 cm cone type woofers with anti-magnetic design are adopted.A 2.5 cm ceramic carbon dome type tweeter with an alnico magnet for the magnetic circuit is adopted for the high range.The protective net of the tweeter is made of copper with low resonance sharpness.Midship mount is used to prevent excessive vibration of the speaker unit from being transmitted to the baffle.Both the woofer and tweeter are secured to the inner baffle in the enclosure to prevent unwanted vibrations from being transmitted directly to the baffle.In addition, the baffle uses an elliptic curve round baffle to obtain a natural sound field and sound image orientation.In addition, suede packing is attached around the tweeter to reduce high-frequency reflections and excessive vibration of the baffle.The network is separate for woofer and tweeter to prevent mutual magnetic interference.In addition, the network board for the woofer is floated from the enclosure to reduce the effect of vibration on the enclosure.The speaker jacks can be used as a by-wire connection."

name: Pioneer
description: "Tall boy type speaker system using vertical twin system.In the vertical twin system with a tweeter in the center and two upper and lower woofers in between, the sound energy of the two woofers matches the axis of the tweeter, so that the sound from low to high range can be heard as if it is centered on the tweeter.As a result, sound field and clear sound localization.In addition, the new technology ""Wave Surface Control Technology"" developed in the S-1000twin is employed. It scientifically clarifies how the surface of sound spreads, and takes into consideration four points : ""Control the woofer and the tweeter on the time axis,"" ""Control the directivity,"" ""Control the electrical phase,"" and ""Control the wave surface diffraction of the baffle."" It adjusts the mounting position of the tweeter.As a result, excellent sound field reproduction and sound image localization have been realized.For the low range, it uses 2 18 cm cone type woofers laminated with polymer film on pulp cone which is also used in TAD (Technical Audio Devices) unit.In addition, we have conducted a major review, such as increasing the rigidity of the diaphragm and improving the frame structure. We have also improved the magnetic flux density of the magnetic circuit by approximately 5%.This realizes a low sound with a scale.A 2.5 cm ceramic carbon dome tweeter with a W. F. (wave front) director with wave front control technology is adopted for the high frequency range.The energy response with the woofer is controlled on the time axis, and the directivity is controlled by the horn shape.As a result, the wave surface at the listening position of the viewer matches.In addition, a neodymium magnet is used in the magnetic circuit to realize a smaller size and higher density. As a result, it can be mounted in the baffle plate, reducing the influence of sound pressure inside the enclosure.In addition, the junction with the W. F. director is also a floating structure to block unwanted vibration.In addition, the director is molded with a special elastic material that does not generate excessive vibration and absorbs its own vibration as well.In order to prevent mutual interference of each unit, the network is distributed separately for the woofer and the tweeter.In addition, the network board for the woofer is floated from the enclosure to reduce the effect of vibrations from the enclosure.In addition, transmission loss is reduced by caulking without using solder and choke coil and cord using OFC wire.The enclosure uses a midship mounting method to avoid transmitting excessive vibration of the unit to the baffle.The woofer is fixed to an inner baffle inside the enclosure, and the tweeter is fixed from the back side of the baffle via a spacer.This prevents mutual interference between units and further reduces the occurrence of unnecessary vibration of the baffle.In addition, a 50 mm thick type baffle has been adopted, and by taking a large round treatment, a natural sound field feeling with less diffraction phenomenon is obtained.The speaker terminal can be bi-wired."

name: Pioneer
description: "This is a tall boy type speaker system that uses a vertical twin system and inherits the technology developed by Pioneer in monitor speaker technology.It uses a vertical twin system which is an in-line coaxial arrangement double woofer system with a tweeter at the center and a woofer at the top and bottom.This ensures that the acoustic energy of the two woofers is centered and aligned with the axis of the tweeter, so that all sounds from low to high frequencies are played around the tweeter.As a result, excellent directivity and phase characteristics have been achieved.For the lower range, we use two 20 cm cone-shaped woofers with a diaphragm laminated with polymer film based on the cone used in TAD (Technical Audio Devices).Alnico magnet is used for the magnetic circuit.A 3-cm dome type tweeter using a ceramic carbon diaphragm, a new material with carbon purity of 99.9%, is adopted for the high frequency band.An alnico magnet is used for the magnetic circuit as well as the low frequency.Each unit is mounted using the midship mount method.Each unit is fixed to an inner baffle installed inside the enclosure to avoid transmitting unwanted vibrations generated by the unit to the baffle.In addition, the concept of non-resonance is pursued, and the shield of the speaker frame is firmly fixed by a helper.In addition to the high rigidity of the enclosure, a floating top is adopted to suppress unnecessary vibration of the top plate. name: S5
description: "A speaker system that uses a unit that inherits the design philosophy of Technical Aucio Devices (TAD) and adopts a vertical twin system as a system that draws out the potential of this unit.The S5 uses a vertical twin system with a horn at the center and a woofer at the top and bottom.In this system, the acoustic energy of the two woofers is concentrated in the center and coincides with the horn axis, so that the range from low to high frequencies becomes a virtual co-axis centered on the horn, improving the sense of sound localization.In addition, it has excellent horizontal directivity, and the quick response of the woofer gives a crisp low sound.Two newly developed 25 cm cone type woofers are installed in the lower range.By combining a magnetic circuit using an alnico magnet with a lightweight vibration system, we have ensured linearity that does not lose balance from low volume to high input. In addition, by thoroughly increasing the initial motion sensitivity of the vibration support system, we have improved the balance at low volume, which was considered difficult in the past.In addition, by combining a special aging cone and a vibration system with good linearity, it is designed to resist changes over time.A horn type tweeter combining a driver unit and a wooden horn is mounted in the high range.The driver unit uses a powerful alnico magnetic circuit with a magnetic flux density of 18,000 gauss and a lightweight, high-hardness beryllium diaphragm with a diameter of 4.8 cm.The horn uses a newly developed wood horn to bring out the wide-band characteristics of the driver unit. It is made of Painted maple with excellent sound quality and is finished by hand. It solves the problems of high sensitivity and directional control in the wide band.The connection between the network and the unit is directly connected by crimping without using terminals. In particular, the Woofer unit is crimped even to the Kinshi line without using solder. Furthermore, the dedicated circuit is used for each woofer to prevent back-electromotive force interference between the woofers.In addition, oxygen-free copper wires are used for the choke coil and wire cord, and vibration countermeasures are applied to each material and cord to control resonance and noise. In addition, the wiring is also taken into consideration so that crosstalk between elements and wire cords does not adversely affect the wiring. The input to the network is directly and uniformly transmitted by radial power supply system.Particular attention has been paid to the material of the enclosure as well. The top plate and baffle plate upper part are made of Birds Eye Maple (maple), the other parts are made of walnut, and oil stain finish is applied.The structure is a tall boy type floor type. The baffle plate has an elliptic curve round baffle with a large arc to reduce sound reflection and diffraction phenomena.In addition, in order to prevent the vibration of each unit from interfering with each other by the baffle and making the sound muddy, all units are firmly fixed by the midship mount. In addition, a shield frame and a floating top are provided to eliminate resonance.The speaker terminal supports a bi-wired connection that separates the high-frequency and low-frequency circuits for independent power supply, and is equipped with a short bar so that it can be used as a single speaker terminal.The emblem is made of natural precious wood with laser processing."

name: Pioneer
description: "A pre-main amplifier developed with new elements and new circuits to realize the ""Magniwide power range"" concept of full power reproduction at low distortion rate over an ultra-wide band.The A-0012 uses a group transistor RET with superior high-frequency switching characteristics. This device is made by combining hundreds of small transistors with superior high-frequency characteristics in parallel. It has high breakdown strength and can produce high output at high frequencies with low distortion.In addition, a DC amplifier configuration has been adopted to improve the low-frequency characteristics, extending the frequency characteristics to the ultra-low frequency range and improving the phase characteristics in the mid-low frequency range.The power supply consists of a large left and right independent transformer with an emphasis on dynamic characteristics and a 18,000 Ï‰ Fx4 capacitor.In addition, the power section through which a large current flows and the speaker terminals are wired on extremely thick Line 14 with a resistance value that is 1/4 of the conventional thick line. In addition, pure copper is used for the ground line of the power capacitor, and at the same time, the copper foil on the printed circuit board of each circuit is doubled to 70 Ï‰ thick, making for a thorough low-impedance design.It uses class AB operation and operates up to 3W, which accounts for most of the music signal, at class A, which has an established reputation for sound quality, with essentially no switching distortion or crossover distortion.In addition, since the power utilization factor is high efficiency close to that of general class B amplifiers, it is possible to obtain a dynamic range of up to 120W during peak playback.It has a 4 dc configuration consisting of an MC head amplifier, an equalizer amplifier, a flat amplifier, and a power amplifier. If a buffer amplifier is included, it can be called a 5 dc amplifier.Since all amplification stages are DC, there is no capacitor that causes phase distortion in the NFB loop of the amplifier circuit, and it has flat phase characteristics over a wide band and stable operation. It also improves transient response characteristics including the damping of back electromotive force from the speaker.In the equalizer amplifier section, a low-noise dual FET with excellent noise characteristics is used in the first stage differential section.In the dual FET, the entire element has a high SN ratio, and at the same time, a higher SN ratio is obtained by suppressing the voltage between the drain and gate of the FET by cascade connection to prevent generation of noise.The whole MC head amplifier section is divided into two systems. The first stage parallel connection symmetrical 3-stage direct-coupled A-class SEPP-DC amplifier is composed of two newly developed low-noise NPN and PNP transistors connected in parallel. It is designed to improve linearity when NFB is not applied by focusing on bare characteristics.In addition, the SN ratio is improved by adopting symmetrical circuit configuration.All stages of the flat amplifier section are DC to improve sound quality.In addition, a flat amplifier and bypass switch are installed in order to pursue higher purity playback sound. By jumping from a flat amplifier, a buffer amplifier and a power amplifier can be connected directly.Equipped with a change-over switch that can independently select 5 types of load resistance and 5 types of load capacity and can set a total of 25 types of cartridge load.In addition to the main control of the standard bass / treble, it is equipped with a twin-tone control with an ultra-low and ultra-high range control knob as a sub-control.It is also equipped with a tone ON-OFF switch that can obtain flat characteristics by bypassing the tone control circuit.Equipped with a subsonic filter that allows slope switching.The volume uses a continuously variable precision volume of decibel display with excellent corrosion resistance gold-plated sliding elements and terminals.The Phono terminal is gold-plated.Equipped with audio muting.A dedicated parent-child contact relay for each of speakers A and B is used for the protection circuit.Equipped with split switches for pre-part and power part, can be used separately."

description: "This pre-main amplifier was developed based on the concept of wide range technology that expresses the nuance of music by focusing on sound quality outside the audible band.It is equipped with a newly developed wide-range circuit for stable amplification of input signals from digital devices.This is a simple circuit that uses a single-stage amplifier circuit to obtain the required gain. It has excellent current linearity and flat output impedance from low to high range.This allows for accurate reproduction and a spacious speaker drive over a wide bandwidth.In order to enhance the power supply capability, we have adopted a large power transformer in the power supply section to suppress the deterioration of sound quality caused by the leakage flux generated by the transformer.In order to prevent the generation of sound nigori due to the mutual interference of each circuit, the power supply section and power amplifier section are shielded, and the adjacent power amplifier section and voltage amplifier section are shielded and separated by a newly developed Aero heat sink. This 3 box chamber structure is adopted.The newly developed Aero heat sink has been adopted as the heat sink, and since there is no parallel face facing the structure itself, standing waves are hardly generated.In addition, resonance, which is the nigori of sound quality, is suppressed, and high heat transfer effect is obtained by extending two sheets at a time from the back surface of the mounting part of the fin and power transistor. name: Pioneer
description: "This is a pre-main amplifier that inherits the technology of high-end machines.The chassis layout has a symmetrical twin monaural structure.In addition to the symmetrical layout of the internal circuit and structure represented by the twin transformer, the A-05 has a fully symmetrical structure including the front panel, rear panel, and volume, so that the environment such as current, magnetic field, temperature distribution, and mechanical stress distribution can be made uniform. This minimizes the characteristic error of L/R caused by parts.In addition, all compromises have been made to simplify the circuit, and the signal path has been straightened to achieve higher quality playback.Wide-range linear circuit ver. 5 is adopted to improve the time axis characteristics of the transmission system.Conventional amplifier circuits are equipped with choke coils for the speaker output terminals, capacitors for each input terminal, and phase compensation capacitors to ensure stability against high frequencies. However, these parts prevent the simplification of the circuit and the amplification of pure sound. The choke coil adversely affects the output impedance in the high frequency range, and the phase compensation capacitor adversely affects the sound quality.In order to solve this problem, the wide-range linear circuit is designed to obtain the necessary gain by one stage amplification using a current feedback circuit, and the damping factor is made flat over a wide range to obtain excellent speaker drive power.Dedicated tuning parts such as custom-designed volume and original organic semiconductor condenser are adopted.The power transformer uses a toroidal transformer with an oriented core.The core section without corners suppresses the generation of beat and improves the S/N feeling.It is equipped with a gain selector to cut off the excess gain and increase the purity of the sound when playing at a small volume.There are two selector positions, 40 dB and 26 dB. The 40 dB position gives you more power, and the 26 dB position gives you more natural music playback.The phono equalizer uses a single-chip dual FET as its input circuit.An OFC power cord is used for the power cable, and external noise is eliminated by drawing the power cord from directly under the power transformer.Uses gold-plated input / output terminals.A large vise type speaker terminal with low transmission loss is adopted."

name: Pioneer
description: "Stereo pre-main amplifier with symmetrical twin monaural structure.In order to obtain realistic and rich stereo images, the A-07 has a symmetrical structure that includes CFCs, rear panels and volume in addition to the symmetrical layout of the internal circuit as represented by the twin transformer. This makes the environment such as current, magnetic field, temperature distribution, and mechanical stress distribution uniform, and minimizes left and right characteristic errors caused by parts.The A-07 is equipped with a wide-range linear circuit that obtains the required gain by one stage amplification using a current feedback circuit. This circuit flattens the damping factor over a wide range and realizes a reliable speaker drive. In addition, the stability of the circuit itself is enhanced by the adoption of a cross-array power stage, a newly developed output stage with excellent power linearity and temperature stability.As a result, superior high-frequency characteristics have been obtained, phase characteristics have been dramatically improved, and characteristics that are resistant to high-frequency noise have been realized.Uses carefully selected high-reliability parts.In addition to the custom-made polypropylene film condenser with thorough tuning of sound quality, we have adopted winding resistance, mold resistance and sealed relays that ensure stability regardless of the operating environment to achieve high accuracy and reliability.In addition, we have adopted a high-precision attenuator volume that is not easily affected by minute vibrations, enabling accurate and stable control by reducing left-right interlocking errors.Each block is separated by a frame in which each block is separated by a frame. Mutual interference between blocks is eliminated by shielding the amplifier, power supply and control.The rear panel has pin jacks arranged radially around the ground, which is the operation standard of the amplifier, to improve electrical stability. In addition, an aero-wing heat sink with excellent heat dissipation and vibration damping characteristics is adopted. The high heat transfer effect equalizes the temperature of the power transistor, while eliminating parallel planes in the structure itself to suppress standing waves and resonances that cause noise turbidity.Advanced Direct Construction is used to keep the signal path as simple as possible.In this method, the signal selected by the signal switching relay immediately after the input terminal is input to a single board connected to the volume and the amplifier circuit by the shortest length, thereby further shortening the signal path and improving electrical stability.It is equipped with a gain selector.This is a function to switch the gain of the amplifier to make the most of the output of the connected source device. When listening at a low volume or using a high-efficiency speaker, the S/N ratio can be improved by setting it to the 26 dB position, enabling fine volume control.An insulated circuit is adopted in which the electric circuit, control circuit and power supply section of both left and right channels are electrically independent. This circuit uses a photocoupler to eliminate interference caused by current loops between circuits.The Phono equalizer uses a single-chip dual-FET input configuration.Uses highly reliable gold-plated input terminal.The power cable is drawn from directly under the power transformer to reduce the influence of external noise, and large-capacity extra-thick OFC cable is used for wire material.A large vise type speaker terminal is adopted."
