name: Pioneer
description: "Pioneer engineers have kept the idea of ""If we can express our will to the maximum in the fixed condition of pre-main amplifier"" warm for 6 years. It uses simple circuit design for ""straight sound"". In addition, it is the highest quality pre-main amplifier which was born by incorporating all the technologies such as Exclusive C7 philosophy and technology.Symmetrical twin monaural structure is adopted.A shield box with a large current circuit power block on the left and right sides and a small signal input block in the rear center is placed around the central power supply section. The symmetrical structure with independent left and right channel circuits provides excellent separation.In addition to the length of the left and right signal paths and the configuration of parts, the temperature, magnetic field distribution, and vibration environment inside the main body that affect the operation of elements and circuits are made uniform, and the occurrence of left and right electrical and mechanical characteristic errors is suppressed.A pre-power isolated structure has been adopted to achieve the purpose of a separate amplifier, in which circuits with different roles of voltage amplification and current amplification operate properly, while maintaining the advantages of a pre-main amplifier, in which excellent balance and compactness can be obtained by connecting two amplifiers directly.The preamp circuit (from the input terminal to the voltage amplification stage) including the volume is shielded by a non-magnetic aluminum box. Moreover, this box is supported by a chassis through vibration control rubber. It adopts a floating structure. The power supply section is also separated from the rectifier circuit by making the pre-section and the power section independent of each other. This realizes complete separation.As a result, delicate input signals are isolated electrically and physically so as not to cause deterioration of sound quality due to circuit interference from the power section, fluctuation of the power section and vibration of the power section. This structure can be called a separate amplifier in a set.It is equipped with advanced direct construction which is a further development of direct construction which makes the signal path as short as possible.The signal switching relay and volume unit are controlled from the front panel right after the input terminal. The input block is located at the rear. In addition, the 16 power transistors of the power block are also located at the rear so that the shortest length is realized.The signal is routed directly from the input block to the power amplifier and processed at once at the rear of the amplifier. As a result, the paths between pre-power and power speaker terminals, which tend to be noise sources, are greatly shortened.In the input circuit, a signal switching relay is placed immediately after the input terminal to greatly improve crosstalk between each source. In addition, the buffer amplifier mounted on the same substrate as the relay drives low impedance, thereby realizing excellent channel separation by reducing impedance of the circuit.The power amplifier section is operated in pure class A operation. By expanding the exclusive super linear circuit developed by Pioneer to the final stage of large current, the low distortion of 0.05% is achieved despite the final stage non-feedback configuration, and the high damping factor of 200 is also achieved.The newly developed high-precision, integrally molded silent chassis is used for the chassis.Through in-depth research, we have developed a special resin material that is resistant to changes over time and has excellent anti-torsional and anti-shock properties. It supports the main body securely and at the same time, it has a shape that matches each block and efficiently disperses and absorbs internal and external vibrations.Since it is non-magnetic, electromagnetic induction noise and magnetic distortion are greatly suppressed.The power supply section uses a stack type electrolytic capacitor with low flux noise developed like a pure A-class amplifier, and a power transformer with low magnetic flux density, sufficient capacity, and excellent regulation characteristics to keep flux noise low.The volume uses a hand-made attenuator type with the same basic structure as the one used for Exclusive C7.Each step consists of carefully selected carbon resistance and high-precision contact points. Unlike conventional sliding resistance devices, which change the sound volume, it is less affected by temperature and humidity. It eliminates the sound quality change due to contact resistance and the level difference between left and right, enabling stable control.In order to maintain the design with the highest priority on sound quality, the attached functions such as tone control, balance, and loudness are omitted, and the speaker output is also single-system. This reduces the subtle influence of circuits and switches, and minimizes the effect of wiring steps and signal paths.In addition, the earth side of each input source is also switched simultaneously, and a separate earth design is adopted to eliminate signal interference between connected devices from the earth side.The Phono equalizer has a single-chip dual FET input configuration.One balanced input is mounted on the input terminal, and highly reliable gold-plated terminals are used for all terminals.The speaker terminal is a large vise type.It uses a large-capacity extra-thick type OFC power cord that suppresses the influence of external noise by drawing it from directly under the power transformer.It uses a high-grade type pure aluminum machined rotary knob and carefully selected resistors and capacitors.The concentrated arrangement of power transistors separates the part that absorbs the generated heat from the part that effectively diffuses it, and adopts a new heat radiation structure that takes into consideration the position and shape of the heat sink and the air flow path.The aluminum heat sink uses a new type that reduces resonance by changing the length of the fin."

name: Pioneer
description: "This is a pre-main amplifier that focuses on the operability that allows you to enjoy music while focusing on sound quality.In the amplifier with remote control, distortion is generated by the semiconductor switch used. In order to eliminate this, a motor-driven rotary switch is adopted for the function switching. In addition, in order to suppress the deterioration of sound quality caused by the microcomputer for remote control, the transformer and power supply are separated for the microcomputer, and even the board is dedicated for the microcomputer. This prevents the control signal of the remote control from flowing into the audio part and suppresses noise generation.In addition, the operation of the microcomputer is stopped when the remote control is not operated.The power amplifier section employs a super linear circuit that cancels out the nonlinear distortion of the transistors used in the amplifier section by combining transistors with completely opposite characteristics.This reduces signal degradation and distortion.In order to prevent noise from entering from the power supply, the power transformer is isolated from the chassis, and a clean ground system is adopted in which noise generated from the transformer flows to an independent ground system.Since the noise current generated from the transformer core does not flow into the signal system, the SN ratio in the sense of hearing, which does not appear in the specification, is improved.The smoothing capacitor in the power supply section is a pair of complimentary service capacitors that take into consideration the effect of the magnetic field generated on the plus side and the minus side on sound quality, to reduce noise.Direct Construction II is used to prevent unnecessary wiring and reduce signal degradation and interference.The function switch is laid out in the signal input section to suppress degradation caused by the signal passing through the contact when the direct switch is ON.In addition, the REC selector is laid out close to the signal input section, so that the signal path is designed to be shortest even when recording to tape.In addition, the function switch, volume, direct switch and power amplifier are laid out on the same board, reducing the wiring and shortening the time.The switch between speakers A and B is also a relay switch with a protection function, and the path of the output signal is shortened thoroughly.Honeycomb chassis and honeycomb heat sink are used to prevent vibration and resonance.A low-load drive design that increases the drive capability of the speakers at low load, coupled with a discrete configuration, delivers high-quality, power-rich sound.We use carefully selected parts for resistors, capacitors, and cords.In addition, oxygen-free copper wires are used for the power cord with polarity indication, signal and power cord.Uses copper plated screws that are effective in absorbing vibrations.Wireless remote control is included."

name: Pioneer
description: "The EX series stereo prestereo pre-main amplifier with built-in D/A converter and improved internal construction to eliminate factors that cause noise and distortion.Digital input / output is equipped with two optical input systems and one optical output system.In order to prevent the pulse width from changing when the optical fiber is bent or vibrated, an optical transmission distortion correction circuit is mounted on the input side and output side respectively to reduce noise.In the DAC section, the phase difference is eliminated by mounting a D/A converter for each L/R, and the separation is improved by separating the L/R.This D/A converter employs a specially developed glitch less IC that minimizes the occurrence of glitches. This eliminates the analog switch called a digricher, thereby improving performance and sound quality.Furthermore, by adding an MSB error correction circuit to each IC, the linearity at the 0 cross point is greatly improved.In addition, in order to prevent degradation of sound quality due to jitter (fluctuation of the clock edge), a PLL with an extremely high jitter suppression effect is adopted for the PLL that generates the clock, and the oscillation circuit is bonded with special resin in order to avoid the effect of vibration.When the D/A converter operates, only one master clock system is used, and the generation of unnecessary beat components is suppressed by eliminating other asynchronous clocks (such as microcomputer clocks).The digital filter over-samples by a factor of four to push unwanted high-frequency components into higher bands and eliminate aliasing noise.The digital filter uses a high-performance IC to achieve an in-band ripple within � 0.0001 dB and an attenuation error of 100 dB.The low-pass filter consists of a 5th-order Butterworth low-pass filter with excellent phase characteristics, which is composed of FDNR discrete circuits to reduce phase distortion as well as smooth characteristics.We are also working to improve sound quality by using high-quality parts and grounding with oxygen-free copper bus bars.Equipped with a digital recording selector that allows you to record a digital signal on the DAT that is independent of the sound coming from the speakers (this function is only available when watching analog sources).Digital circuits such as data demodulation, PLL, and digital filter are separated from analog sections such as D/A converter and analog low-pass filter by a separate board, and the digital section is shielded.In addition, by separating the power supply for the digital circuit and microcomputer from the power supply for the analog system from the transformer, we prevent interference with the analog system, which causes deterioration of sound quality.It uses direct construction to minimize the signal path and ensure proper positioning.First, the digital part and analog part are separated, and the signal path after the analog signal becomes the shortest like other analog sources. In addition, each input block is separated and the input / output block is shielded to prevent internal signal degradation and interference.In the input block, the input and recording selector can be controlled electrically, and the main volume can be controlled mechanically. Thus, the signal path can be minimized. Input sources other than the Adapt/Tape2 jacks can be directly transferred to the main volume by turning ON the Source Direct Switch, so that you can enjoy more pure sound.The power amplifier block is laid out along the signal flow and guides the output of the power stage directly to the speaker selector. Again, the wiring distance from the power supply is minimized.In the speaker selector block, the terminals are directly attached to the board on which the relay is attached. In order to minimize the number of terminals, and to give priority to terminal A, the terminal A is placed on the board with terminal A as opposed to the conventional terminal position.In order to minimize vibration, we have adopted a unique honeycomb shape for the frame chassis.In order to prevent vibration and resonance of the power transformer, the honeycomb formed by drawing is used for the transformer frame and frame chassis, and the honeycomb formed by punching is used for the bottom plate and bonnet case. In addition, to effectively suppress vibration and resonance of the power transistor, the extruded aluminum honeycomb of the chimney type is used as a heat sink. To suppress external vibration, four large honeycomb insulators made by resin molding are used. In addition, a fifth insulator made of cast iron is used to support the heavy transformer.In addition, cast iron is used for the transformer case, and pitch material with good thermal conductivity is filled between the cast iron case and the transformer body, and heat radiation fins are provided to prevent the internal resistance of the transformer winding from increasing due to temperature rise.In addition, it uses a newly developed large-capacity sealed capacitor that is less susceptible to electromagnetic induction.For the volume, a method of balancing the weight in both directions around the bearing of the rotary knob is adopted. In order to prevent any mechanical stress from being applied to the volume body, and in order to minimize the effect of the vibration of the amplifier, the shield cover supporting the volume substrate is floated from the body part with special paper, and harmful resonance of 2-4kHz is absorbed.Non-switching circuit TypeIII is adopted, in which switching distortion does not occur in principle.In addition to stabilizing the idle current, which has been drifting due to changes in the outside air temperature or when a large signal is input or just after the power switch is turned on, the voltage and power stages are clearly separated to improve the speaker drive performance under low load conditions.It uses a newly developed sealed capacitor in which the cathode of the aluminum electrolytic capacitor and the aluminum case are connected more securely, and the capacitor element is strongly shielded.This eliminates noise and noise from the capacitor itself, resulting in a high S/N.The Phono equalizer automatically turns OFF when you do not listen to a record, preventing unwanted noise and improving the sound quality of other sources.The recording selector also has an ON/OFF function. It operates only when the TONE direct switch is turned ON, and then the clock stops.A hybrid MC transformer is used for the Phono equalizer circuit.Copper plating is used for rear panel, bottom plate, transformer frame, speaker terminal and block shield case in order to eliminate electro-striction and reduce vibration.Uses an extra-thick power cord with OFC polarity display.In addition, high-quality parts such as audio fuses, rotary knobs made of pure aluminum, gold-plated input / output terminals, and large-size vise terminals are introduced."

name: Pioneer
description: "Pre-main amplifier equipped with dynamic non-switching amplifier.Pioneer's original dynamic power supply system is used to supply power to CDs and other sources with a wide dynamic range.In this system, an input signal is detected by a level detector, and a low voltage section (VLWhen the output exceeds a certain level, the high-voltage section (VHIn addition, the power section is equipped with Pioneer's original non-switching circuit that completely eliminates switching distortion, thereby realizing high-quality drive.In addition to a simple two amplifier configuration from the MC input to the speaker output, the high-level signal is directly input to the power amplifier to improve sound purity.In addition, by adopting DC servo, the equalizer amplifier and power amplifier are completely non-coupling capacitors.The equalizer section employs a DC servo high-gain equalizer with low-noise, high-gain dual FET in the first stage to improve the signal-to-noise ratio.In addition, the RIAA element, which actually affects sound quality, is composed of a polypropylene condenser and a brass cap non-magnetic resistor for high sound quality. name: Pioneer
description: "This pre-main amplifier was developed as the culmination of a fundamental review of the circuit, construction and physical properties, which are the origins of the amplifier, in order to respond to digital sources.The design philosophy of this amplifier is roughly divided into three points.First, each signal block is appropriately arranged in order to make the signal path the shortest distance. Second, thorough anti-vibration and anti-resonance measures are taken. Third, the drive performance of the speaker is improved at low load.We are solving various problems by investing various technologies in these areas.First, a structure called direct construction is adopted in order to make the signal path the shortest distance.By separating each circuit block and shielding the I/O block, adverse effects such as internal signal degradation and interference between signals can be prevented.The input block allows remote mechanical control of the Input & Recording Selector and the main volume to minimize signal routing. The input signal selected by the Input Selector does not flow to the front panel when the Source Direct Switch is turned ON, so you can enjoy even more pure sound.The power amplifier block is laid out along the signal flow and guides the output of the power stage directly to the speaker selector. Again, the distance from the power supply is the shortest.In the speaker selector block, the speaker terminals are directly attached to the circuit board on which the relay is attached so that the shortest speaker terminal A is given priority and the terminal A is placed on the lower side.In order to completely eliminate vibration and resonance, a resonance free construction method is adopted. Four types of honeycomb shapes are adopted, and vibration and resonance are totally reduced by combining the transformer part and volume system.Honeycomb made by punching is used for bottom plates and bonnet cases. For extruded aluminum honeycomb heat sinks to effectively suppress vibration and resonance of power transistors. Honeycomb made by resin molding is used for large honeycomb insulators to suppress external vibration.The transformer case is made of cast iron with high shielding effect, high rigidity, high internal loss, excellent vibration damping characteristics, and almost no resonance frequency. Pitch material with high thermal conductivity is filled between the case and the transformer body, and a heat radiation fan is installed to prevent the internal resistance of the transformer winding from increasing due to temperature rise.In addition, it uses a newly developed large-capacity sealed capacitor that is less susceptible to electromagnetic induction.Since sound quality is adversely affected by a structure in which a load is applied to the axis of the volume or vibration is generated, we have adopted a method of balancing the weight in both directions centering on the bearing of the rotary knob of the volume to prevent mechanical stress from being applied to the volume body. In addition, in order to minimize the effect of the vibration of the amplifier, the shield cover supporting the volume base is floated from the body part with special paper to absorb the resonance of 2 to 4 kHz which is harmful to sound quality.Non-switching circuit type III is adopted.This circuit is an upgraded version of Type II, in which switching distortion does not occur in principle, and has succeeded in suppressing thermal distortion by instantaneously stabilizing the idle current that drifts when the power switch is turned on, when a large signal is input, or when the outside temperature changes.In addition, detection and correction of input / output signal difference of the power stage is improved to reduce non-linear distortion. Furthermore, voltage amplification stage and power amplification stage are clearly separated. Since the power amplification stage concentrates on the speaker drive, there is no influence on the voltage amplification stage even at large output, and speaker drive performance at low load is improved.It uses a newly developed sealed capacitor in which the cathode of the aluminum electrolytic capacitor and the aluminum case are connected more securely. By strongly shielding the capacitor element, noise from the capacitor itself is eliminated, and high S/N is achieved.The Phono equalizer can be turned off when you do not listen to a record to prevent unwanted noise.In addition, the recording selector also has an OFF function, and the sound purity is enhanced by a simple circuit configuration.The equalizer uses a unique NF-CR type circuit to stabilize the operation in the mid - and high-frequency range, and uses low-noise Hi-gm FET to improve S/N.Copper plated parts are used for the rear panel and bottom plate to prevent electro-striction and vibration.The power cord is a thick oxygen-free copper power cord with polarity indication. This cord is made of insulating material with low dielectric constant to reduce the capacitance of the power cord, thus reducing the influence of external noise.In addition, the polarity of transformer windings is controlled to minimize noise coming through the cord.Uses parts that emphasize sound quality such as fuse for audio.Machined pure aluminum is used for rotary knobs and other parts."

name: Pioneer
description: "Pre-main amplifier with super linear circuit.Semiconductor amplification devices such as transistors have inherent non-linearity (distortion). In order to eliminate this non-linear distortion, we have adopted a super linear circuit at the first stage of the power section.In this method, the non-linearity of the transistor and the non-linearity of the reverse mode are paired and canceled. This makes it possible to make the non-linearity of the transistor almost linear.As a result, we succeeded in reducing NFB to about 1/1000 of the conventional one because of improved bare characteristics, and solved the unstable factors such as TIM strain caused by NFB.In a class B amplifier, the transistor amplifier is switched in principle.In order to resolve this switching distortion and obtain high-purity sound quality, a non-switching circuit is installed in the power amplifier.This method uses a high-speed bias servo circuit to control the bias current according to the input signal to keep the transistor in an operating state at all times. As a result, the transistor does not switch and switching distortion is essentially 0.We also pursue 0 crossover distortion, carefully select transistors with high pair characteristics, and set the operating point to the optimum point to achieve input / output characteristics with high linearity and close to 0 crossover distortion.A DC servo circuit is used in the power amplifier section to cut out the unnecessary ultra-low frequencies that degrade sound quality without using a capacitor.This DC servo realizes a circuit configuration that does not use any coupling capacitor from the AUX or Tuner input to the SP output, eliminating the coloring of sound by the coupling capacitor.It is equipped with a line straight switch for more refined sound quality.Equipped with MM/MC switching function that can use MC cartridge.Equipped with a Rec Out selector, it is equipped with an indicator that shows at a glance which terminal of Rec1 or Rec2 is receiving the recording output."

description: "A pre-main amplifier that employs a super-linear circuit to cancel out non-linear distortion of transistors.Taking note of the inherent nonlinearity (distortion) of semiconductors, we have adopted a super linear circuit in the first stage of the power section.The Super Linear Circuit, which is Pioneer's original technology, is a circuit that eliminates the non-linearity (distortion) of transistors without relying only on NFB (negative feedback) like conventional amplifiers. It is a circuit that sets a transistor with a reverse mode non-linearity in the non-linearity of the transistor and cancels the non-linearity by using a current mirror circuit to obtain an equivalent excellent linearity.As a result, the fundamental characteristics (bare characteristics) are improved, so that a large amount of negative feedback (NFB) does not need to be applied as in conventional systems, and it is reduced to about 10 dB, 1/1000 of the conventional level.As a result, the NFB-induced TIM distortion, degradation of frequency characteristics during phase correction, and instability in the high-frequency range are eliminated, and the inherent advantage of NFB, which produces output signals similar in shape to input signals, can be utilized.The power stage and driver stage are equipped with non-switching circuits in order to ensure sound quality without distortion.This method is based on Pioneer's proprietary high-speed bias servo circuit. By controlling the bias current according to the input signal, the transistor is always kept in an operating state. By this method, the transistor does not switch in principle, and switching distortion is essentially 0.We also pursue 0 crossover distortion and carefully select the transistors to be adopted. By using transistors with high pair characteristics and setting the operating point to the optimum point, input / output characteristics with output characteristics with higher linearity.A clean servo regulator is used to supply power to the first stage of the equalizer amplifier and power amplifier.Compared with the conventional serial control type, it is a parallel control type with a smaller output current loop. The impedance of the power supply becomes 0 equivalently, and the influence on other signal circuits is suppressed.As a result, crosstalk, such as signal leakage, is eliminated, resulting in higher sound quality.DC servo circuits are used for both the equalizer amplifier and the power amplifier.As a result, all coupling capacitors in the signal system from the MC input terminal to the SP output terminal are removed, and non-coupling capacitors are used in all stages.This suppresses the generation of phase shift and transient intermodulation distortion.It is equipped with a line straight switch in order to obtain more refined sound quality.MC cartridge can be used and MC/MM can be switched.In addition, MM / load capacity and MC / load resistance can be switched to bring out the performance of the cartridge.It is equipped with a subsonic indicator that notifies mixing of unnecessary ultra-low frequency (20 Hz) by light.It is equipped with a Rec Out selector and an indicator to let you know at a glance which terminal of Rec1 or Rec2 outputs the recording output."

name: Exclusive
description: "A professional studio monitor and speaker system based on the model2251 with the smallest possible enclosure.The same unit as model2251 is used.A 25 cm cone woofer TAD TL-1102 is mounted in the low range.The diaphragm is a composite cone made of natural pulp, which has undergone an aging process, laminated with a special film, and coated with a special damping paint.In addition, the magnetic circuit uses an internal magnetic type with an Alnico magnet that can reduce the second harmonic distortion in principle. By designing with a margin for the magnet operating point, the sensitivity drop due to demagnetization at high power is also kept low.Furthermore, in order to stabilize the transmission of driving force, the yoke and plate of the magnetic circuit are integrally molded by a special casting method, and the center pole is also screwed to the yoke. This improves the synthesis of the magnetic circuit by approximately four times.The driver unit TAD TD-2002 and the compact design horn TAD TH-2002 are mounted in the high range.The TD 2002 uses a lightweight and highly rigid 4.8 cm beryllium diaphragm and an alnico magnet with a magnetic flux density of approximately 20,000 Gauss to achieve excellent linearity. In addition, the phasing plug, which prevents phase disturbance of sound waves, uses an annular slit type that facilitates phase matching in ultra-high frequencies. The power supply section has been reviewed and the terminal on the diaphragm assay is now a direct power supply terminal that directly goes out of the back cover. This reduces the influence of internal AC magnetic flux and sound pressure and provides clear sound quality.The TH-2002 is a horn whose directivity is controlled by wave-front control technology. The directivity angle is set to 60 � horizontally and 30 � vertically in consideration of small-capacity monitor rooms. In addition, by adopting an asymmetric vertical horn based on the Asymmetrical Pattern, Axis & Level (APAXIAL) method, smooth output-sound pressure characteristics are obtained, and directivity control in the vertical direction is actively performed. This reduces the influence of reflection from the top of the enclosure or from the ceiling and provides clear orientation. In addition, by adopting AFAST (Acoustic Filter Assisted System Tuning) to suppress the resonance characteristic of the horn, the sound is absorbed by the acoustic tube installed in the upper part of the horn, and the back and forth movement of sound image due to pitch (sound height) is eliminated, and the articulation of reproduced sound is improved."

name: Exclusive
description: "Based on the results and data of the model2402, this studio monitor speaker system was developed by putting in the latest TAD systemization technology cultivated in the development of the model2251.TAD TL-1601c which is 40 cm cone type woofer is mounted in the low range.The TL-1601c uses a special casting process to integrally mold the yoke, plate, and frame, which were previously separate parts. In addition, the center pole is screwed to the yoke to increase the rigidity of the unit. The magnetic circuit uses an Alnico magnet to suppress second harmonic distortion and achieve a strong magnetic flux density.In addition, by applying a special aging process to the diaphragm, a tough and durable cone has been realized.The high-frequency band is equipped with a unit that combines a driver TAD TD 4003 and a horn TAD TH 4003.The TD 4003 is a newly designed compression driver equipped with an aluminum annular slit on a phasing plug to prevent phase disturbance of sound waves.The vibration system uses a lightweight and highly rigid 10 cm beryllium diaphragm, and the magnetic circuit uses a neodymium magnet with a high magnetic flux density of 20000 of Gauss. This realizes wide-band reproduction and excellent linearity. In addition, the throat diameter is set at 39 mm in consideration of diffusion in the high-frequency range, thereby reducing the influence of AC magnetic flux and sound pressure inside the direct feeding terminal.The TH-4003 uses the APAXIAL (Asymmetrical Pattern, Axis & Level) method and wave-front control technology to create an asymmetrical horn shape. The directional angle is set at 80 degrees horizontally and 30 degrees vertically to obtain smooth output sound pressure characteristics. In addition, directional control in the vertical direction is actively performed. This reduces reflection in the low frequency range, eliminates fins, and makes it possible to make the sound source position near the top and bottom of the woofer.In addition, AFAST (Acoustic Filter Assisted System Tuning) is adopted in the upper part of the horn, and the resonance peculiar to the horn is absorbed by the acoustic tube, and the backward and forward movement of the sound image due to the pitch (sound height) is eliminated.The network part of the model2404 was sold separately, and a dedicated network unit DN 2404 for bi-wiring was sold.The DN-2404 realizes smooth phase characteristics as a system by adjusting the phase characteristics of the unit with high precision, and adopts CGR (Capacitive Gap Reduction) system to reduce unnecessary current due to parasitic capacitance.The DN 2404 uses an external system so that it is not affected by magnetic flux and sound pressure inside the enclosure."

name: Pioneer
description: "This speaker system was completed as a natural phase system based on Pioneer's original wave front control technology and networkless technology.The Natural Phase System has three key points : ""an enclosure that matches the sound sources of a woofer and a tweeter for theoretical phase matching,"" ""smooth electrical phase characteristics using networkless technology,"" and ""a shape that prevents wavefront diffraction and fully draws out the performance of each speaker unit."" By implementing these three points, uniform sound spread and smooth phase characteristics are achieved.A 16 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The shape and material of all suspension systems, including the edge shape, are examined one by one to enhance the ability to follow minute input.In addition, by directly connecting without a network using networkless technology, the deterioration factor of the input signal is eliminated as much as possible.A 3.5 cm semi-dome type tweeter is used for the high range.This tweeter is a newly developed HSDOM (Harmonized Synthetic Diaphragm Optimum Method) tweeter using ceramic graphite. It is designed to maximize each function and performance by using the finite element method with computer for the material, shape, edge, etc. of the diaphragm.The frame of the woofer and the flange of the tweeter are made of die-cast zinc with 2.6 times the specific gravity of aluminum to enhance Iori and vibration control effect.The unit is mounted using a midship mounting method to prevent the magnetic circuit from swinging due to the driving of the cone.Networkless technology provides a simple network using only a low-frequency amplitude limiting capacitor for the tweeter.A CGR (Capacitive Gap Reduction) system utilizing TAD (Technical Audio Devices) technology has been introduced to reduce unnecessary electrostatic charge generated near the signal current and improve sound quality by using a clean signal.In the enclosure, mahogany with good acoustic characteristics is used for all components such as the baffle plate 67 mm thick, which is shaved from the plank, the butts and the base.In addition, in order to suppress the diffraction phenomenon of sound, the baffle surface is made to be the minimum area for the size of the unit, and the wave surface is controlled by applying a unique taper treatment.The enclosure is designed to be integrated with the dedicated base and has a floating structure using felt packing between the main body and base to reduce sound quality change due to installation conditions.This floating base is detachable.The separately sold special stand also adopts the total design and design, and can be swung inside 18 degrees without changing the position of the stand."

name: Pioneer
description: "A compact vertical twin speaker system that can be placed on a shelf and offers a sound field scale comparable to that of a floor-type speaker.It employs a vertical twin system with wave surface control technology, and four improvements have been made : adjusting the energy time response of the woofer and the tweeter on the time axis, controlling the directivity of the woofer and the tweeter, matching the electrical phase of the network, and controlling the wave surface diffraction by the baffle shape.In the low frequency range, an oven cone made of paper made by mixing aramid fiber with pulp is used, and resolution in the low frequency range is improved by increasing sound speed and obtaining an appropriate internal loss.In addition, an Alnico magnet is used for the magnetic circuit, and a copper short ring and OFC voice coil are combined to reduce distortion.A 2.5 cm dome type tweeter with a W. name: Pioneer
description: "A new wave front control technology has been introduced into the vertical twin, and this speaker system aims at better sound field reproducibility and clearer sound image localization.In order to make the most of the advantages of vertical twin speakers, we have scientifically clarified how the wave front of sound reaches the ears of listeners, and have introduced a new wave front control technology.The four points are ""adjusting the energy time response of the woofer and the tweeter on the time axis,"" ""controlling the directivity of the woofer and the tweeter,"" ""matching the electrical phase of the network, etc.,"" and ""controlling the wavefront diffraction by the shape of the baffle."" These controls enable the transmission of a beautiful sound wave surface that spreads the sound wave uniformly.For the lower range, two 20 cm cone type woofer using newly developed cone made by mixing aramid fiber with pulp is used.The newly designed Alnico magnetic circuit employs a short ring to further reduce distortion and an edge-wise voice coil to improve driving force.The frame is made of highly rigid aluminum die cast and uses a shield frame gasket to prevent unwanted vibrations.A 3 cm dome type tweeter with a W. F. (wave front) director is used for the high range.The position of the vibration plate of the tweeter is controlled so that the rising peaks coincide with each other, and the directivity is also controlled by the shape of the horn of the director. name: Pioneer
description: "While inheriting the charm of S-1000twin, this speaker system was developed with S-5000 technology in pursuit of higher perfection.Two 20 cm cone type woofers are used for the low range.The diaphragm uses ALCC (alginic acid composite cone), which is made by mixing alginic acid fiber in order to increase the bonding force between high rigidity material (carbon fiber, aramid fiber, etc.) and pulp.Alginic acid fiber is made from alginic acid extracted from seaweed into filament fiber. This fiber is used as a binder for high rigidity material and pulp, and by increasing the bonding force, high rigidity and high internal loss are improved.In addition, the S-1000twinA is mixed with polyarylate fiber, which has excellent shock absorption power as a high-rigidity material, and the reaction of the woofer diaphragm is improved.In addition, the voice coil adopts an edgewise winding with ribbon wire, and the coil occupancy rate in the magnetic gap is high, so the driving force of the cone is improved by approximately 10% compared to conventional products.An alnico magnet is used for the magnetic circuit, and a copper short ring is added to prevent magnetic materials such as poles and plates in the vicinity from being magnetized, thereby suppressing distortion.In addition, the top of the center cap is equipped with a CRA (Cap Resonance Absorber) made by Exenes to reduce surface noise on the center cap surface. The frame is made of zinc die-cast, which has a specific gravity 2.6 times that of aluminum, to reduce unnecessary vibration.A 3-cm dome tweeter is used for the high range.The diaphragm uses a ceramic graphite diaphragm with a carbon purity of 99.99%, which is driven by an alnico magnet and an OFC edgewise wound voice coil.In addition, in order to increase the bonding strength between the top plate and the flange, the top plate is cut to improve the flatness.On the front, we have adopted a W. F. (wave front) director developed from wave front control technology. This W. F. director is made by Painted maple laminate carving which is also used in Exclusive S5. By adjusting the time axis with the woofer and controlling the directivity by the horn shape, the wave front of the sound at the listening position of the listener is matched.The enclosure is a vertical twin system in which two woofers are arranged vertically with a tweeter at the center.Wave-front control technology was introduced in the design. By strictly controlling the energy time of the woofer and the tweeter on the time axis, controlling the directivity of the woofer and the tweeter, controlling the directivity of the woofer and the tweeter, matching the electrical phase of the network, and controlling the wave-front diffraction by the shape of the baffle, we aim to realize a more ideal speaker system.A midship mount system is used to fix the unit. Both the woofer and tweeter are fixed to the inner baffle inside the enclosure to reduce unnecessary vibration. In addition, a floating top and shield frame are used to eliminate resonance.Artificial leather is applied to the baffle surface to improve the S/N feeling of sound quality.The rear duct is used to avoid unnecessary radiation sound in the middle region from the duct.The enclosure is finished with walnut real wood veneer with oil stain finish, and the top plate uses bird's eye maple.The RUNNET uses a new 2-color woven fabric."

name: Pioneer
description: "A vertical twin type speaker system that employs an all-crystalline diamond diaphragm.A 20 cm cone type woofer with an ALCC (alginate composite cone) diaphragm, which was developed in Shinkai over a period of four years, is used for the low range.This diaphragm consists of a composite diaphragm made by mixing pulp with aramid fiber, and mixed with alginic acid fiber, which is made from alginic acid extracted from seaweed into threads and made into fibers. The alginic acid fiber functions just as a binder between pulp and aramid fiber, increasing the bonding strength between pulp and aramid fiber and improving rigidity.The magnetic circuit employs a high-linearity magnetic circuit with 2.5 times the plate thickness of the conventional one. The voice coil is made into a short voice coil that fits perfectly in the magnetic gap, and the decrease in magnetic flux density is suppressed even when the voice coil is large in amplitude. In addition, the Alnico magnet with high magnetic flux density and low harmonic distortion is adopted.In addition, the frame is made of zinc die-cast, which has a specific gravity 2.6 times that of aluminum, and the shape is designed to reduce air resistance to the diaphragm while reducing unnecessary vibration due to higher rigidity.The surface of the Woofer gasket is treated with bristles to reduce the reflection of sound from cones and edges. In addition, the gasket itself has a damping effect and produces a reproduced sound with less noise turbidity.A 3-cm dome type tweeter with a full crystalline diamond diaphragm is used for the high range.This diaphragm is made of 100% polycrystalline diamond instead of conventional materials such as titanium coated with diamond. This diaphragm takes advantage of the characteristics of diamond that are close to the ideal diaphragm.As a result, the sound velocity is approximately 3.3 times that of titanium, the reproduction frequency band is approximately 3.4 times that of titanium, and the internal loss is approximately 3 to 5 times that of titanium.In addition, a new W. F. (Wave Front) director utilizing wave front control technology is adopted for the front of the tweeter. The director is made of Painted maple laminated material with high rigidity and excellent acoustic characteristics. In order to match the energy response with the woofer, the mounting position of the diaphragm is adjusted, and in order to improve the range of orientation in the vertical direction, the horn shape of the director is incorporated.In addition, an alnico magnet is used for the magnetic circuit, and zinc die-cast, which has 2.6 times the specific gravity of aluminum, is also used for the flange of the tweeter. In addition, the surface of the zinc die-cast is treated with hair transplantation to suppress excess resonance.The unit array is a vertical twin system using wave surface control technology, and all band sound is radiated around the tweeter. In addition, by using a small-diameter twin woofer, voluminous low sound reproduction is realized.The wave surface control technology scientifically clarifies how the wave surface of the sound emitted from each unit spreads and reaches the listener's ear. It is strictly controlled in four points : ""adjusting the energy time response of the woofer and the tweeter on the time axis,"" ""controlling the directivity of the woofer and the tweeter in all frequency bands,"" ""matching the electrical phase of the network, etc.,"" and ""controlling the wave surface diffraction by the baffle shape.""A full midship mounting system is adopted to prevent unwanted vibration from each unit from being transmitted to the baffle.The woofer is fixed to the inner baffle inside the enclosure, and the tweeter is fixed from the back side of the baffle through a hair-implanted layer. By mounting the unit outside of the baffle surface, unnecessary vibration of the baffle is reduced.In addition, a floating top that suppresses unnecessary vibration of the top plate and a shield frame that blocks vibration from the frame are adopted. Each unit circuit is also separated in the network mount. In particular, the tweeter circuit is covered with felt from below to eliminate unnecessary vibration from the enclosure.The woofer circuit and the tweeter circuit are separated independently, and the signal transmission loss is reduced by crimping wiring.Each element is mounted with careful anti-vibration measures and is laid out so as not to be affected by crosstalk.For input to the network, a radial power supply system is adopted to enable direct and uniform signal transmission.The enclosure is plated with high quality walnut real wood and takes advantage of the grain of natural precious wood. In addition, compared to the usual oil finish, the number of polishing is increased and the smoothness is improved.In addition, wool with high sound absorption and excellent sound quality is used as sound absorbing material to reduce unnecessary standing waves in the enclosure.It uses a bi-wiring connection terminal that can separately feed the low and high sound circuits."

name: Pioneer
description: "This is a pure malt speaker system that uses TAD technology to further improve sound quality.Pioneer established the Environmental Protection Promotion Committee in 1991 and has been working on three visions : Safety (no toxic substances), Cleanliness (no waste), and Ecology (no use of limited resources). The Pure Malt Speaker Series was developed in collaboration with Suntory.Casks made of hard white oak, more than 100 years old, are used to mature whiskies for about 50 years. A pure malt speaker recycles the barrel's side plate as an enclosure, which, unlike a freshly cut plate, has a soft, lingering sound when tapped.The enclosure color is celtee oak, the color of the hardened barrel.In addition, the barrel laminated wood used for the enclosure is made with the same straight grain cutting method as that used for high-class furniture. The natural pattern called ""Toraki"" can be seen. In addition, each piece has a different character, such as the nail marks of the barrel and the stain marks of the whiskey, which are unique features of the barrel side plate made with the barrel side plate. Each piece has a different character.A 10 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The diaphragm uses a pulp diaphragm that inherits the know-how of TAD. This diaphragm is made by a busy process of finely grinding rare pulp, making it with high-quality water, and producing it in a special single-cavity mold. It achieves the high rigidity and internal loss characteristic of natural materials, and the concentric corrugation ribs increase the diaphragm strength and enable sound with good response.The edge part uses foamed polycarbonate urethane which is a new material that is light and excellent in internal loss, and the reproducibility of minute sound is improved by the TAD traditional corrugation shape with excellent linearity.A bass-reflex system is used for the enclosure, and a hollowed-out duct made material is used for the duct.The speaker terminals come directly out and are firmly attached to the back plate of the enclosure.Grill net comes with 2 kinds of variation and you can choose from 2 of deep red and deep green according to your preference.A portion of the sales of these speakers was donated to the Green Fund of the National Land Afforestation Promotion Organization."

name: Pioneer
description: "A Series speaker system developed with the theme of home theater and home concert hall.Two 16 cm cone type woofers are installed in the lower range.The cone uses Kevlar fiber. In order to realize an ideal unit material, the thickness, direction of fiber and cutting are taken into consideration, and satin weave is used. In addition, nonwoven fabric of aramid fiber is used for the mat material, and the contradictory elements of rigidity and internal loss required as a speaker unit are balanced at a high level.A 13 cm coaxial type unit is installed in the middle and high range.This unit combines a 13 cm cone type mid-range and a 3 cm dome type tweeter. The mid-range diaphragm uses Kevlar fiber.In addition, Pioneer has introduced the HSDOM (Harmonized Synthetic Diaphragm Optimum Method) for the tweeter. By analyzing the material, shape, edge, etc. of the diaphragm using the finite element method with a computer, it is designed to maximize each function and performance. By combining piston motion and divided vibration in a well-balanced manner, ultra-high frequency reproduction is achieved. The diaphragm of this tweeter uses a 20-micron titanium oxide diaphragm, and ultra-high frequency reproduction up to 50 kHz is achieved.It is equipped with a ribbon-type super tweeter for ultra-high frequency and realizes ultra-high frequency reproduction up to 120 kHz.The enclosure uses a bass reflex system.In addition to increasing the strength of the baffle plate and top plate, we have placed reinforcing plates at the optimum position inside to thoroughly suppress unnecessary vibration generated by each unit.In addition, the S-A7 introduces Reflection Free Alignment (�) layout and Acousitcal Filter Assited System Tuning (AFAST) technology.The � layout reduces the effect of sound reflected from the floor surface on the woofer. When the woofer is placed with a large talk from the floor surface, the difference in distance between the sound that directly reaches the ear from the woofer and the sound that is reflected from the floor surface and reaches the ear becomes large, preventing the undulation of the sound pressure in the low middle range due to interference.AFAST technology uses an acoustic tube inside the enclosure to absorb standing waves and resonance sounds to suppress unwanted box sounds, and to eliminate backward and forward movement of sound images due to pitch fluctuations.Uses a large gold plated input terminal."

name: Pioneer
description: "This speaker system was developed as a new-generation reference for high-definition media such as DVD audio by applying the technology and experience accumulated in the past.This speaker uses AFAST (Acoustic Filter Assisted System Tuning) technology.By using an acoustic tube in the enclosure and in the horn opening, it suppresses unnecessary box ringing by absorbing standing waves and resonance sound, and eliminates unstable back and forth movement of sound image due to fluctuation of pitch (sound height), thus enhancing clear reproducibility.A 25 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The diaphragm is made of cone paper equivalent to the TAD unit which is well known as a studio monitor speaker. It is mixed with Kevlar and subjected to aging treatment so that the sound quality is sufficiently tuned.A 3 cm compression driver and an AFAST horn are installed in the high range.The compression driver is a high-efficiency design incorporating TAD design know-how. It uses a lightweight and highly rigid 3 cm edge-wise voice coil to reproduce sound with excellent response.In addition, AFAST technology has been introduced into the horn, and by mixing copper powder, both strength and internal loss are increased, and resonance is suppressed by increasing weight.A ribbon-type super-tweeter has been newly developed and installed in order to reproduce the ultra-high frequency range that DVD audio enables.By adopting a magnetic circuit using neodymium magnet and aluminum ribbon, it is possible to reproduce ultra-high frequency range up to 120 khz with high efficiency.Each unit is fixed from the rear of the enclosure to provide high resolution and high dynamic range.In the network section, high-quality sound parts are used for wiring cords, choke coils, capacitors, and terminals, and a dividing network is used to reduce loss and leakage. Special attention is paid to paid to the phase characteristics between units to achieve smoothness as a system.It is also equipped with switching terminals for bi-wiring connection, bi-amplifier connection and multi-amplifier drive.Equipped with 3-position switching type level control for tweeter.It is designed in pursuit of the ideal speaker system of ""the enclosure does not sound but only the diaphragm"".First of all, strength is improved by adopting a trapezoidal structure, and in addition, unnecessary resonance is suppressed by a three layer structure sandwiching special damping material.In addition, acoustic tubes based on AFAST technology, a further development of Pioneer's TAD professional studio monitor technology, are placed inside the enclosure to significantly reduce the amount of sound absorbing material and eliminate the generation of standing waves, which has been considered a weak point of the tall boy type (patent pending).In addition, it has a separate structure with a trapezoidal enclosure divided into upper and lower parts, a special ceramic speaker base weighing 24 kg, and a round form method.The bass reflex structure provides sound paths in all directions from the lower part of the enclosure and dimples on the base for natural low sound reproduction."

name: Pioneer
description: "A speaker system using a trapezoidal enclosure.A 14 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.It has an appropriate internal loss and uses a cone that is smoothly attenuated without stretching the band. It matches the in-band energy characteristics and on-axis characteristics in the full range without using network elements, making it possible to cross over with the tweeter.A 2.5 cm soft dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.It uses a high-flux density magnetic circuit with a narrow magnetic gap, and by filling it with magnetic fluid, power linearity and coupling with the filter are improved.The dome has a catenary shape with high rigidity.As for the network, the woofer side is a networkless direct drive, and only a condenser is connected to the tweeter, and loss due to network elements is adopted.The enclosure has a trapezoidal configuration with one side of a baffle plate slanted.This allows the construction of a minimum baffle surface near each speaker unit, thus reducing the secondary reflections of sound due to diffraction phenomena.The four sided baffle also disperses the resonance points of the baffle surface and reduces the level of secondary radiation due to unwanted resonance.We also reduce standing waves by reducing the number of parallel planes in the enclosure.The enclosure is made from a carefully selected MDF material with a piano-like black mirror finish.A vice type gold-plated terminal is used for the speaker terminal."

name: Pioneer
description: "Based on wave front control technology and high-speed technology, this speaker system was developed by introducing new high-sensitivity technology in order to realize more realistic sound field and sound image reproducibility.Two 25 cm cone type woofers with ALCC (alginate composite cone) diaphragm are used for the low range.This diaphragm is made of a mixture of alginic acid fiber to increase the bonding strength between high-strength polyarylate fiber and pulp. Alginic acid fiber extracted from seaweed such as kelp works as a binder for both, improving the bonding strength and obtaining high rigidity and internal loss.The magnetic circuit uses a double anti-magnetic magnet with a canceling magnet and drives at a magnetic flux density of 14,300 Gauss. In addition, the T-shaped pole provides a symmetrical magnetic flux distribution and provides excellent power linearity even when the voice coil is large in amplitude.The damper uses a butterfly type damper with low mechanical loss and air resistance and excellent initial motion sensitivity. Combined with a lightweight woofer diaphragm, this damper enables accurate responses even to minute inputs.A horn type tweeter is used for the high frequency range.The driver is equipped with a rear type compression driver.This is the same system as the Technical Audio Devices (TAD) unit and Exclusive S5. The sound guided by the fading plug adjacent to the diaphragm is collected at the center of the outlet and emitted from the horn at once. This rear type has excellent phase and high-frequency characteristics because the length of the sound path is the same for each sound path.The diaphragm is made of highly responsive 3 cm diameter titanium, and the back cover is made of aluminum die cast.In addition, the horn section uses a newly designed slant angle oval wave horn that is integrally molded with the front port. When set to the front, the horn flare has an inclination of 10 degrees, and both L and R tweeters face inward respectively, so that more natural sound field and sound image localization can be obtained at the central listening point.In addition, the horn has an oval shape with a soft curved surface, so that it has a wide horizontal directivity and a wider listening area for stereo playback.The horn is made of aluminum die-cast with high rigidity and high molding accuracy to ensure vibration control so that the horn itself does not generate excessive vibration.The network is distributed specifically for the unit for sound quality, and the network board is floating from the enclosure to avoid vibration.A full midship mount is adopted to prevent vibration of the unit from being transmitted to the baffle.Both the woofer and tweeter are firmly secured inside the enclosure to prevent unwanted vibration of the baffle.The enclosure takes advantage of the bass reflex effect for higher efficiency and has ports on the front and rear baffles. In addition, ports are provided at the same position so that they pass through the front and rear baffles to disperse the anti-resonance of the port.In addition, a large capacity enclosure (72L) is adopted to fully demonstrate the performance of the unit, and the depth is enlarged to improve the low-frequency characteristics.In addition, by rounding the corner of the baffle to a large extent, the wavefront diffraction is controlled, thereby reducing the diffraction phenomenon.The enclosure is made of high-density particle board with a Reed-Dark-Brown finish."

name: Pioneer
description: "This speaker system was developed with the concept of high sensitivity and high efficiency, inheriting the design philosophy of TAD (Technical Audio Devices) and Exclusive S5 in search of the reality of the original sound.Two 25 cm cone type woofer using ALCC (alginic acid composite cone) diaphragm is used for the low range.This ALCC diaphragm is made by mixing alginic acid fiber and papermaking in order to increase the bonding force between high strength polyarylate fiber and pulp. Alginic acid fiber extracted from kelp and other seaweeds acts as a binder to increase the bonding force.In addition, the magnetic circuit uses a double magnet magnetic circuit with a canceling magnet, and achieves a high magnetic flux density of 14,300 gauss. In addition, a T-shaped pole is used to obtain a uniform magnetic flux density from front to back, improving the linearity of amplitude against input.In addition, in order to improve response at the time of Oire force and Dainyu force, we have adopted a butterfly-type damper with a revised shape.A horn type tweeter is used for the high range.The horn driver is equipped with a rear-type compression driver that provides high resolution and excellent linearity.This compression driver uses the same method as TAD and Exclusive S5. The sound emitted from the diaphragm is guided to the center by a fading plug designed based on fluid dynamics research. The sound is compressed and radiated from the horn. In particular, since the diaphragm is a rear type with the sound generating direction on the rear side, the length of the sound path of the fading plug is the same. There is no phase disturbance of the sound from each slit, and the high-frequency characteristics are excellent.The diaphragm of this driver is made of 3 cm titanium nitride, and a back cover made of aluminum die-cast with excellent vibration resistance is attached to the back of the diaphragm to prevent unnecessary vibration.The horn section is equipped with a large oval wave horn designed with a flared shape to send out spherical waves, thereby realizing a natural sound spread close to a point source.In addition, by rounding the horn opening, the reflection of sound is reduced and the sound is smoothly connected to the outside. The horn shape is oval-shaped, so the horizontal directivity is wide and natural sound can be obtained in a wide range of listening points.For the material of this horn, aluminum die-cast with high molding accuracy and excellent vibration control is adopted.In addition, AFAST (Acoustic Filter Assisted System Tuning), a new technology introduced in TAD, has been introduced, and a resonator is installed in the upper part of the horn. This makes it possible to smooth out changes in phase and to obtain more precise sound localization and reproduction sound.In the network section, only elements with a low distortion factor are carefully selected and distributed to each unit to prevent temporal interference between units.In addition, the network board is floated from the enclosure to isolate vibration from each unit.In order to prevent unwanted vibration of the baffle from adversely affecting playback sound, the tweeter woofer is fixed by Pioneer's unique midship mounting method.By fixing the unit inside instead of the baffle, unnecessary vibration of the baffle is reduced.The enclosure has two ports on the front to take advantage of the bass reflex effect that enhances the low range.Compared to a single port of the same area, there is less mid-range leakage from the enclosure and less noise turbidity due to interference from the unit.In addition, since the opening uses a special R-shaped elastic body, there is little wind noise and sound waves are emitted smoothly.Furthermore, in order to improve the low-frequency characteristics, it is a large-capacity enclosure with an internal volume of 100L, and the extremely thick baffle is used as a round baffle to prevent the sound diffraction phenomenon.In addition, the material is acoustically examined high-density particle board, and the finish is a flower-like finish in Redish dark brown color.There is an attenuator that can adjust the high-frequency level at the bottom of the input terminal. It can be adjusted according to the condition of the room with 2 positions of Normal/Decrease."
